name: abort-async-prompt-on-object-destroyed
negative_constraints: 不要 manually track pending questions or check in yes_action whether the tab is still alive; use abort_on.
不要 change the semantics of default=False or of the force flag.
不要 put abort_on on the parent TabbedBrowser alone when the object at risk is the individual tab; use tab.destroyed.
不要 add abort_on to the synchronous else-branch.
procedure: 定位 the async prompt call site: here TabbedBrowser.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned in qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py. More generally, grep for message.confirm_async or message.ask_async whose yes_action/callback captures a Qt object (tab, window, download) that can be destroyed while the prompt is pending.
复用 the existing abort_on keyword of message.confirm_async. It takes a list of Qt signals; when any of them fires, the question is aborted. Do not build a new abort mechanism.
增加 abort_on=[tab.destroyed] (the destroyed signal of the captured object) to the confirm_async call so the prompt cannot run yes_action on a deleted tab.
更新 the method docstring to describe all three paths: pinned -> prompt, not pinned -> run yes_action directly, tab destroyed -> abort the question.
保持 the else-branch (not pinned, or force) unchanged: it still calls yes_action() synchronously and needs no abort handling.

trigger.task_type: Abort pinned tab prompt if tab is destroyed

validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/mainwindow and tests/end2end features covering pinned tabs (tabs.feature).

manual check: pin a tab, trigger :tab-close to open the prompt, then destroy the tab another way (for example close the window or :tab-only --force). The prompt should disappear and no exception should be logged when answering.
verify that message.confirm_async still accepts abort_on and forwards it to the Question (qutebrowser/utils/message.py).

name: add-modifier-alias-to-keyutils-special-key-parser
negative_constraints: Do not add a new Qt modifier constant or a separate code path for Cmd. Reuse the existing 'meta' mapping.
Do not map Command/Cmd to 'ctrl', even though Qt on macOS swaps Ctrl and Meta. Keep the alias semantically consistent with Windows/Mod4 → Meta, as the accepted change does.
Do not put a short alias before a longer alias that contains it.
Do not change the case-insensitive handling. Aliases in the table must be lowercase.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py and find `_parse_special_key(keystr)`.
Find the `replacements` tuple. It holds (alias, canonical) pairs and is applied in order to the lowercased key string.
Add each new alias as a pair that maps to the canonical modifier name Qt already understands: 'ctrl', 'meta', 'alt' or 'shift'. For macOS Command/Cmd, add ('command', 'meta') and ('cmd', 'meta').
Put the new pairs next to the other aliases for the same canonical modifier. In this PR, all meta aliases (windows, mod4, command, cmd) sit together and ('mod1', 'alt') was moved after them.

Order the pairs so that a longer alias is never partially rewritten by an earlier, shorter alias. Put 'command' before 'cmd', and keep the modifier aliases before the 'less'/'greater' symbol replacements.

Before adding a short alias such as 'cmd', check that it does not appear as a substring of any real Qt key name or other alias. The replacement is plain string substitution, so a collision would silently corrupt valid keys.
Do not touch the KeyInfo or KeySequence parsing logic. Normalization already flows through `_parse_special_key`, so changing the table alone makes `<Command+x>` and `<Cmd+x>` parse as `<Meta+x>`.
validation: Add parametrize cases to `TestKeySequence`'s normalization test in tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py: ('<Command+x>', '<Meta+x>') and ('<Cmd+x>', '<Meta+x>'). Mirror the table order.
Optionally add mixed-case and combo cases, such as '<cmd-x>' and '<Cmd+Shift+x>', to confirm separator and case handling.

Run `pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py`. Make sure the existing Control, Windows, Mod1 and Mod4 cases still pass, and that the hypothesis or roundtrip tests for all Qt key names do not regress because of substring collisions.

name: align-predicate-with-docstring-and-drop-caller-workarounds
negative_constraints: Do not change the docstring to describe the buggy behavior. The task is to make the code match the documentation.
Do not leave caller-side special cases such as `or modifiers == Qt.KeypadModifier` in asserts after fixing the predicate. Redundant workarounds hide future regressions.
Do not remove the _assert_plain_key or _assert_plain_modifier guards at the start of is_special.
Do not widen the change to other modifier handling (e.g. _modifiers_to_string, Shift normalization) unless a test requires it.
procedure: Locate the predicate in qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py and read its docstring. Treat the docstring as the spec.
Diff the docstring against the implementation and list every extra special case. Example: is_special treats Qt.KeypadModifier as non-special even though the docstring does not say so.
Remove the special case from the predicate. For is_special the result is `return not (_is_printable(key) and modifiers in [Qt.ShiftModifier, Qt.NoModifier])`.

Grep the repository for every caller of the predicate (e.g. `grep -rn is_special qutebrowser/ tests/`). Find places that compensated for the old behavior with extra `or` conditions, such as the assert in KeyInfo.__str__ that included `or self.modifiers == Qt.KeypadModifier`.
Simplify those compensating conditions to call the predicate directly, e.g. `assert is_special(self.key, self.modifiers)`.

Check that the branch above the assert (the printable-key / Shift handling in KeyInfo.__str__) still leaves only keys that are special under the corrected predicate. That keeps the assert sound for keypad-modified printable keys, which now render as `<Num+x>`.

Add or extend parametrized tests in tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py: assert that is_special is True for a printable key with Qt.KeypadModifier, and that str(KeyInfo) for a keypad key produces the `<Num+...>` form without an AssertionError.

trigger.task_type: Make a helper predicate (e.g. keyutils.is_special) behave exactly as its docstring states

validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/keyinput/` and confirm it passes.
Check that KeyInfo(Qt.Key_1, Qt.KeypadModifier) stringifies to `<Num+1>`.
Check that is_special(Qt.Key_A, Qt.NoModifier) and is_special(Qt.Key_A, Qt.ShiftModifier) are False.
Check that is_special(Qt.Key_A, Qt.KeypadModifier) and is_special(Qt.Key_A, Qt.ControlModifier) are True.
Run the key-binding config tests (tests/unit/config/) to confirm keypad bindings still parse and normalize.

name: allow-empty-input-in-keysequence-parse
negative_constraints: 不要直接删除 `assert len(new) > 0`。非空 keystr 解析出 0 个序列仍属于 bug, 需要保留断言。
不要在 parse 开头对空串特判并直接 return, 以免绕过 _validate 和统一的构造逻辑。
不要把空串转成 KeyParseError 抛出。任务目标是让 parse('') 正常返回空序列。
不要修改 _MAX_LEN 分块逻辑或 QKeySequence 的拼接方式。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py 中的 KeySequence.parse classmethod。找到对 utils.chunk(strings, cls._MAX_LEN) 的循环, 以及其后无条件执行的 `assert len(new) > 0`。
确认失败路径: 输入 keystr=='' 时 strings 为空, 循环不执行, new._sequences 为空, 于是 len(new)==0 并触发 AssertionError。
把断言改成仅在输入非空时检查: `if keystr: assert len(new) > 0`。非空输入的不变量保持不变。
保留后续的 `new._validate(keystr)` 调用和 `return new`, 让空输入也走同一条校验与返回路径, 不新增提前 return 分支。
检查 KeySequence 的 __len__、__iter__、__str__ 等方法在 _sequences 为空时的行为。不应抛异常, str 应为空串。
补充测试: 在 tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py 的 parse 参数化用例中加入 '' -> KeySequence() 的期望, 并断言 KeySequence.parse('') == KeySequence()。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py。
确认 KeySequence.parse('') 返回长度为 0 的序列, 且等于 KeySequence()。
确认非空输入(如 'a', '<Ctrl-x>', 超过 _MAX_LEN 的长序列)的解析结果不变。
确认非法输入仍然抛出 KeyParseError。

name: argparse-append-arg-empty-list-default
negative_constraints: Do not use default=None and then add `if args.debug_flags:` guards at every call site. Fix it once at the parser level.
Do not change dest='debug_flags', nargs=1 or the type validator debug_flag_error. Downstream code depends on these names and this structure.
Do not add defaults to other append arguments such as --qt-arg or --qt-flag in the same change, unless the task explicitly asks for it. Keep the change minimal.
Do not replace action='append' with action='extend' or anything similar. That changes the value structure (it flattens it).
procedure: Find the definition in qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py: inside get_argparser(), search for debug.add_argument('--debug-flag', ...).

Confirm the root cause: with action='append', argparse defaults the dest to None when the flag is not passed. Downstream code that iterates over or checks membership in args.debug_flags (e.g. `'x' in args.debug_flags` or `for f in args.debug_flags`) then raises a TypeError.
Add only the keyword argument default=[] to that add_argument call. Keep type=debug_flag_error, nargs=1, action='append', dest='debug_flags' and help unchanged.

Use grep -rn 'debug_flags' qutebrowser/ tests/ to review all consumers. Confirm they work with an empty list. Because nargs=1, the value is a list of lists like [['flag']], not a flat list, so check whether consumers flatten it.
If tests or app code build an argparse.Namespace by hand, add debug_flags=[] there too, so it matches the parser default.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit (focus on argument-parsing and debug-flag tests).
Check manually: python -c "from qutebrowser.qutebrowser import get_argparser; print(get_argparser().parse_args([]).debug_flags)" should print [].
Check that parse_args(['--debug-flag', '<valid flag>']).debug_flags is [['<valid flag>']]. An invalid flag should still be rejected by debug_flag_error.

name: argparse-positional-no-required-kwarg
negative_constraints: 不要把 positional 改成 `--bump` 这样的 optional flag。这会改变现有的 CLI 调用约定,也会影响 release 流程文档。
不要为了让参数可省略而加 `nargs='?'`。bump 参数必须保持必填。
不要改动 bump 后的版本计算和文件改写逻辑。本修复只涉及 parser 构造。
不要在 optional 参数(以 '-' 开头)上删除合法的 required=True。
procedure: 定位 scripts/dev/update_version.py 中 `if __name__ == "__main__":` 块里的 argparse.ArgumentParser 定义。
识别名字不以 '-' 开头的 add_argument 调用(例如 'bump'),它们是 positional 参数。
从这些 positional 参数中删除 `required=True`。argparse 对 positional 传入该 kwarg 会在构造 parser 时直接抛 TypeError,导致脚本无法运行。
保留 `choices=["major", "minor", "patch"]`、`action="store"` 和 help 文本不变。positional 参数本身就是必填的,choices 也会继续校验取值。
在 scripts/dev/ 下 grep 其他 positional add_argument 中的 `required=`,一并修复同类问题。

keywords: TypeError: 'required' is an invalid argument for positionals

validation: 运行 `python scripts/dev/update_version.py --help`,确认不再抛 TypeError,并列出 {major,minor,patch}。
运行 `python scripts/dev/update_version.py`(不带参数),确认 argparse 报 'the following arguments are required: bump'。
运行 `python scripts/dev/update_version.py foo`,确认因 invalid choice 被拒绝。
运行 flake8/pylint 等 linters 检查 scripts/dev。

name: argparse-repeatable-option-passthrough
negative_constraints: Do not change nargs to '+' or '*' to emulate repetition. That changes CLI semantics and swallows positional :command/URL arguments.
Do not keep `namespace.qt_arg[0]` / `[1]` indexing after adding append. It would pass a list into argv and break Qt startup.
Do not replace the None check with a truthiness-only check that assumes a list default, and do not set default=[]. A mutable default shared across parses is a bug source.
Do not reorder the existing argv layout or drop sys.argv[0] as the first element.
Do not remove the existing single-occurrence test cases.
procedure: In qutebrowser/qutebrowser.py get_argparser(), find the debug group's add_argument calls for the options that must become repeatable.

Add action='append' to each option and keep the existing nargs and metavar unchanged. The namespace value then becomes a list of lists: nargs=1 gives [[x], ...] and nargs=2 gives [[name, value], ...].
Find every consumer of the attribute. The main one is qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py get_args(namespace). Also grep for namespace.qt_flag and namespace.qt_arg (or args.qt_*) elsewhere.

Change each consumer from indexing a single entry (ns.opt[0]) to iterating over the list. For flags, use `argv += ['-' + flag[0] for flag in ns.qt_flag]`. For args, use `for name, value in ns.qt_arg: argv += ['-' + name, value]`.
Keep the `is not None` guard. With action='append' the default is still None when the option is absent, not [].
Keep the output order: sys.argv[0] first, then all flags, then all name/value pairs. Within each option, follow the order given on the command line.

Extend the parametrized test list in tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py TestGetQtArgs.test_qt_args. Add a case with --qt-arg given twice and a case with --qt-flag given twice. Keep the existing single-use cases as regression checks.

trigger.task_type: Allow a CLI option (e.g. --qt-arg / --qt-flag) to be given multiple times

validation: Run pytest tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py -k TestGetQtArgs.
Check that parsing ['--qt-arg','stylesheet','foo','--qt-arg','geometry','bar'] yields [argv0,'-stylesheet','foo','-geometry','bar'].
Check that parsing ['--qt-flag','foo','--qt-flag','bar'] yields [argv0,'-foo','-bar'].
Check that no args still yields [argv0] only.
Grep the repository for other qt_arg/qt_flag consumers and confirm none still index a single element.

name: backend-unsupported-op-typed-exception
negative_constraints: Do not use `except NotImplementedError` or a broad `except Exception` in caller code to swallow backend gaps.
Do not remove the env var or feature for all backends. QtWebKit still supports HTML selection and must keep providing it.
Do not wrap the plain-text selection() call in the same try block. A failure in the HTML part must not lose the text part.
Do not put the exception class in a backend-specific module. It belongs in the abstract browsertab.py so every backend and caller shares it.
procedure: Locate backend implementations (webengine/webenginetab.py, webkit/webkittab.py) where a method raises a bare NotImplementedError for a feature the backend cannot provide. In the evidence this was WebEngineCaret.selection(html=True).
Add a dedicated exception subclass in browsertab.py, next to WebTabError, e.g. `class UnsupportedOperationError(WebTabError)` with a docstring. Reuse it if it already exists.

Change the backend code from `raise NotImplementedError` to `raise browsertab.UnsupportedOperationError`. NotImplementedError means 'not written yet' and should not be caught. The new exception means 'this backend cannot do it' and callers are expected to handle it.

Find every caller of that method with grep, e.g. `caret.selection(html=True)` in commands.py where userscript env is built. Wrap only the backend-dependent call in `try/except browsertab.UnsupportedOperationError: pass`.
Degrade gracefully. Keep the values that can still be produced, such as QUTE_SELECTED_TEXT. Leave out only the optional value, such as QUTE_SELECTED_HTML, instead of aborting the whole command.
Keep the existing FIXME comments, such as tab None handling. Do not expand the fix's scope.

trigger.task_type: QtWebEngine: Fix crash with userscript + selection

validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser and the relevant tests/end2end features (caret, spawn userscript).
Manually or in an e2e test, under QtWebEngine: select text, run a userscript with :spawn -u, and confirm no crash, QUTE_SELECTED_TEXT is set, and QUTE_SELECTED_HTML is absent.
Under QtWebKit, confirm QUTE_SELECTED_HTML is still set.
Grep for remaining `raise NotImplementedError` in webenginetab.py that user-triggered paths can reach. Decide for each whether it should become UnsupportedOperationError.

name: bound-qtwebengine-workaround-version-range
negative_constraints: Do not delete the workaround outright. Qt 5.11 still needs it.
Do not replace `qtutils.version_check` with a raw `qVersion()` string comparison or `PYQT_VERSION` checks.
Do not use `compiled=True`, or leave the default, on only one side of the range.
Do not remove the QTBUG reference comment. Later cleanup depends on it.
Do not touch the `qute` scheme registration, which is unconditional.
procedure: Find the workaround block. Search for the `# WORKAROUND for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-...` comment and the `qtutils.version_check(...)` guard above it. In this case that is `QuteSchemeHandler.install` in webenginequtescheme.py.
Confirm which Qt version fixes the upstream bug. Use the QTBUG report or the task statement.

Turn the open-ended lower bound into a half-open range. Keep the existing lower bound and add an upper bound: `qtutils.version_check('5.11', compiled=False) and not qtutils.version_check('5.12', compiled=False)`.
Use the same `compiled=False` flag on both sides so both checks test the runtime Qt version. A mixed compiled/runtime check gives inconsistent ranges on distro builds.
Use parentheses and a continuation line for the multi-line condition. Keep the existing WORKAROUND comment and QTBUG link inside the block.
Leave the workaround body as it is (the `installUrlSchemeHandler(b'chrome-error', self)` and `installUrlSchemeHandler(b'chrome-extension', self)` calls). Only change the gate.
Check whether the scheme handler's request path has matching logic for chrome-error/chrome-extension URLs. If it does, make sure it does not assume those schemes are always registered on Qt >= 5.11.

trigger.task_type: Qt version-gated workaround narrowing (e.g. Qt 5.12: disable chrome-error:// and chrome-extension:// scheme handler workaround)

validation: Run the existing unit tests for qutebrowser/browser/webengine and tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py.
Run flake8/pylint on the changed file to check continuation-line indentation and line length.
If possible, run under Qt 5.11 and Qt 5.12. qute:// pages and error pages should load, and on 5.12 there should be no chrome-error handler registration.
Grep for other places with the same QTBUG number to keep their gating consistent.

name: cap-synthetic-key-repeat-count-across-backends
negative_constraints: Do not change the AbstractScroller API or the public scroll command signatures. The cap belongs inside the backend's private `_key_press`.
Do not cap only one backend. Fixing only WebEngine leaves WebKit hanging on the same large count.
Do not raise an error or warn the user for a large count. Clamp it silently.
Do not replace the loop with early-abort-at-page-boundary logic as part of this change. Keep the change a minimal clamp.
Do not use different magic numbers in the two backends.
procedure: Locate every loop that synthesizes key events from a user-supplied count. At minimum, check `WebEngineScroller._key_press` and `WebKitScroller._key_press`. Use `grep -n 'for _ in range(count)' qutebrowser/browser`.
Replace `range(count)` with `range(min(count, 5000))` inside the loop header. Leave the event construction and the postEvent/sendEvent logic unchanged.
Apply the identical cap to both the WebEngine and the WebKit scroller so the backends behave the same for the same count.

Remove the FIXME comments that this fix resolves: the class-level `# FIXME:qtwebengine ... big count/argument causes memory leaks and hangs` and the `Abort scrolling if the minimum/maximum was reached` note in `_key_press`.
Keep FIXME comments that are unrelated to this fix, such as `# FIXME:qtwebengine needed? self._widget.setFocus()` in webkittab.
validation: Run the existing tests: `pytest tests/unit/browser` and the scroll-related end-to-end features (`tests/end2end/features/scroll.feature`) for both backends where available.
Manually run `:scroll-page 0 1` with count 99999 (for example, type `99999` before the command) and confirm there is no hang or memory spike on WebEngine and on WebKit.
Grep to confirm that no `range(count)` remains in the scroller key-press paths and that both files use the value 5000.

name: consume-one-shot-override-at-use-site
negative_constraints: 不要用 QTimer.singleShot(0, ...) 或其他延迟回调来清除一次性状态。QtWebEngine 的 createWindow 是异步触发的, 可能比回调晚到, 导致 override 已被清掉; rapid hinting 时也可能清掉下一次 hint 刚设置的值。
不要只修 QtWebEngine 而漏掉 QtWebKit 的 webpage.py, 两个 backend 的 override_target 语义必须保持一致。
不要在 override 为 None 的分支中修改状态, 只在实际消费 override 时清空。
procedure: 定位所有读取 tab.data.override_target 的位置: WebEngineView.createWindow (webengine/webview.py) 和 BrowserPage 中处理新窗口/链接点击的 target 选择逻辑 (webkit/webpage.py)。
定位设置或重置该状态的位置: AbstractWebElement.click 中通过 QTimer.singleShot(0, after_click) 的延迟回调。
把重置从异步回调里移出, 改到消费点: 在 `if override_target is not None: target = override_target` 分支内紧接着写 `self._tabdata.override_target = None`, 两个 backend 都要改。
after_click 只保留与点击后编辑相关的副作用, 例如对可编辑文本输入执行 caret.move_to_end_of_document, 并同步更新其 docstring。
检查两个 backend 的 target 选择逻辑, 确认都是读后立即清空, 语义一致。

keywords: new tab opens in wrong place

validation: 运行现有测试: pytest tests/unit/browser 和 tests/end2end/features/hints.feature, 两个 backend 都跑 (--qute-bdd-webengine)。
手动或通过 e2e 验证: 用 rapid 模式 (hint links tab-bg --rapid) 连续选择多个 hint, 每个链接都应以后台 tab 打开, 而不是落到当前 tab 或普通 open_target。
验证普通链接点击 (无 override) 在 hint 之后仍然使用默认的 open_target。

name: dedupe-names-in-multi-name-from-import
negative_constraints: 不要删除首次出现的那个名字, 也不要借机重排或重新格式化整行 import。
不要顺手删除看起来未使用的其他导入(如 utils、objreg)。那属于另一类变更, 需要单独验证。
不要把多名字 import 拆成多行, 也不要改成 'import qutebrowser.utils.usertypes' 风格。这会偏离仓库现有约定。
如果两次导入的来源不同(不同包同名, 或带 'as' 别名), 不要当作纯重复处理, 那可能是遮蔽 bug。
不要为这种纯导入去重添加 changelog 条目或新测试。
procedure: 定位 lint 报告的重复导入行。这类问题常见于 'from qutebrowser.utils import a, b, ..., a' 这种多名字 from-import, 新名字被追加到末尾, 而列表前面已经有同名项。
在同一模块内搜索其余 'from qutebrowser.<pkg> import' 行, 确认重复项没有同时出现在另一条 import 语句里。
只删除后出现的那个重复名字, 保持原有名字顺序和行结构不变, 这样 diff 只有一行。
确认被保留的那个导入仍指向同一对象, 即同包同名、没有 'as' 别名。只有这种情况下删除才是纯无操作变更。
在当前 commit 范围内, 顺带检查同一子包(如 qutebrowser/keyinput/、qutebrowser/utils/)的其他文件是否有同类重复。如有, 同样一行修复。
validation: python -c 'import qutebrowser.keyinput.modeman' (或对应被修改模块), 确认导入成功
运行 pylint/flake8, 确认 reimported(W0404)/F811 告警消失且没有新增告警
运行该模块相关的现有测试(如 keyinput 测试), 确认无回归
检查 git diff, 确认只改了 import 行中的一个名字

name: defer-qwebengine-profile-access-in-settings
negative_constraints: 不要在模块导入、类定义或 MAPPINGS 构造期间调用 QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile() 或其他会实例化 profile 的 API。
不要在 __init__ 缓存 profile 的 bound method；缓存会固定到过早创建的 profile。
不要只修改基类而遗漏覆盖 _set/get 的子类。
不要改变 websettings.Base 的 get/_set 签名或 utils.unused(settings) 约定。
procedure: 定位在模块导入或类实例化时(如 module-level MAPPINGS 字典里构造的 websettings.Base 子类 __init__)调用 QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile() 的代码。
把在 __init__ 中解析出的 bound method(getattr(profile, name))改为只保存属性名字符串(self._getter = getter / self._setter = setter)。
在 get()/_set() 实际调用时再执行 getattr(QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile(), self._getter)()，从而把 profile 创建推迟到 QtWebEngine 初始化之后(例如 inspector/远程调试环境变量已设置之后)。
同步检查所有子类(如 PersistentCookiePolicy 覆盖的 _set)，确保它们不再使用旧的预绑定 self._setter 可调用对象，而是同样惰性获取。

增加 end2end 测试: 用 quteproc_new 以 --temp-basedir --enable-webengine-inspector 启动，等待 'Remote debugging server started successfully...[REDACTED_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT]:*' 日志，解析端口并用 socket 连接验证；非 webengine 后端时 pytest.skip()。

trigger.task_type: Don't create QWebEngine profile at import time

validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine tests/unit/config
运行 pytest tests/end2end/test_invocations.py -k webengine_inspector --qute-bdd-webengine(或仓库对应的 webengine 开关)确认远程调试端口可连接
grep 'defaultProfile()' 确认没有残留在 import 时执行的调用

name: defuse-pseudo-type-comments-for-pylint
negative_constraints: Do not use `# pylint: disable` or adjust the pylintrc to hide these errors. Fix the comment text at its source.
Do not modify real PEP 484 `# type:` annotations.
Do not delete the explanatory comments or rewrite their meaning. Change only the separator.
Do not add a changelog entry or tests for this. It is an internal lint fix.
procedure: Locate every comment line that begins with `# type:` across the whole repository, e.g. `grep -rnE '#\s*type:' qutebrowser/ tests/ scripts/`. Do not stop at the files the linter already flagged.

Classify each hit. If it is a real PEP 484 type annotation (for example `# type: List[str]`), keep it unchanged. If it is prose, quoted documentation (such as the MDN attribute description in mhtml.py) or sample error output (such as the QSqlError fields in sql.py), it is a pseudo type comment.
Change only the separator in each pseudo type comment, from `type:` to `type -`, for example `# type - ConnectionError`. Keep the rest of the comment text and the indentation exactly as they were.
When a pseudo type comment sits inside a block of field-style comments (`type`, `database text`, `driver text`, `error code`), change only the `type:` line. Leave the other lines as they are.
Keep the diff limited to comment lines. No code logic may change.
validation: Run `grep -rnE '#\s*type:' qutebrowser/` and confirm that only real type annotations remain.
Run pylint 2.x on the changed modules, e.g. `tox -e pylint`, and confirm there are no type-comment syntax-error or parse errors.
Run flake8 or the existing tests to confirm behavior has not changed, e.g. `tox -e flake8`.

name: demote-known-qt-messages-to-debug
negative_constraints: Do not keep the early `return` for known messages. The point is that they are still recorded at DEBUG level, not discarded.
Do not change the qt_to_logging mapping or the levels of other Qt messages.
Do not use substring or regex matching for suppressed_msgs. Keep the exact match on msg.strip().
Do not bypass qt.makeRecord/qt.handle, for example by calling qt.debug directly. That would lose the file, line, and func context.
Do not put commas between the fragments of a single split string. That would split one pattern into several partial patterns.
Do not leave the old last element without a comma when you add new elements after it.
Do not assume the last element already has a comma. The accepted PR itself left the last entry without one.
Do not rely on code review to catch the concatenation. It raises no syntax error.
procedure: In qutebrowser/utils/log.py, find qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg). It holds the qt_to_logging map and the suppressed_msgs list.

Find the early `return` that fires when msg.strip() is in suppressed_msgs. Replace it with a computed variable: set level = logging.DEBUG for well-known messages. Otherwise set level = qt_to_logging[msg_type].

Leave the rest of the function unchanged and let execution continue for all messages: the context.function regex that extracts the function name, the 'qt' / 'qt-<category>' logger name logic, and the call to qt.makeRecord.
Pass the computed `level` into qt.makeRecord(name, level, context.file, context.line, msg, None, None, func). Do not look up qt_to_logging[msg_type] directly at that call.
Update the comment above suppressed_msgs. It should say these messages are demoted to debug so users don't see them, not that they are suppressed or dropped.
To add more noisy messages, append their exact stripped text to suppressed_msgs. Do not add new branches.
Find the current last element of the string tuple or list. It may span several adjacent literal lines.
Add a trailing comma after the final literal of that element before appending anything.
Write each new element as one or more adjacent literals with no internal commas, followed by its own trailing comma.
Keep one comment line per element directly above it.
Before appending, check whether the current last element of the tuple ends with a comma. Add one if it does not.
Give the new element its own trailing comma so the next maintainer cannot hit the same trap.
If the entry uses multi-line adjacent strings, put the comma only after the final fragment, never between fragments.

trigger.task_type: Just change level to DEBUG with suppressed Qt messages

validation: Run the existing tests under tests/ for utils/log.
Emit a known message such as 'OpenType support missing for script 19' through qt_message_handler. Confirm a record appears on the 'qt' logger at DEBUG level.
Confirm an unrelated QtWarningMsg is still logged at WARNING.
Run flake8/pylint on log.py to check line length and the unused-variable rule.

name: deshadow-earlyinit-qt-version-param
negative_constraints: Do not change the function name earlyinit.qt_version. Other modules (version.py, startup checks) call it.
Do not move the PyQt5 imports to module level in earlyinit.py. earlyinit must stay importable before the Qt checks run.
Do not change the output string format. Tests and version output depend on it.
procedure: Locate qt_version() in qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py. It has a parameter named the same as the function, `qt_version`, which shadows the function name.

Rename that parameter to a descriptive, non-conflicting name, such as `qt_version_str`, to match QT_VERSION_STR. Rename every use inside the function body: the None check, the assignment, the comparison and the format.
Keep the existing behavior: lazy imports of qVersion and QT_VERSION_STR inside the function, and the return format '{runtime} (compiled {compiled})' when the two versions differ.
Grep the repo, tests included, for keyword calls such as `qt_version(... qt_version=`. Update each one to the new keyword. tests/unit/misc/test_earlyinit.py::test_qt_version is a known caller.
Wrap long call lines so they stay within the repo's line-length limit (79 chars).
validation: pytest tests/unit/misc/test_earlyinit.py -k qt_version
Run pylint/flake8 on qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py and confirm there is no redefined-outer-name warning and no line-length warning.
Grep for 'qt_version=' and confirm no stale keyword callers remain.

name: document-windows-versioninfo-magic-values
negative_constraints: Do not change any field value, key name, or field order. This is a pure readability refactor, and the generated version file must be semantically identical.
Do not change the literal '040904B0' to a different language or code page. Do not let it disagree with the Translation [en_us, utf_16] values: Windows resource lookup relies on the two matching.
Do not move en_us / utf_16 to module-level constants or into another module. Keep them as local definitions near where they are used, consistent with the existing script style.
Do not add a changelog entry or new tests for this kind of dev-script formatting/comment change.
Do not introduce new dependencies, and do not change how the PyInstaller.utils.win32.versioninfo (vs) API is called.
procedure: Open scripts/dev/gen_versioninfo.py and locate the kids list in main(). It holds the vs.StringFileInfo / vs.StringTable / vs.VarFileInfo construction.

Find the bare magic numbers, for example the [1033, 1200] passed to VarStruct('Translation', ...). Above ffi = vs.FixedFileInfo(...), extract them into named local variables: en_us = 1033 with a # 0x0409 comment, and utf_16 = 1200 with a # 0x04B0 comment.
Above those variables, add reference links: the locale-code table and the MSDN code-page identifiers page (dd317756). This lets a reader verify where the values come from.
Change the Translation argument to use the named variables: vs.VarStruct('Translation', [en_us, utf_16]).

Next to the string literal '040904B0' in StringTable, add a comment explaining how it is composed. 0x0409 is MAKELANGID(LANG_ENGLISH, SUBLANG_ENGLISH_US). 0x04B0 is codepage 1200 (UTF-16LE). Make clear that the string is the hex concatenation of the two Translation values.

Reformat the deeply nested call into block indentation. Each structural level gets its own opening line ('kids = [', 'vs.StringFileInfo([', 'vs.StringTable(...', ' [') and its own closing line ('])', '])', ']').
Use a fixed 4-space indent per level, and put trailing commas on the multi-line list elements. This avoids the hard-to-maintain alignment indentation of the original.

Keep every StringStruct key name, value, and their order exactly as they were (Comments, CompanyName, FileDescription, FileVersion, InternalName, LegalCopyright, LegalTrademarks, OriginalFilename, ProductName, ProductVersion).
Keep the vs.VSVersionInfo(ffi, kids) call, the output file, and the rest of the script logic unchanged.
validation: python -m py_compile scripts/dev/gen_versioninfo.py
Run the project's existing lint checks (flake8/pylint) on scripts/dev to confirm the indentation and trailing commas are compliant.
If PyInstaller is available, run the script before and after the change and diff the generated version file. The content must be byte-for-byte identical.
Manually confirm that hex(en_us)=0x409 and hex(utf_16)=0x4b0, and that together they make '040904B0'.

name: earlyinit-qt-pyqt-dual-version-check-message
negative_constraints: 不要只报告 qVersion()。用户无法据此区分是 Qt 太旧还是 PyQt 太旧，消息中必须包含 PYQT_VERSION_STR。
不要用 PYQT_VERSION（整数）来显示版本，显示时要用 PYQT_VERSION_STR。反过来，也不要用字符串做版本比较。
不要把 PyQt5 的导入提到模块级别。earlyinit 必须在 PyQt 缺失或版本过旧时仍能导入，并给出友好的报错。
不要改变 backend 分支的逻辑或最低版本号。这项任务只涉及消息和缺失的 PyQt 检查，不要顺带提升最低版本要求。
不要用 print/sys.exit 代替 _die，否则会失去 GUI 错误弹窗和统一的退出行为。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py 中的 check_qt_version(backend)。它在启动早期运行，只能使用此时已经可以安全导入的模块：函数内局部导入的 PyQt5.QtCore 和 qutebrowser.utils.qtutils。
在已有的局部导入 `from PyQt5.QtCore import qVersion, PYQT_VERSION` 中追加 PYQT_VERSION_STR。不要把这个导入移到模块顶层。
Qt 版本继续用 qtutils.version_check('X.Y.Z', operator.lt) 检查，PyQt 版本用十六进制整数比较，例如 `PYQT_VERSION < 0x050200`。两个条件用 `or` 组合，这样两个最低版本要求都会被强制执行，而不是只检查 Qt。
改写所有 'Fatal error' 文本，让它同时报告两个版本：'... but Qt {} / PyQt {} is installed.'.format(qVersion(), PYQT_VERSION_STR)。通用最低版本分支（5.2.0）和 webengine 专属分支（5.7.0 / PyQt 0x050701）都要改，保持两处措辞一致。
继续通过现有的 _die(text) 报错退出，不要另造新的错误通道。保留分支顺序：先检查通用最低版本，再检查与 backend 相关的版本（elif backend == 'webengine'）。
多行字符串采用括号隐式拼接，并把 .format 链放在下一行，保持在 79 列以内，满足仓库的 flake8/pylint 风格要求。
validation: 运行 tests/unit/misc/test_earlyinit.py（如存在）及现有单元测试，确认没有回归。
用 monkeypatch 将 PYQT_VERSION 设为低于阈值，确认会调用 _die，且消息包含 'Qt <ver> / PyQt <ver>'。
运行 flake8/pylint 检查 earlyinit.py 的行长和格式。
手动检查 webengine 分支与通用分支的消息格式是否一致。

name: extract-qurl-validity-check-to-urlutils-helper
negative_constraints: Do not copy the old inline code verbatim. Its 'Invalid URL {}' placeholder was never formatted, so the URL never appeared in the message. The helper must call `.format(url.toDisplayString())`.
Do not use `url.toString()` or `repr(url)` in user-facing errors. Follow the repository convention of `toDisplayString()`.
Do not change `invalid_url_error`. It serves the non-command message.error path and takes a different signature (win_id, action).
Do not leave a duplicated inline check at any call site once the helper exists.
Do not move the validity check after tab or window side effects in the caller.
Do not write `url.errorString()` only to the debug log while the user sees just 'Invalid link'. Users need the specific reason.
Do not reimplement the message concatenation in webpage.py. Reuse the urlutils helper so the format stays consistent.
Do not change the return value or the `open_target` reset in the invalid-link branch. That would break the navigation-blocking behavior.
Do not format a raw urlstr of an invalid URL into the message. It may be empty or misleading.
procedure: Locate the inline checks with grep: `grep -rn 'isValid()' qutebrowser/browser qutebrowser/commands`. Focus on blocks shaped like `if not url.isValid(): errstr = 'Invalid URL ...'; raise cmdexc.CommandError(...)`. A typical example is `CommandDispatcher._open` in browser/commands.py.

In qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py, add a module-level function `raise_cmdexc_if_invalid(url)` next to the existing `invalid_url_error(win_id, url, action)`, which handles the message.error path. Give it a one-line docstring describing the QUrl check.

Implement it as follows. Return silently when `url.isValid()` is true. Otherwise build `errstr = 'Invalid URL {}'.format(url.toDisplayString())`. Read `url.errorString()` once into a local variable, and if it is non-empty append `' - {}'.format(url_error)`. Then `raise cmdexc.CommandError(errstr)`.
Add `from qutebrowser.commands import cmdexc` to the imports in urlutils.py, after the existing `from qutebrowser.utils import ...` line.

Replace every inline block at the call sites with a single `urlutils.raise_cmdexc_if_invalid(url)` statement. Keep it at the same position, before any side effects such as tab or window creation and `cmdutils.check_exclusive`.
Add unit tests in the urlutils test module. A valid QUrl must not raise. An invalid QUrl must raise CommandError, and the message must contain both the display string and the errorString.
Locate the place in the browser layer where an invalid QUrl is detected, typically the `not url.isValid()` branch in `BrowserPage.acceptNavigationRequest` in qutebrowser/browser/webpage.py.
Check that `get_errstring(url, base)` exists in qutebrowser/utils/urlutils.py. It combines a base description with `url.errorString()` into one user-facing message.
Add `urlutils` to the existing `from qutebrowser.utils import (...)` statement. Do not add a separate import line.
Build the message as `msg = urlutils.get_errstring(url, "Invalid link clicked")`, then show it with `message.error(self._win_id, msg)`.

Delete the old pair of calls: the user message that formatted the raw urlstr, and `log.webview.debug(url.errorString())`. Their content is now part of the user-facing message, so the debug log would only duplicate it.
Leave the rest of the branch unchanged: reset `self.open_target = usertypes.ClickTarget.normal` and still `return False` so the navigation is rejected.
Search the repository for other places that hand-concatenate `errorString()` for invalid URLs. List them and decide whether to unify them in the same change; do not expand scope by default.

validation: Run the existing test suite (pytest tests/ or the repository's unittest runner).
Run `python -c 'import qutebrowser.utils.urlutils'` and do a full app import to confirm the new utils→commands import causes no circular import.
Grep for remaining `errstr = "Invalid URL` occurrences outside urlutils. There should be none.

name: fix-bitmask-loop-boundary-in-qflags-key
negative_constraints: Don't rewrite qflags_key or switch to another decomposition algorithm. The bug is a one-character comparison boundary.
Don't remove every xfail marker at once. Only unmark tests that you have confirmed now pass, and leave the issue-#42 cases marked.
Don't touch qenum_key or the add_base/klass semantics as part of this fix.
Do not assume the result of a QFlags bitwise operation is still accepted by every Qt API.
Do not change the return-value semantics or the fallback behavior of qenum_key/qflags_key.
procedure: Locate the bit-decomposition loop in qutebrowser/utils/debug.py:qflags_key. It shifts `mask` from 0x01 and collects the bits for which `value & mask` is set.

Check the loop condition against these boundary cases: a value that is exactly one power of two (for example Qt.AlignTop == 0x20), and a value whose highest set bit equals the mask. A strict `<` leaves out the highest bit, and for a single-bit value it leaves out the only bit.
Change the condition to the inclusive form `while mask <= value:`. Keep the rest of the loop and the name lookup (qenum_key per bit, then join with '|') unchanged.
Leave value=0 alone. The loop is still skipped for 0, and the existing zero handling stays as it is.
In tests/unit/utils/test_debug.py::TestQFlagsKey, remove the `fixme` (xfail) wrapper only from the cases that this fix makes pass: the single-flag parametrize case and test_add_base.
Keep `fixme` on the multi-flag cases that still fail for the separate reason tracked in issue #42 (for example AlignLeft|AlignTop and the cases with klass=Qt.Alignment).
In debug.qenum_key and similar helpers, convert any enum or flags value to `int()` before passing it to a Qt meta-object API.
When modifying these helpers, check the edge case where flags drop back to 0 after `&= ~` operations. In that case the PyQt object type can be unstable.
Document the reproduction steps in the docstring of the new test, even if the root cause is unclear.
validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/utils/test_debug.py -k QFlagsKey -rxX`.
Confirm 'AlignTop' and add_base 'Qt.AlignTop' pass as normal tests and are not reported as XPASS.
Confirm the remaining fixme cases are still reported as xfail and not as unexpected failures.
Confirm AlignCenter still returns 'AlignHCenter|AlignVCenter'.

name: force-js-on-qtwebengine-devtools-view
negative_constraints: Do not toggle JavascriptEnabled on QWebEngineSettings.globalSettings() or the default profile. That would re-enable JS for the user's normal tabs and violate their content.javascript.enabled choice.
Do not write to qutebrowser's config (config.val / config.instance.set) to work around this, because the inspector must not mutate user settings.
Do not apply the same change to the QtWebKit inspector path without verifying it needs it. That backend uses a different mechanism (QWebInspector).
Do not remove or alter the port and remote-debugging setup in inspect().
procedure: Locate WebEngineInspector.__init__ in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webengineinspector.py, where a dedicated QWebEngineView is created for the devtools UI.
Read that view's own settings object via view.settings(). It is a per-view QWebEngineSettings, not the profile-wide or global defaults that the user's JS config applies to.

Call settings.setAttribute(QWebEngineSettings.JavascriptEnabled, True) right after creating the view and before self._set_widget(view). The devtools frontend is itself a JS app, so it renders blank when the user disables JS globally.
Import QWebEngineSettings from the same PyQt5.QtWebEngineWidgets module as QWebEngineView, so the inspector module's imports stay consistent.
Leave the AbstractWebInspector base class and the inspect() and remote-debugging-port logic unchanged. The fix belongs only to the backend-specific widget construction.

Run flake8/pylint on webengineinspector.py to confirm the new import is used and correctly ordered.

name: gate-new-qt-signals-with-version-check
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except AttributeError 或 hasattr 判断新版 Qt 的信号或方法能否使用。PyQt 与 Qt 版本不一致时会误判。
不要只检查运行时 Qt 版本（不要传 compiled=False）。除非明确只依赖运行时行为、与 PyQt 绑定无关。
不要把同一版本门控拆到多处，导致部分信号连接了、部分没连接。
不要顺手改无关信号的连接顺序或逻辑。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser 中 grep 'except AttributeError' 和类似 '# Added in Qt 5.x' 的注释，定位用 try/except 探测新版 Qt 信号或 API 是否存在的连接代码。重点看 webenginetab.py 中 _WebEnginePermissions.connect_signals 等 page.xxx.connect 的位置。
背景：运行时 Qt 与编译时 PyQt 的版本可能不一致，例如 PyQt 5.10 运行在 Qt 5.11 上。这时信号属性可能存在，但无法正常连接或使用；也可能不存在。所以 hasattr 或 AttributeError 判断不出 API 能否真正使用。
复用 qutebrowser.utils.qtutils.version_check('5.11') 做门控。它默认同时检查运行时 Qt 版本和编译时 PyQt/Qt 版本（compiled=True），能覆盖版本不一致的情况。
把 try: ... except AttributeError: pass 改成 if qtutils.version_check('<引入该 API 的 Qt 版本>'):，并把对应的 .connect() 调用放进这个 if 块。同一版本引入的多个信号放在同一个 if 块里。
确认文件顶部已经 import qtutils（webenginetab.py 已有 from qutebrowser.utils import ... qtutils）。
检查对应的槽函数（例如 _on_quota_requested、_on_register_protocol_handler_requested）是否引用了 5.11 才有的类型或枚举。如果有，也要放在同样的门控下，或保证只有信号连接后才会执行到这些代码。

trigger.task_type: Don't connect Qt 5.11 signals on PyQt 5.10

validation: 运行现有测试：pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine，以及与权限相关的 end2end 测试（tests/end2end/features/prompts.feature）。

如果条件允许，在 PyQt 5.10 + Qt 5.11 的组合上启动 qutebrowser，确认打开页面时不报连接错误或 AttributeError。

name: gate-qt-signal-connections-with-version-check
negative_constraints: Do not keep the try/except AttributeError for feature detection. It can silently swallow real AttributeErrors such as typos in slot or signal names.
Do not use hasattr(page, 'signalName') as a replacement. The repository convention is an explicit qtutils.version_check.
Do not change the slot handlers (_on_print_requested, _on_select_client_certificate) or their own version guards within this task.
Do not pass compiled=False or other version_check arguments unless the original code needed runtime-vs-compiled distinctions.
Do not move version-gated connects into unrelated methods, and do not reorder the other signal connections.
procedure: Locate the signal-wiring method. For WebEngine this is WebEngineTab._connect_signals in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py. Find signals wrapped in `try: ... connect(...) except AttributeError: pass` that carry an 'Added in Qt X.Y' comment.
Find the Qt version that introduced each signal. Take it from the existing comment or the Qt documentation, e.g. printRequested and selectClientCertificate appeared in 5.12.
Reuse the existing helper `qtutils.version_check('X.Y')`. Confirm `qtutils` is already imported from qutebrowser.utils in the file, and add the import only if it is missing.

Replace the try/except block with `if qtutils.version_check('X.Y'):` and keep the original connect calls inside it unchanged. Use one block per version, grouping signals that were added in the same version.
Delete the `except AttributeError: pass` branch and the 'Added in Qt X.Y' comment. The version string now documents the requirement.

Reason through both branches: on Qt < 5.12 the block is skipped with no AttributeError; on Qt >= 5.12 both signals are connected.

name: guard-configtype-transform-when-config-dir-none
negative_constraints: Do not call super().transform() or os.path.join with standarddir.config() when it may be None.
Do not fix this by making standarddir.config() return a fake or temporary directory. -c "" deliberately means no config dir.
Do not change validation semantics to reject relative values when the config dir is None. Users may legitimately pass inline CSS.
Do not remove the inline-data fallback branch while restructuring the condition.
procedure: Find configtypes subclasses whose validate/transform resolve relative paths against standarddir.config(). Examples are File, UserStyleSheet and Directory, plus anything that calls os.path.join(standarddir.config(), ...).
Check the config-is-None path. validate() usually skips relative-path checks when standarddir.config() is None, so transform() cannot assume the value is absolute or resolvable.

In the subclass transform, add an explicit `if standarddir.config() is None:` branch. Set the resolved path to None there and do not call super().transform(), because the parent would join against None.

Make the downstream logic None-safe, e.g. `if path is not None and os.path.exists(path)`. Keep the existing fallback behaviour. For UserStyleSheet the fallback treats the value as inline CSS and base64-encodes it into a data URL.
Keep the early `if not value: return None` at the top unchanged.
Add a comment explaining why super().transform() is skipped: it relies on validation having rejected relative paths, which does not happen with -c "".

Add a unit test in tests/unit/config/test_configtypes.py that monkeypatches standarddir.config to return None and asserts the transform result. Also add an end-to-end regression test that starts with -c "" (see the companion skill).

trigger.task_type: Fix crash when starting qutebrowser with -c "" (no config dir) in a config type transform/validate

validation: Run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/config/test_configtypes.py.
Run the new or updated unit test with standarddir.config monkeypatched to None and confirm there is no TypeError.
Run the integration test that starts with -c "" and confirm the process starts and quits cleanly.

name: guard-empty-command-text-before-index
negative_constraints: 不要用 try/except IndexError 包住索引来掩盖问题，应显式判断空值。
不要在空输入时静默返回或清空命令行，应与非法前缀一样抛出 CommandError。
不要把空值检查放到 {url} 替换之前就结束流程。校验应针对最终的 text 进行。
不要修改 modeparsers.STARTCHARS 的定义，也不要改动 set_cmd_text 的内部行为。
不要先写 `text[0]` 再判空,空输入会抛 IndexError。
不要在校验失败后仍调用 set_cmd_text 或 command_accept,run=True 时尤其会执行非法输入。
不要在 callback 内用 raise cmdexc.CommandError 代替 message.error。callback 是异步编辑器回调,异常不会被命令分发器捕获。
不要硬编码起始字符集合,必须引用 modeparsers.STARTCHARS。
不要为测试另写一个 editor 脚本生成器,应复用 set_up_editor。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/command.py 中定位 Command 类的 :set-cmd-text 命令处理函数。重点检查 {url} 替换之后对 text[0] 的校验。
找出所有直接索引用户输入字符串的位置，例如 text[0]、text[-1]。用户传入空字符串时，这些位置会抛出 IndexError，最终表现为崩溃或未处理异常。
在原有条件前加空值短路判断，写成 `if not text or text[0] not in modeparsers.STARTCHARS:`。这样空输入会和非法首字符走同一条错误分支。
复用已有的 cmdexc.CommandError("Invalid command text '{}'.")，把错误作为用户可见的命令错误报告。不要新增异常类型。
把 `not text[0] in ...` 顺手改成更地道的 `text[0] not in ...`，语义保持不变。
合法校验通过后仍然调用 self.set_cmd_text(text)，正常路径不做改动。
定位 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/command.py 中 Command.edit_command 里交给 editor.ExternalEditor 的内部 callback(text)。
在 callback 开头加 guard clause。条件是 `not text or text[0] not in modeparsers.STARTCHARS`,先判空再取下标,避免空字符串触发 IndexError。
guard 命中时调用 message.error(...) 报告错误,消息里列出 modeparsers.STARTCHARS。随后直接 return,不要调用 set_cmd_text,也不要调用 command_accept。
复用现有常量 modeparsers.STARTCHARS 作为合法前缀的唯一来源,不要硬编码 ':' 或 '/' 等字符。
在 utils 的 import 行补上 `message`,和已有的 usertypes/log/objreg 并列。
在 tests/end2end/features/test_editor_bdd.py 中复用已有的 set_up_editor(quteproc, server, tmpdir, text) helper,新增一个 bdd.when step,例如 'I set up a fake editor returning empty text',传入 ""。
在 editor.feature 中增加场景:设置返回空文本的 fake editor,执行 :edit-command(可分别覆盖带 --run 和不带的情况),期望出现 error 消息 'command must start with one of ...'。
validation: 运行现有测试套件，例如 tox 或 pytest。
手动或用测试执行 `:set-cmd-text ""`，确认显示的是 "Invalid command text ''." 错误，不出现 IndexError 崩溃。
确认 `:set-cmd-text :open` 和 `:set-cmd-text /foo` 仍能正常设置命令行。
确认 `:set-cmd-text foo` 这类非法前缀仍会报 CommandError。

name: guard-invalid-qurl-before-per-url-config-lookup
negative_constraints: Do not catch exceptions around the config.instance.get call to hide the error. Check the URL's validity explicitly instead.
Do not fall back to the global value by calling set_muted with a default when the URL is invalid. Return early so the previous mute state is kept.
Do not reset or modify self._overridden in the invalid-URL path.
Do not refactor the slot signature or the signal connection. This is a one-line guard fix.
procedure: Locate the urlChanged slot that receives a QUrl, for example WebEngineAudio._on_url_changed decorated with @pyqtSlot(QUrl).

Find where the url is passed to a per-URL config lookup, such as config.instance.get('content.mute', url=url). Pattern-scoped config can error on an invalid or empty QUrl. During page transitions QtWebEngine may emit an empty, invalid QUrl.

Add `not url.isValid()` to the slot's existing early-return condition. For example, change `if self._overridden:` to `if self._overridden or not url.isValid():`. Keep the guard minimal and put it before any config access.
Leave the existing override semantics unchanged. If the user has manually overridden the setting (self._overridden), the slot should still return early.

Search the same file and its siblings for other `config.instance.get(..., url=url)` calls inside urlChanged or loadFinished handlers. Check whether they need the same isValid guard, but only change them if the task scope covers them.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser and the webengine-related tests.
If feasible, add or run a unit test that calls _on_url_changed(QUrl()) and asserts that nothing raises and that set_muted is not called.
Manually check that per-domain content.mute still applies when navigating to a valid URL, and that a manual :tab-mute override is still respected.

name: guard-optional-backend-singletons-in-debug-commands
negative_constraints: Do not assume a successful QtWebKit import means the WebKit backend is in use. Always also check the runtime singleton for None.
Do not use a bare except or catch AttributeError to hide the None case. That masks real bugs.
Do not drop the history cache stats under WebKit. They must still be reported when the interface exists.
Do not rewrite the command to switch on objects.backend unless needed. The minimal None guard is the accepted fix.
procedure: Locate the debug command in qutebrowser/misc/utilcmds.py, for example debug_cache_stats. Find every place it touches a backend-specific object, such as the PyQt5.QtWebKit import or QWebHistoryInterface.defaultInterface().

Note that a successful import does not mean the backend is active. When QtWebKit is installed but the session runs on QtWebEngine, defaultInterface() returns None. Calling .historyContains on it then raises AttributeError.
Initialize the optional result before the try block, for example history_info = None. Every path then leaves it defined.
Inside the try block, check the singleton with `if interface is not None:` before reading attributes like historyContains.cache_info().
Make the except ImportError branch a plain pass, since the default is already set. Catch only ImportError. Do not widen it to AttributeError or Exception.
Keep the existing log.misc.debug output format. A None value should simply log as None for that cache.

trigger.task_type: Fix :debug-* command crashing under QtWebEngine (or a backend where QtWebKit objects are absent)

validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/misc/test_utilcmds.py if present, otherwise the related end-to-end debug command tests.
Run :debug-cache-stats with --backend webengine. It should raise no exception, and history_info should log as None.
Run :debug-cache-stats with --backend webkit if available. history_info should show a CacheInfo tuple.
Run pylint/flake8 on utilcmds.py. Keep the existing protected-access disable.

name: guard-optional-qtwebengine-imports-for-pylint
negative_constraints: 不要用文件级或模块顶部的 `# pylint: disable` 一次覆盖整个文件，这样会掩盖其他真实的 import 错误。
不要漏写结尾的 `# pylint: enable=...`。
不要把 import 包进 try/except ImportError，也不要改成运行时动态导入来绕过 lint，这会改变模块加载语义。
不要省略 useless-suppression，否则在有 QtWebEngine 的环境里 lint 会失败。
不要去改 .pylintrc 的全局配置，也不要为了这个问题新增 ignored-modules。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/webengine/ 下所有 `from PyQt5.QtWebEngine* import ...` 语句。可以用 grep 'QtWebEngine' 查找，避免漏掉某个文件。

复用仓库已有的 pylint 抑制写法：只在 import 行的上一行加 `# pylint: disable=no-name-in-module,import-error,useless-suppression`，在下一行加对应的 `# pylint: enable=no-name-in-module,import-error,useless-suppression`，让抑制只作用于这一条可选模块的 import。
保留 useless-suppression，原因是：在装了 QtWebEngine 的环境里这两条告警不会出现，不加它反而会报 useless-suppression。这样两种环境下 lint 都能通过。
PyQt5.QtCore、QtGui、QtWidgets 这类必装模块的 import 保持原样，不加抑制。
检查改动只涉及注释，没有改动 import 语义，也没有改动类和函数的行为。
validation: 在没有安装 QtWebEngine 的环境里运行 pylint（如 tox -e pylint），确认 webengine 模块不再报 no-name-in-module 或 import-error。
在安装了 QtWebEngine 的环境里运行 pylint，确认没有 useless-suppression 告警。
grep 确认 webengine 目录下每一处 QtWebEngine import 都有成对的 disable/enable 注释。
运行现有测试，确认没有行为变化。

name: guard-optional-qtwebengine-module-in-version-reporting
negative_constraints: Do not raise or log an error when the module is None. Version output must degrade gracefully, using the 'unavailable' sentinel string.
Do not put the None check after webenginesettings.parsed_user_agent is accessed. That path still raises AttributeError.
Do not try to import QtWebEngine inside the function, and do not make it a hard dependency.
Do not change the return type to Optional[str]. Callers format the result as a string.
Do not change the existing behaviour of preferring the saved user agent when the module is available.
procedure: In qutebrowser/utils/version.py, find the module-level optional import of webenginesettings. It is set to None when QtWebEngine cannot be imported.
Find every function that dereferences webenginesettings, such as _chromium_version, which uses parsed_user_agent and init_user_agent().
Put an early guard at the top of the function body, before any attribute access: `if webenginesettings is None: return 'unavailable'`.
Add `# type: ignore` to that return only if mypy flags the guarded branch as unreachable. Do not change the function signature.
Leave the existing logic after the guard unchanged. That includes the lazy init_user_agent() call and the assert on parsed_user_agent.
Add a unit test in tests/unit/utils/test_version.py. It should call monkeypatch.setattr(version, 'webenginesettings', None) and assert that _chromium_version() == 'unavailable'.
Clean up the existing positive test while you are there. If it wraps the call in a caplog context that asserts nothing, remove the wrapper and assert the version directly.
validation: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py -k chromium_version
Run the full tests/unit/utils/test_version.py.
Run mypy on qutebrowser/utils/version.py and confirm the guard does not introduce new type errors.

name: guard-predicted-navigation-url-validity
negative_constraints: Do not filter invalid URLs silently inside the slot with an early return. Guard at the emit site and assert in the slot.
Do not change reload behavior: an invalid URL must still go through the reload action. Only the signal is skipped.
Do not change only one of the WebEngine/WebKit backends.
procedure: Locate every `predicted_navigation.emit(...)` call site in both backends: `WebEngineTab` and `WebKitTab`, including `reload` and `load_url`/openurl. Find them with grep `predicted_navigation.emit`.

At each emit site where the URL can be empty, wrap the emit in `if url.isValid():`. A typical case is `reload`, where `self.url()` is still an empty QUrl on a new tab. Only skip the emit. Keep the rest of the reload logic, such as choosing `ReloadAndBypassCache` and triggering the action, as it is.
Make the change symmetrically in webengine and webkit. Do not fix just one backend.
At the start of the slot `_on_predicted_navigation`, add `qtutils.ensure_valid(url)` so the receiver asserts the contract and an invalid URL fails immediately.
Check the other slots connected to `predicted_navigation`, such as those in browsertab/tabbedbrowser, and confirm they also assume a valid URL.

trigger.task_type: Don't emit predicted_navigation with invalid URLs

validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/browser`, and the webengine/webkit tab-related tests if they exist.
Add or run a test that calls `reload()` on an empty tab (url = QUrl()). It must not raise `QtValueError` and must not emit `predicted_navigation`.
Run `pytest tests/end2end -k reload` to confirm that reload with per-domain settings still behaves normally.

name: guard-tab-commands-against-tabs-are-windows
negative_constraints: 不要把守卫放到 _resolve_buffer_index 或其它共享辅助函数里。那些函数还有别的命令在用, 会连带改变它们的行为。
不要在守卫之前执行任何会修改 tabbed_browser 状态的代码。
不要靠静默 return 或日志来拒绝执行。用户必须通过 CommandError 收到明确的错误反馈。
不要硬编码读取 config 字典。统一用 config.val.tabs.tabs_are_windows 访问配置。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/commands.py 中 CommandDispatcher 里对应的 @cmdutils.register 命令方法 (如 tab_take), 先通读 docstring 和参数说明。
在方法体最开头、docstring 之后, 增加对 config.val.tabs.tabs_are_windows 的检查。必须放在 _resolve_buffer_index 及任何创建或移动 tab 的副作用之前。
检查命中时, 复用现有错误通道 raise cmdutils.CommandError("Can't take tabs when using windows as tabs")。不要用 message.error 后再 return。
对照同文件中已有的同类守卫 (如 tab_give / tab_detach 里对 tabs_are_windows 或单 tab 情形的检查), 让错误文案风格和检查位置保持一致。
如果仓库有 tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature 或 tests/unit/browser 下的相应测试, 增加一个场景: 设置 tabs.tabs_are_windows 为 true, 执行 :tab-take, 断言输出该错误消息。

trigger.task_type: Prevent a tab-moving command (e.g. `:tab-take`, `:tab-give`) from running when tabs.tabs_are_windows is enabled

validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/browser 及 tabs 相关的 end2end 测试 (tests/end2end/features/test_tabs_bdd.py)。
手动验证: 执行 :set tabs.tabs_are_windows true 后再执行 :tab-take 0/1, 应显示错误且不新开或移动任何窗口和 tab。
手动验证: tabs_are_windows 为 false 时, :tab-take 行为不变。

name: guard-zero-tabs-in-tab-navigation-commands
negative_constraints: 不要把 guard 放在 newidx 计算之后，必须在任何读取当前索引之前就短路返回。
不要修改 _current_index()/_count() 或 TabbedBrowser 的全局行为来掩盖问题，修复应局限在命令入口。
不要在 0 tab 时改为抛出 cmdexc.CommandError 或弹消息，这会对正常的关闭流程产生噪音。
不要改动 count 参数语义和 wrap 逻辑（tabs->wrap 配置），在非零 tab 的情况下原有行为必须保持不变。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/browser/commands.py 的 CommandDispatcher 中找到崩溃的 tab 导航命令方法，例如 tab_prev 和 tab_next，以及同类的 tab_focus。
确认崩溃路径：最后一个 tab 关闭后，窗口仍可能存活，命令仍会被分派。此时 self._current_index() 返回 -1 或无效值，self._count() 返回 0，后续的索引计算和取模运算会出错。
复用 CommandDispatcher 已有的 self._count() 辅助方法。在方法体最开头、docstring 之后、任何 self._current_index() 计算之前，加入 `if self._count() == 0: return`。
在 guard 旁加注释，说明触发场景（命令在最后一个 tab 关闭后执行）并附上 issue 链接，与现有风格保持一致。
逐个审查同族命令（tab-prev、tab-next、tab-focus、tab-move 等）中依赖 _current_index()/_count() 做算术或取模的路径，对每个存在同样问题的入口分别加 guard，不要只修报告中的那一个。
保持静默返回，也就是 no-op。不要抛出 CommandError：0 tab 是关闭过程中的过渡状态，并非用户错误。
validation: 运行现有测试：tox / pytest tests/ 中与 commands、tabbed browser 相关的用例。
手动或用 BDD 测试复现：配置 last-close 为非 close 的值（如 blank 之外会留下空窗口的配置），关闭所有 tab 后执行 :tab-prev、:tab-next、:tab-focus，确认不崩溃。
回归检查：存在多个 tab 时 :tab-prev/:tab-next 的 count 和 wrap 行为与修复前一致。

name: keep-version-reporting-side-effect-free-of-sql-lifecycle
negative_constraints: Do not call sql.init or sql.close inside a reporting or query function such as version.version(). That function runs while the application is live, and doing so replaces or closes the global database connection.
Do not open the real on-disk history database just for --version. Use the in-memory '' path.
Do not fix only the CLI path and leave the init/close in version.py. The runtime qute://version path would still break history.
procedure: Locate the SQL calls in qutebrowser/utils/version.py's version(). It is not only used by the --version CLI path. qute://version and crash reports call it at runtime too. If it calls sql.init('') / sql.close() itself, it will replace and close the application's already-open history database.

Remove the sql.init('') and sql.close() calls from version(). Keep only the read-only query `lines += ['sqlite: {}'.format(sql.version())]`, which assumes SQL has already been initialized by the caller.

Move the initialization to the early-exit path in qutebrowser/app.py run(). In the `if args.version:` branch, after standarddir.init(args) and before print(version.version()), add sql.init(''). An in-memory database is enough there because only the version is queried, and the process exits immediately.
Make sure app.py already imports sql. Add the import if it does not.

Update the unit tests. Add the existing init_sql fixture to the parameters of tests that call version.version(), such as test_version_output, so the tests reflect the new precondition: callers initialize SQL first.
validation: Run pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py and confirm that test_version_output passes with init_sql.
Manually run `python -m qutebrowser --version`. It should print the sqlite version and exit normally.
Open qute://version in a running qutebrowser, then confirm that history recording and querying (qute://history, :open completion) still work without a closed-database error.

name: keyparser-count-ascii-digits-only
negative_constraints: 不要用 str.isdigit()/isnumeric()/isdecimal() 判断按键是否为 count 数字, 它们都接受 Unicode 数字。
不要为 '²' 单独写特例; 应把条件收紧为 ASCII 白名单。
不要删除 `assert len(txt) == 1` 来掩盖问题, 应在入口处过滤非 ASCII 数字。
不要改变现有行为: 无 count 时 '0' 不作为 count, supports_count=False 时不解析 count。
procedure: 定位 BaseKeyParser._match_count 中把按键文本判定为 count 的条件。
认识根因: str.isdigit() 对 Unicode 数字 (如 '²', '³', 全角数字) 也返回 True。这些字符会进入 count 分支, 之后 int() 转换或长度 assert 会失败, 或累积出错误的 count。
把判定改为 `txt in string.digits`, 只接受 ASCII 0-9; 在文件顶部 import string。保留 supports_count 检查和 '前导 0 不作为 count' 的逻辑。
全局搜索 keyinput 及其它解析按键/count 的地方 (grep 'isdigit()'), 对用户输入的按键文本同样换成 ASCII 判定。
在 tests/unit/keyinput/test_basekeyparser.py 的 TestCount 中新增回归测试: 用 handle_text(Qt.Key_twosuperior, Qt.Key_B, Qt.Key_A) 喂入非 ASCII 数字键, 断言不抛异常; 测试注释里引用 issue 号。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_basekeyparser.py。
确认新增的上标测试在修复前失败 (抛异常), 修复后通过。
确认现有 TestCount 用例 (多位 count、count 后接命令、keystring_updated 信号) 仍然通过。

name: keysequence-complete-rich-comparisons
negative_constraints: 不要改用 functools.total_ordering 替换已有的显式方法。现有风格是逐个显式定义,而且 total_ordering 会改变性能和语义。
不要在新方法里加 isinstance 检查或返回 NotImplemented,除非已有的 __lt__/__gt__ 也这么做。四个方法的行为要一致。
不要用 str(self) 或 Key 列表重新实现比较逻辑,一律委托给 _sequences。
不要漏掉 pylint 的 disable 注释,否则 lint 会失败。
不要改动 __eq__/__ne__/__hash__ 的现有实现。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py 里找到 class KeySequence 和已有的比较方法 __lt__/__gt__/__eq__/__ne__。
复用已有写法: 每个方法直接委托给 self._sequences 与 other._sequences 的同名比较运算。这两个字段是 list 的比较语义。
新方法 __le__ 返回 self._sequences <= other._sequences,__ge__ 返回 self._sequences >= other._sequences。
新方法放在 __gt__ 之后、__eq__ 之前,和现有方法排在一起。
每个新方法体首行加 '# pylint: disable=protected-access',与相邻方法一致,因为它们都访问了 other._sequences。
检查 __hash__ 是否仍基于 _sequences 存在,不能因为改动比较方法而丢失可哈希性。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py。
用 KeySequence.parse 构造的序列验证 <= 和 >= 的结果与 <、> 和 == 的组合一致,例如 a<=b 等价于 a<b or a==b。
如果已有的参数化比较测试只覆盖 < 和 >,就给它补上 <= 和 >= 的用例。
运行 pylint 和 flake8,确认 keyutils.py 没有 protected-access 警告。

name: keysequence-getitem-slice-vs-index
negative_constraints: Do not return a KeySequence for an integer index; a single item must be a KeyInfo.
Do not change the return type of slices. Slices must still be KeySequence instances so existing prefix-matching logic keeps working.
Do not build a KeySequence from KeyInfo objects in the integer branch. The constructor takes raw key ints from _iter_keys, so mixing in KeyInfo objects is a type error.
Do not add hand-written bounds checks or custom exceptions; let list indexing handle them.
procedure: Locate KeySequence.__getitem__ in qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py. Find where the current implementation wraps the result of keys[item] in self.__class__(*...) regardless of the argument type.
Split the branches with isinstance(item, slice).
Slice branch: keep the existing behaviour. Build the list with list(self._iter_keys()), slice it, and return self.__class__(*keys[item]). The result must still be a KeySequence.

Integer index branch: build the list from the public iteration protocol with list(self). That yields KeyInfo objects as defined by __iter__. Return infos[item] directly so callers get a single KeyInfo, not a KeySequence of length 1.
Leave raising IndexError/TypeError to the native list indexing. Negative indices then behave the same as on a Python list.
Check that callers which index a single key, such as seq[0] or seq[-1], expect KeyInfo. Check that callers which slice, such as seq[:-1], expect KeySequence. Update both kinds of call site.

trigger.task_type: Fix getting individual items from KeySequence

validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py
Add or verify a test that KeySequence.parse('ab')[0] is a KeyInfo whose key matches Qt.Key_A.
Add or verify a test that KeySequence.parse('abc')[1:] == KeySequence.parse('bc') and that the slice is still a KeySequence.
Add or verify tests for a negative index and for an out-of-range index raising IndexError.
Run the keyinput/basekeyparser tests to make sure prefix matching still works.

name: keysequence-validate-key-range-assert
negative_constraints: 不要把区间断言改成 raise KeyParseError。越界 key 是编程错误,不是用户输入错误,改成可捕获的解析错误会掩盖 bug。
不要把上界写成 `< Qt.Key_unknown`。那样 Key_unknown 会先命中断言,原有的 KeyParseError 用户提示路径就失效了。
不要删除或重排原有的 Key_unknown 检查。
不要在断言中省略 info.key 消息参数。
不要为了让断言通过而在 _validate 内部对 key 做掩码或截断。修正应该放在调用方的构造逻辑里。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/keyinput/keyutils.py 中的 KeySequence._validate(self, keystr=None)。它遍历 `for info in self`,对每个 KeyInfo 做校验。
在循环体的第一行、`info.key == Qt.Key_unknown` 检查之前,增加区间断言: `assert Qt.Key_Space <= info.key <= Qt.Key_unknown, info.key`。消息参数要带上 info.key,这样断言失败时能直接看到越界的整数值。
保留原有的 `if info.key == Qt.Key_unknown: raise KeyParseError(keystr, "Got unknown key!")` 分支不变。区间上界取 Key_unknown(闭区间),所以 unknown 会通过断言,继续由 KeyParseError 按用户可见错误处理。
区分两类问题: 用户输入解析出来的 unknown key 属于可恢复的用户错误,用 KeyParseError 处理;key 值低于 Qt.Key_Space 或高于 Qt.Key_unknown 属于程序内部不变量被破坏,用 assert 暴露。

name: macos-ctrl-meta-swap-in-keysequence
negative_constraints: 不要在配置/绑定解析层(KeySequence.parse、字符串 <Ctrl+x>)做交换,只对真实键盘事件的 modifiers 做交换,否则用户配置的语义会被反转。
不要在 Ctrl 与 Meta 同时按下时交换或丢弃任何一个。
不要无条件交换。必须用 utils.is_mac 限定,非 mac 平台的行为要保持不变。
不要让新增或修改的测试依赖 Ctrl 的平台语义。与交换无关的修饰键测试改用 Alt。
不要省略 Qt bug 引用注释,这个 workaround 需要可追溯、可移除。

实现对称交换,分三种情况:Ctrl 和 Meta 同时按下时保持不变;只有 Ctrl 时清除 ControlModifier 并加上 MetaModifier;只有 Meta 时反过来。位运算用 `&= ~X` 加 `|= Y`。

name: map-qutebrowser-setting-to-qtwebengine-chromium-flag
negative_constraints: 不要把 flag 加在 QtWebEngine 分支之外。QtWebKit 后端不能收到 Chromium 参数。
不要用 dict.get 之类的写法静默忽略未知枚举值。必须以 raise utils.Unreachable 结尾。
不要只加新测试而不更新 autouse fixture。否则那些对完整 argv 做精确比较的已有 TestQtArgs 用例会失败。
不要在 'always' 这类默认值下也追加 flag，否则会改变默认行为。
不要试图在运行时通过 QWebEngineProfile 动态修改这类只能在启动时生效的 Chromium 开关。它们属于 qt_args 启动参数路径。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/config/configinit.py 中的 qt_args(namespace)。找到 QtWebEngine 专属分支，即 low-end-device-mode 等 flag 被追加到 argv 的那段代码。
在该分支内、`return argv` 之前读取设置值，用 config.val.<option.path> 读取，例如 config.val.content.headers.referer。
把每个合法的枚举值显式映射为 argv.append('--chromium-flag')。默认或无操作的值用 `pass` 分支显式列出，例如 'always' 不加任何参数，'never' 加 '--no-referrers'，'same-domain' 加 '--reduced-referrer-granularity'。
在末尾加 `else: raise utils.Unreachable("Unknown <option> {}".format(value))`。这样以后 configdata.yml 新增枚举值却忘了映射时会立刻报错，沿用 low_end_device_mode 已有的写法。
检查 configdata.yml 中该选项的 backends/valid_values 声明，确认 Python 分支覆盖了全部 valid_values。如果该选项原先标为 QtWebKit-only，要相应更新 backend 声明。

更新 tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py 里 TestQtArgs 的 autouse fixture（本 PR 中把 patch_version_check 改名为 reduce_args），把新设置固定为无参数的默认值，例如 config_stub.val.content.headers.referer = 'always'。这样已有的精确 argv 断言测试不会被多出来的 flag 打破。同时更新 fixture 的 docstring。

新增参数化测试，例如 test_referer，形如 (value, expected_arg)。测试里用 monkeypatch 把 configinit.objects.backend 设为 usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine，再设置 config_stub.val.<option>，执行 parser.parse_args([]) 和 configinit.qt_args(parsed)。无参数的值断言所有相关 flag 都不在 argv 中，其余值断言对应的 flag 在 argv 中。

name: mhtml-css-detection-by-mime-or-extension
negative_constraints: 不要删除原有的 MIME 判断。扩展名只能作为补充条件,不能替代 MIME。
不要用 `url.toString().endswith('.css')` 或对 path 做手工字符串切分。这类写法会被 query/fragment 干扰,应使用 QUrl.fileName()。
不要在非 CSS 分支对二进制内容做文本解码,扩展名判断只用于把资源路由进 CSS 分支。
不要改动 CSS 分支的解码容错策略(errors='ignore'),也不要顺手重构下载流程。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/mhtml.py 中 _Downloader 的下载完成处理逻辑。它先读取响应头的 Content-Type,把 mime 按 iso-8859-1 解码,然后用 `mime.lower() == 'text/css'` 判断是否走 CSS 分支。CSS 分支会把内容以 utf-8/errors='ignore' 解码,并递归解析 url()/@import 引用。
把这个判断从只看 MIME 改为 MIME 或 URL 扩展名任一命中即可:`mime.lower() == 'text/css' or url.fileName().endswith('.css')`。这样可以覆盖服务器返回错误或缺失 Content-Type(例如 text/plain、application/octet-stream、空值)但实际是样式表的情况。
复用已有的 QUrl 对象 `url` 及其 fileName() 方法取路径的最后一段。fileName() 不含 query 和 fragment,所以 `style.css?v=1` 也能被识别。
保持 CSS 分支内部逻辑不变:解码方式、_get_css_imports 的调用、对引用资源的 fetch 与 URL 处理都照原样,只放宽进入分支的条件。
如需补测试,在 tests/unit/browser/test_mhtml.py 或相关测试中构造 Content-Type 不是 text/css、但 URL 以 .css 结尾的资源,断言其中的 url()/@import 引用会被继续抓取。
