确认 Content-Type 为 text/css 但无 .css 扩展名的资源仍按 CSS 处理(回归检查)。
确认非 .css 且非 text/css 的资源(如图片)不进入 CSS 解析分支。

name: migrate-qt-project-links-to-qt-io
negative_constraints: Do not blindly sed `qt-project.org` to `qt.io`. The subdomains map differently: doc.qt.io vs bugreports.qt.io, and a forum link is removed rather than rewritten.
Do not change QTBUG issue numbers, anchors (#fragment) or page filenames.
Do not break multi-line string concatenation or asciidoc `url[text]` syntax in configdata descriptions.
Do not delete the code comment that explains a workaround just because its link is dead. Drop only the dead URL line.
Do not modify functional code or tests as part of a link migration.
procedure: Locate every occurrence with a repo-wide search such as `git grep -n 'qt-project.org'`. Cover the qutebrowser/ package and scripts/. Do not limit the search to one module, because the links live in comments, docstrings, user-visible config description strings and helper scripts.

Classify each hit by host and apply the matching mapping:
- bugreports.qt-project.org/browse/QTBUG-N becomes bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-N. Keep the issue key unchanged.
- qt-project.org/doc/qt-5/<page> becomes doc.qt.io/qt-5/<page>.
- qt-project.org/doc/qt-4.8/<page> becomes doc.qt.io/qt-5/<page>. Upgrade the version only when the project targets Qt5 and the page exists there, for example stylesheet-reference.html#list-of-property-types.

Handle hosts that have no reliable qt.io equivalent. For qt-project.org/forums/viewthread/..., which was dropped after the forum migration, remove the reference line. Keep the explanatory comment that justifies the code.
Leave codereview.qt-project.org links unchanged unless a verified new host exists. The evidence keeps them as-is.

In configdata.py, some URLs are split across adjacent string literals, such as "...http://doc.qt.io/qt-5/" "stylesheet-reference.html#...[the Qt documentation]". Edit only the host/path fragment so the concatenation and the asciidoc link syntax stay intact.
Rewrite the URL text only. Do not touch the surrounding code logic, the WORKAROUND markers or the docstring structure.

trigger.task_type: Change Qt links to point to qt.io.

validation: Run `git grep -n 'qt-project.org'`. The only remaining hits should be intentional ones, such as codereview.qt-project.org.
Run the existing test suite plus flake8/pylint to confirm no syntax or line-length regressions (long URLs in comments).
Regenerate or check the docs derived from configdata (e.g. the asciidoc settings doc) to confirm the gradient documentation link renders correctly.
Spot-check a few rewritten URLs (doc.qt.io/qt-5/..., bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-...) to confirm they resolve.

name: modeman-shift-modifier-not-non-alnum
negative_constraints: Don't change `is_non_alnum` to `event.modifiers() != Qt.NoModifier` or keep `bool(modifiers)`. That still treats Shift as non-alnum and leaks uppercase letters to the page.
Don't drop all modifier checks. Ctrl, Alt and Meta combinations must still pass through in auto mode.
Don't touch the `is_tab` or focus-widget logic, or the forward-unbound-keys 'all'/'none' branches. The fix only concerns how Shift is classified.
Don't create a real QKeyEvent in the test. Use the autospec mock factory and supply `type()` so the event goes through the keypress path.
procedure: Locate the `is_non_alnum` computation in `ModeManager._eventFilter_keypress` in `qutebrowser/keyinput/modeman.py`. It decides whether an unhandled key is forwarded to the web page under `input.forward-unbound-keys=auto`.

Replace the plain truthiness test `bool(event.modifiers())` with a whitelist check: `event.modifiers() not in (Qt.NoModifier, Qt.ShiftModifier)`. Shift on its own only produces a printable character such as 'A', so treat it like no modifier. Combinations that include Ctrl, Alt or Meta still count as non-alnum.
Keep the existing `or not event.text().strip()` branch unchanged. Keys with empty or whitespace text, such as arrow keys, must still be treated as non-alnum and passed through.

Extend `fake_keyevent_factory` in `tests/conftest.py` with an optional `typ=QEvent.KeyPress` parameter and set `evtmock.type.return_value`. This lets `ModeManager.eventFilter` route the mock event as a keypress. Add `from PyQt5.QtCore import QEvent` at the top of conftest.

Add a parametrized test in `tests/unit/keyinput/test_modeman.py`. Use a `FakeKeyparser` whose `handle()` returns False and `passthrough=False`, registered for `KeyMode.normal`. Set `config_stub.data = {'input': {'forward-unbound-keys': 'auto'}}`. Assert `eventFilter(evt)` for each case: 'a' with no modifier is filtered (True); Key_Up with empty text is not filtered (False); Shift+A giving 'A' is filtered (True, with a reference to issue #1207); Shift+Ctrl is not filtered (False).
validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_modeman.py`. All four parametrized cases should pass, and the Shift+A case should fail if the fix is reverted.
Run `pytest tests/unit/keyinput` to confirm the conftest factory change (the new `typ` kwarg with a default) doesn't break existing users of `fake_keyevent_factory`.
Manual check: in normal mode with `forward-unbound-keys=auto`, pressing an unbound Shift+letter should not type into the page, and Ctrl+key should still be forwarded.

name: move-shared-helper-to-lower-layer-to-break-import-cycle
negative_constraints: Do not change the prompt wording, the title, or default=False. The refactor must not change behavior.
Do not reverse the roles so that commands.py is imported by mainwindow; layering has to be browser/commands -> mainwindow, one way.
Do not keep the staticmethod in CommandDispatcher as a compatibility shim. It would keep a duplicate path to the same logic.
Do not inline the confirm logic at each call site. tab_close, tab_only and the tab bar close all share one helper.
Do not change the yes_action callback semantics. tab_only re-invokes itself with force=True, and that recursion must be kept.
procedure: Locate a helper that the lower-layer module (mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py) reaches through an import of the higher-layer module. Here it is the CommandDispatcher.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned @staticmethod, called from TabbedBrowser via `from qutebrowser.browser.commands import CommandDispatcher`.

Move the helper into the owning lower-layer class (TabbedBrowser) as an instance method `def tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(self, tab, force, yes_action)`. Keep the signature order, the docstring and the behavior unchanged: if `tab.data.pinned and not force`, call message.confirm_async(title='Pinned Tab', text=..., yes_action=yes_action, default=False); otherwise call yes_action() directly.
Confirm the target module already imports what the helper uses (message is already imported in tabbedbrowser.py). Do not add a new upward dependency.
Delete the original @staticmethod from CommandDispatcher. Do not leave a forwarding alias.
Update every call site in commands.py, including tab_close and the pinned-tab check in tab_only, to `self._tabbed_browser.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(tab, force, action)`.
Update the internal call site in TabbedBrowser (the tab-close handler that gets the tab by idx) to `self.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(tab, False, lambda: self.close_tab(tab))`.
Remove the now-unused `from qutebrowser.browser.commands import CommandDispatcher` import from tabbedbrowser.py.
grep the whole repository, including tests, for `CommandDispatcher.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned` and `tab_close_prompt_if_pinned` to make sure no reference is left behind.
validation: python -c 'import qutebrowser.mainwindow.tabbedbrowser' should succeed without importing browser.commands, which shows the cycle is gone.
grep -rn 'CommandDispatcher.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned' qutebrowser tests should return nothing.
Run the existing tests, e.g. pytest tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature and the unit tests, focusing on the pinned-tab scenarios for tab-close, tab-only and tab-close via middle-click/close button.
Run pylint/flake8 to confirm the unused import has been removed and there are no new warnings.

name: mypy-ignore-pyqt-signal-emit-in-lambda
negative_constraints: Do not replace `lambda: self.sig.emit()` with a direct `self.sig.emit` reference. The code comment documents a segfault when the lambdas are removed.
Do not use a file-wide `# type: ignore` or a module-level mypy disable. Ignore only the specific emit lines.
Do not put `# type: ignore` on the `QTimer.singleShot(` line when the emit is on another line, because mypy will not suppress the error there.
Do not add casts or a stub file just to silence these signal-attribute errors in this commit.
Do not remove the existing pylint disable comment.
procedure: Run mypy on the module first. Find each error that points at `QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self.<signal>.emit(...))`. The PyQt stubs do not type signal attributes like `finished`, `readyRead`, `metaDataChanged` and `error` on QNetworkReply as bound signals that have `.emit`.
Keep each lambda. The existing comment says removing them causes a segfault. Also keep the `# pylint: disable=unnecessary-lambda` line.

Split each call across two lines: put `QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda:` on the first line. Put the indented `self.<signal>.emit(...))  # type: ignore` on the continuation line, aligned under the opening parenthesis.
Put `# type: ignore` on the physical line that contains the `.emit` attribute access. Mypy reports the error on that line, and the split keeps the line under the flake8/pylint length limit.
Apply the same pattern to every fake reply class in the file: FixedDataNetworkReply, ErrorNetworkReply and RedirectNetworkReply. Include signals that pass arguments, such as `self.error.emit(error)`.
Change only these lines. Do not change signal ordering, setError, setOpenMode, setAttribute or abort semantics.

validation: Run mypy for the repository (for example `tox -e mypy`) and confirm networkreply.py reports no errors and no 'unused type: ignore' warnings if warn_unused_ignores is enabled.
Run flake8 and pylint on the file (`tox -e flake8,pylint` or equivalent) to check line length, continuation indentation and the preserved pylint disable.
Run the existing unit tests: `pytest tests/unit/browser/webkit/network/test_networkreply.py`. They confirm the fake replies still emit metaDataChanged, readyRead, error and finished asynchronously.

name: mypy-silence-pyqt-signal-connect-false-positives
negative_constraints: Do not change any slot, signal or connection target. Do not replace `functools.partial` arguments. Do not add `cast()` or wrapper functions, because that changes runtime behavior.
Do not add an ignore to a whole file or class, such as `# mypy: ignore-errors`, and do not loosen settings in mypy.ini globally. Fix only the affected lines.
Do not put `# type: ignore` on the argument line of a multi-line call. mypy reports the error on the line where the expression starts, so an ignore there has no effect.
Do not add ignores to lines mypy does not report, such as connects of custom pyqtSignals (e.g. `self.reloading.connect`). This avoids unused-ignore warnings.
Pure typing-annotation fixes do not need a changelog entry or new tests.
procedure: Run mypy against the target module, e.g. `tox -e mypy` or `mypy qutebrowser/browser/webkit/webpage.py`. Collect every new error.

Check whether the errors sit on Qt built-in signal `.connect(...)` calls, such as QWebPage.printRequested, downloadRequested, unsupportedContent, loadStarted, loadFinished, frameCreated, featurePermissionRequested, featurePermissionRequestCanceled, saveFrameStateRequested and restoreFrameStateRequested.
Treat these errors as false positives from incomplete PyQt stubs. The stubs declare the signal as a method, so mypy cannot see `.connect`. Do not change the runtime logic to work around them.

Add a bare `# type: ignore` to the physical line mypy reports. For a call that spans several lines, put the comment on the first line, right after `connect(`, e.g. `self.printRequested.connect(  # type: ignore`, and move the argument to the next line.

If adding the comment would push a single-line call past the line-length limit, use the same split. Keep `self.loadStarted.connect(self.on_load_started)  # type: ignore` on one line only if it still fits within the limit.

Also check signal connects that appear later in the module inside conditional branches, such as `featurePermissionRequestCanceled.connect(functools.partial(...))` in `_on_feature_permission_requested`. Ignore each one individually.
Run mypy again and confirm the module has no new errors. Make sure no unused-ignore warning appears. If `warn_unused_ignores` is enabled, remove any redundant ignore.

name: narrow-qt-sqlite-error-workaround-by-bug-signature
negative_constraints: Do not match the workaround on `database_text` alone. A bare 'out of memory' with an UNKNOWN code from another context must still raise SqlBugError.
Do not add UNKNOWN (-1) to `environmental_errors`. That would hide real bugs.
Do not remove the debug logging of type, database text, driver text and error code. It is needed to diagnose future misclassifications.
Do not leave placeholder values like 'driver text' in the test's QSqlError. The test must reproduce the exact Qt error signature that the workaround matches.
Do not write a workaround comment without the upstream bug URL.
procedure: Locate `raise_sqlite_error` in qutebrowser/misc/sql.py. It sorts a QSqlError into SqlEnvironmentError (user environment issue) or SqlBugError (qutebrowser bug).
Read `error.driverText()` and `error.databaseText()` once into local variables. Reuse those variables in both the debug logging and the classification logic, instead of calling the accessors again.
Keep the existing `environmental_errors` list of SqliteErrorCode values unchanged. It is the main classification path.

Replace generic string allow-lists such as `environmental_strings` with a named boolean for the specific Qt bug, for example `qtbug_70506`. The boolean must require all three conditions together: `error_code == SqliteErrorCode.UNKNOWN`, `driver_text == 'Error opening database'`, and `database_text == 'out of memory'`.

Add a `# WORKAROUND for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-70506` comment above that boolean. The comment should say the real error is unknown and is assumed to be environmental, such as an unreadable database file.
Simplify the condition to `if error_code in environmental_errors or qtbug_70506:` so it raises SqlEnvironmentError, and leave the else branch raising SqlBugError.

In tests/unit/misc/test_sql.py, rename the matching test after the bug (`test_qtbug_70506`). Give it a docstring linking the Qt bug, and build the QSqlError with the real signature: driver text 'Error opening database', database text 'out of memory', `QSqlError.UnknownError`, and `SqliteErrorCode.UNKNOWN`. Assert that SqlEnvironmentError is raised.

Check that the parametrized error-code tests still map each environmental code to SqlEnvironmentError and other codes to SqlBugError.

name: normalize-index-before-tab-focus-last-comparison
negative_constraints: Do not compare a raw (possibly negative) index against _current_index(); normalize it to a 1-based positive index first.
Do not move the 'last'/None string or None branches below the integer normalization, because that would cause type errors.
Do not change show_error=False on the implicit tab_focus_last call; with no previous tab it should silently do nothing.
Do not mix 0-based and 1-based indexes; the user index is 1-based, so compare with _current_index() + 1.
procedure: Locate CommandDispatcher.tab_focus in qutebrowser/browser/commands.py. Read the branch order for the index argument. The special cases are 'last', None, and negative indexes. Note that the user-facing index is 1-based and _current_index() is 0-based.

Find every comparison of the raw user-supplied index against the current tab, such as index == self._current_index() + 1. Check whether each one runs before negative-index normalization (index = self._count() + index + 1).
Leave the string/None special cases ('last' → _tab_focus_last(), None → tab_next()) where they are, before normalization. Comparing them to integers or doing arithmetic on them would fail.

Move the 'already on this tab → switch to last tab' check to just after the negative-index normalization: if not no_last and index == self._current_index() + 1: self._tab_focus_last(show_error=False); return. This makes :tab-focus -1 on the last tab behave the same as :tab-focus N on the current tab.
Keep the bounds check (1 <= index <= self._count()) and the out-of-range error path after the tab_focus_last check. The normalized index flows through unchanged.

Add or extend tests in tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature or the unit tests. Cover :tab-focus -1 while already on the last tab, which should go to the previously focused tab. name: optional-qt-module-import-in-version-report
negative_constraints: Do not remove the module-level name or move the import inside `version()`. The tests patch the attribute on the `version` module.
Do not let an ImportError from the optional Qt module escape at import time of qutebrowser.utils.version.
Do not drop the Webkit line when the module is missing. Print a sentinel value ('no') so bug reports still show the state.
Do not reorder the other lines in the version output. The test compares the full text exactly.
Do not catch a broad Exception around the import. Catch only ImportError.
Do not keep `assert ua is not None`. It crashes :version or crash reports when profiles are not initialized.
Do not always query QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile(). Prefer the saved default_user_agent, because the profile UA may already be customized by config.
Do not import QWebEngineProfile unconditionally. The module must still import with QtWebKit-only or without QtWebEngine.
Do not forget to patch the new module-level name in test_version_output. Otherwise the expected backend string breaks.
Do not initialize profiles inside _chromium_version(). That causes side effects in a read-only info function.
Do not rely on the real Qt module being importable in output-format tests. Patch the module-level name instead.
Do not patch the PyQt5 module itself. Patch the name as bound in qutebrowser.utils.version.
Do not patch sys.modules globally, because that can leak into other tests.
Do not leave a caplog context in place that asserts nothing.
procedure: Locate the hard top-level import of the optional Qt symbol in qutebrowser/utils/version.py, for example `from PyQt5.QtWebKit import qWebKitVersion`.
Wrap that import in `try/except ImportError` and bind the name to `None` in the except branch. Keep the module-level name so tests can still monkeypatch `version.qWebKitVersion`.

In `version()`, take the line that calls the optional symbol out of the static `lines += [...]` list. Emit it in an explicit `if symbol is None: lines.append('Webkit: no') else: lines.append('Webkit: {}'.format(symbol()))` block.
Keep the output order exactly the same. pdf.js still comes before Webkit, and Harfbuzz and SSL come after. If you need to, split the static list so the conditional line sits in its original position.

In tests/unit/utils/test_version.py, add a `with_webkit` parameter to `test_version_output`. Use the list form of the parametrize argnames. Append `True` to every existing case and add one `# no webkit` case that ends in `False`.
Patch the symbol with `(lambda: 'WEBKIT VERSION') if with_webkit else None`.
Turn the expected template line into `Webkit: {webkit}` and add `'webkit': 'WEBKIT VERSION' if with_webkit else 'no'` to the substitutions.

Locate the derived-value helper in qutebrowser/utils/version.py, here _chromium_version(). Check whether it relies on module state that is only set after init, such as webenginesettings.default_user_agent. That state may be None when the helper runs early or without profile initialization.

Add an optional import at module top. Copy the existing qWebKitVersion pattern: try: from PyQt5.QtWebEngineWidgets import QWebEngineProfile / except ImportError: # pragma: no cover / QWebEngineProfile = None # type: ignore.
Extend the guard to cover the new optional dependency, e.g. `if webenginesettings is None or QWebEngineProfile is None: return 'unavailable'`.

Replace the hard assert on the saved value with a fallback. Use the saved default_user_agent when it is not None. Otherwise call QWebEngineProfile.defaultProfile().httpUserAgent(). Leave the regex parsing and the error-log path for unmatched UAs unchanged.

Add a unit test to test_version.py: set version.webenginesettings.default_user_agent to a known UA. Monkeypatch version.QWebEngineProfile with a fake whose defaultProfile raises AssertionError. This proves the saved value is preferred and the fallback is not called. Guard the test with pytest.importorskip('PyQt5.QtWebEngineWidgets').

Remove the explicit webenginesettings._init_profiles() call from test_chromium_version_unpatched. The test then covers the fallback path with real QtWebEngine and should not return '', 'unknown' or 'unavailable'.
Add test_default_user_agent_saved to test_webenginesettings.py. It asserts that default_user_agent is populated after profile init, so the preferred path keeps getting state.
In test_version_output, add patches['QWebEngineProfile'] = True next to the FakeWebEngineSettings patch so the new guard does not return 'unavailable' in the faked QtWebEngine backend scenario.
When adding a new module-level optional name to version.py (X = None on ImportError), grep test_version.py for the `patches` dict in test_version_output and for backend-specific branches.
In every branch that simulates the dependency being present, add patches['X'] = <truthy stub or fake>.
For behavior-ordering tests, monkeypatch version.X with a fake whose methods raise AssertionError. This asserts which path is taken without needing real Qt objects.
Find which names the module under test binds for the optional backend, for example version.webenginesettings.
Simulate the missing backend with monkeypatch.setattr(<module>, '<name>', None). Do not uninstall anything or manipulate sys.modules.
Assert the documented fallback value, such as 'unavailable', instead of only asserting that no exception is raised.
Keep the test independent of real QtWebEngine availability, so it does not need importorskip.

name: pdfjs-exempt-own-blob-downloads
negative_constraints: Do not change the signature of `should_use_pdfjs` in only one backend. Both the WebEngine and WebKit callers must be updated, or one backend will raise a TypeError.
Do not exempt all blob: URLs. Only blob URLs whose inner path has the qute scheme are PDF.js self-downloads. Other site blob PDFs should still open in PDF.js.
Do not turn off PDF.js or skip the `content.pdfjs` config check to get downloads working.
Do not try to detect the download button through JavaScript or by editing the vendored pdf.js files. Use the URL-based check on the Python side.
procedure: Locate the PDF.js routing decision: `pdfjs.should_use_pdfjs()` in qutebrowser/browser/pdfjs.py. It decides whether a PDF response is sent to `downloads.PDFJSDownloadTarget` (shown in the viewer) or handled as a normal download.

Find all callers with `grep -rn should_use_pdfjs qutebrowser/`. There is one per backend: WebEngine `DownloadManager.handle_download` in webenginedownloads.py uses `qt_item`, and WebKit `BrowserPage` unsupported-content handling in webpage.py uses `reply`.
Extend the predicate signature to also take the request URL (`should_use_pdfjs(mimetype, url)`). Do not add a separate flag or special-case the callers. Keep the whole decision inside pdfjs.py.

Detect downloads that PDF.js starts itself (its Download button). Their URL is a blob URL wrapping a qute origin, e.g. 'blob:qute%3A///<uuid>'. Check `url.scheme() == 'blob' and QUrl(url.path()).scheme() == 'qute'`.
Return `is_pdf and not is_download_url and config.val.content.pdfjs`. The existing mimetype list ('application/pdf', 'application/x-pdf') and the config check stay as they are.
Update every caller to pass the URL from the backend object it already has: `qt_item.url()` for WebEngine and `reply.url()` for WebKit.

Update the parametrized unit test `test_should_use_pdfjs` to the new signature (pass `QUrl(url)`). Add a case for a PDF on a blob:qute URL with pdfjs enabled that expects False. Keep the existing pdf, x-pdf, non-pdf and disabled cases using a normal http URL.

name: per-url-config-for-request-blocker
negative_constraints: Do not resolve the per-URL setting with the request URL. Doing so would exempt the ad hosts instead of the visited site.

Do not update only one backend. WebEngine (interceptor) and WebKit (networkmanager) must both pass the first-party URL.
Do not crash on an empty or invalid QUrl() first-party URL. Passing it should fall back to the global value.
procedure: In HostBlocker.is_blocked (qutebrowser/browser/adblock.py), add an optional `first_party_url=None` argument. Keep the default so existing callers still work.
Replace the global read `config.val.content.host_blocking.enabled` with `config.instance.get('content.host_blocking.enabled', url=first_party_url)`. This makes a URL-pattern-scoped value take effect.
Resolve the pattern against the first-party page URL, not the request URL. A per-site exemption should apply to the page the user is visiting.
Update the QtWebEngine backend. In RequestInterceptor.interceptRequest, read `info.firstPartyUrl()` and pass it to `is_blocked(url, first_party)`.

Update the QtWebKit backend. In NetworkManager.createRequest, move the host-blocker check below the code that computes `current_url` (the tab URL, with QUrl() as fallback for downloads or closed tabs). Then pass `current_url` to `is_blocked`.
Make sure the setting declares `supports_pattern: true` in configdata.yml if it does not already. Otherwise `config.instance.get(..., url=...)` raises an error or is ignored.

Add tests in tests/unit/browser/test_adblock.py. Set the option to False for a specific pattern with `config_stub.set_obj(..., pattern=urlmatch.UrlPattern(...))`. Assert that requests with a matching first_party_url are not blocked and that non-matching ones still are.

name: platform-specific-ordered-modifier-mapping
negative_constraints: 不要通过给 OrderedDict 已有 key 重新赋值来做平台交换,这不会改变迭代顺序。
不要为了让测试通过而改测试里多修饰键组合的期望字符串。顺序应由实现保证一致。
不要删除 Ctrl/Meta 交换逻辑本身。用户配置依赖 OS X 上按 Cmd 显示为 Ctrl 的行为。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/utils.py 里的 keyevent_to_string 和它的 modmask2str OrderedDict。这个映射同时决定修饰键的显示名和拼接顺序。
判断失败根因:先建默认 OrderedDict,再在 darwin 分支里给已有 key 重新赋值。这样只换了 value,插入顺序没变。结果 Qt.ControlModifier 仍排第一却显示为 'Meta',组合键会输出 'Meta+Alt+Ctrl+Shift+A',而不是规范的 'Ctrl+Alt+Meta+Shift+A'。
改为按 sys.platform 分支,在每个分支里各自完整构建 OrderedDict。darwin 分支的顺序是 (MetaModifier,'Ctrl'), (AltModifier,'Alt'), (ControlModifier,'Meta'), (ShiftModifier,'Shift')。else 分支保持 Control, Alt, Meta, Shift 的原有顺序。
保留 darwin 分支里解释 Qt 在 OS X 上交换 Ctrl/Meta 的注释和链接,包括 issue #110 和 Qt osx-issues 文档。
确认最终输出的显示顺序在所有平台上都是 Ctrl, Alt, Meta, Shift,只是底层 Qt 修饰键和显示名的对应关系随平台变化。

name: port-webkit-config-option-to-qtwebengine
negative_constraints: Don't try to copy the WebKit palette approach (setPalette/QPalette.Base on the view) for QtWebEngine; it has no effect there.
Don't leave the backends restriction in configdata.py after adding the WebEngine implementation, or the option stays unavailable on QtWebEngine.
Don't apply the setting only at construction. It must also be connected to config.changed with change_filter so runtime :set works.
Don't ignore none_ok=True. A None value must fall back to the theme/style color, not crash or pass None to Qt.
Don't change the WebKit behaviour itself; only clean up its stale FIXME text.
If you add a required argument to the WebEnginePage constructor (e.g. theme_color), don't miss any constructor callers; update every one of them.
procedure: In configdata.py, locate the SettingValue for the option. Check whether it is restricted with backends=[usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit].

Find the existing QtWebKit implementation in browser/webkit/webview.py. It is usually a method decorated with @config.change_filter(section, option) that is also called once at init. Read its FIXME:qtwebengine note to see why the WebKit approach does not work on WebEngine.
Look up the QtWebEngine-native API for the behaviour. For background color, palette tweaks on the view have no effect; use QWebEnginePage.setBackgroundColor on the page instead.

In browser/webengine/webview.py, add a WebEnginePage method that mirrors the WebKit one. Decorate it with @config.change_filter('colors', 'webpage.bg'), read config.get(...), and handle the None/none_ok case with a fallback value.

Compute the fallback in WebEngineView.__init__ and pass it into WebEnginePage as a constructor argument, for example theme_color=self.style().standardPalette().color(QPalette.Base). The page does not own the view's style.
In WebEnginePage.__init__, store the fallback, apply the setting once, then connect objreg.get('config').changed to the method so live config changes work. Add any needed imports (QPalette, objreg).
Remove the backends=[usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit] restriction from the SettingValue in configdata.py so the option is valid on both backends.
Remove the stale FIXME:qtwebengine comment or docstring from the WebKit implementation.

name: pragma-no-cover-optional-import-fallback
negative_constraints: Do not change the fallback semantics (keep `= None` and keep downstream `if qWebKitVersion is None` checks intact).
Do not mark the `try:` line, which would exclude the import that does run, and do not put the marker on the import line.
Do not add tests or a changelog entry for a coverage-only pragma.
Do not use the pragma to hide error handling that can be reached in tests. Only use it for environment-dependent ImportError branches.
Do not reformat or reorder the surrounding imports.
Do not delete WORKAROUND/QTBUG reference comments on Qt-bug workaround branches. Only add a pragma to them.
Do not remove a pragma unless the new coverage run confirms that line is covered. Otherwise the coverage check fails.
Do not leave a pragma comment whose stated reason is outdated.
Do not change runtime logic. This task only adjusts coverage annotations and configuration.
不要为了消除未覆盖行而删除 try/except AttributeError；旧/新 Qt 版本仍需要该兼容回退。
不要把 `pragma: no cover` 放在 try 行或函数定义上，否则会排除整个函数或正常路径的覆盖率。
不要用 `hasattr` 重写或 monkeypatch Qt 来人为制造覆盖；本任务只是覆盖率排除，不改行为。
不要给可以通过普通单元测试触发的逻辑分支加 pragma。
不要为这类纯 coverage 注释修改 changelog 或新增测试。
procedure: Locate the module-level `try: from X import Y` / `except ImportError:` block in the target file (here `qutebrowser/utils/version.py`, around the `PyQt5.QtWebKit` import of `qWebKitVersion`).
Confirm that the except branch only handles a missing optional dependency, assigns a sentinel (e.g. `qWebKitVersion = None`), and cannot be reached in the normal test/CI environment.

Put the marker on the `except` line itself, separated by two spaces: `except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover`. coverage.py then excludes the whole except body, so no separate marker is needed on the assignment line.
Leave the try body, the fallback value and the import order unchanged. Keep the diff to a single-line, comment-only change.
If the same file has other optional-import fallbacks that the environment cannot reach, check each one. Add the marker only where the branch is truly unreachable in CI.
Locate the coverage environment definition (tox/CI) and switch it to the new backend and Qt source, i.e. QtWebEngine plus a newer PyQt from PyPI.
Run the tests with coverage enabled in the new environment and collect two lists: newly uncovered lines, and lines that are now covered but still carry '# pragma: no cover'.

Remove the pragmas on lines the new environment covers. Typical cases: workaround branches for old Qt versions (e.g. the history.py url.isValid() check, the TypeError fallback in certificateerror.py), and Qt callbacks that Qt now actually calls (e.g. WrapperLayout.itemAt).
When you remove a pragma, also delete its now-stale explanation comment, such as 'WORKAROUND for this not being covered in old Qt versions' or 'Doesn't get tested on older PyQt'.
Add '# pragma: no cover' to branches that only run on the old backend, e.g. 'if objects.backend == usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit:' in history.init.
Add the pragma to workarounds for Qt bugs that the new Qt version has fixed, and keep their WORKAROUND/QTBUG link comment. Example: the '..' host check in urlutils.safe_display_string.
If a pragma's reason no longer holds but the line is still uncovered, as with the 'tab is None' check in backforward.py, keep the pragma and update or delete the outdated reason comment.
定位 coverage report 中未覆盖的 `except AttributeError:` 分支。确认它包在 `getattr(Qt, 'Key_' + name)` 这类动态属性查找外面。这类查找只会在某些 Qt/PyQt 版本缺少对应常量时失败（如 keyutils._build_special_names 遍历 special_names_str）。
确认该分支是环境/版本相关的防御代码。在 CI 当前使用的 Qt 版本上它不可达，也不是业务逻辑分支。
在 except 行末尾追加 `  # pragma: no cover`，形如 `except AttributeError:  # pragma: no cover`。只标注这一行，coverage.py 会把整个 except 块一起排除。
保持 try/except 结构和 `pass` 主体不变，也不改动循环外的赋值，例如 `_SPECIAL_NAMES[0x0] = 'nil'`。
对同文件其它 version-dependent getattr fallback 做同样检查。只有确实不可达的分支才加 pragma，以保持风格一致。

trigger.task_type: Add "# pragma: no cover" for ImportError

validation: Run the module's existing tests (e.g. tests for utils/version) to confirm they still pass and the import still works.
Run coverage and confirm the except body no longer shows up as missed lines.
Run the repository linters (flake8/pylint) to confirm the inline-comment spacing (two spaces before `#`) is accepted.

name: preserve-tab-state-in-undo-stack
negative_constraints: 不要在 pinned 恢复时绕过 set_tab_pinned 直接改 tab.data.pinned 或 TabBar 属性。
不要只改 UndoEntry 定义而遗漏 undo() 中的位置解包。
不要把新字段插入到 namedtuple 中间,否则会破坏现有的位置参数构造。
不要在 tab.shutdown() 之后才读取 tab.data,因为那时状态可能已经失效。
不要顺带重构 sessions.py 的逻辑。该文件在此 PR 中只有行宽格式化的改动。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/mainwindow/tabbedbrowser.py 中找到 UndoEntry namedtuple。它决定关闭标签页时会保存哪些状态。
要让某个 tab 属性(例如 tab.data.pinned)在 undo 后保留,就把它作为新字段追加到 UndoEntry 末尾,不改动 url/history/index 原有字段的顺序。
在 _remove_tab 构造 UndoEntry 的地方,从 tab.data 读取该属性并传入。这一步要放在 tab.shutdown() 之前,也要在 history serialize 成功的 else 分支内完成。
在 undo() 里找到 self._undo_stack.pop() 的元组解包,同步加上新字段。解包数量和 namedtuple 字段数不一致会直接抛 ValueError。
tabopen/openurl 和 history.deserialize 完成之后,复用 TabbedBrowser.set_tab_pinned(idx, pinned) 恢复状态。不要直接改写 tab.data.pinned,因为 set_tab_pinned 还会负责标签宽度和标题的更新。
参照 sessions.py 中 set_tab_pinned(i, pinned, loading=True) 的写法,确认 session 恢复与 undo 恢复走的是同一个 API,两条路径的行为保持一致。
用 grep 搜索 UndoEntry( 和 _undo_stack 的所有构造点与解包点,确保每一处都已同步更新。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/mainwindow 以及与 tabbedbrowser/sessions 相关的单元测试。
如果存在端到端测试,运行 tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature 中与 undo 和 pin 相关的场景。
新增场景:先 pin 一个 tab,再关闭它并执行 :undo,断言该 tab 恢复后仍是 pinned 状态,且位于原 index。
回归检查:对一个未 pin 的 tab 执行关闭再 undo,确认它恢复后没有被 pin;同时确认 last-close 时复用当前 tab 的路径也能正常工作。

name: prompt-error-via-message-error
negative_constraints: 不要在 message.error 之外再保留 QToolTip 弹出，避免产生双重提示。
不要保留 log.prompt.error 与 message.error 的重复记录，message.error 已经负责日志。
不要在仍有其他引用时删除 QToolTip 或 QPoint 的 import。

validation: 运行现有测试：pytest tests/unit/mainwindow 以及 prompt、downloads 相关的 end2end 测试（tests/end2end/features/prompts.feature、downloads.feature）。

name: qsyntaxhighlighter-attach-before-settext
negative_constraints: Do not call setPlainText or setHtml on the QTextDocument before attaching the QSyntaxHighlighter. Calling it first silently loses highlighting on newer Qt.
Do not move setPlainText inside the 'if column in columns_to_filter and pattern' block. Unfiltered columns would then render empty.
Do not work around the problem by forcing rehighlight() or by version-checking Qt. Reordering the calls is sufficient and version-agnostic.
Do not change the escaping or the space-to-alternation logic of the pattern while fixing the ordering.
procedure: Locate the text-drawing path in CompletionItemDelegate in qutebrowser/completion/completiondelegate.py. This is the branch that handles plain text, not HTML, and calls self._doc.setPlainText(self._opt.text).
Confirm the root cause. Since Qt 5.11.3 and 5.12.1+, QSyntaxHighlighter only rehighlights when the document's contents change. A highlighter attached after setPlainText therefore applies no formats.
Reorder the calls. First build the pattern with re.escape(pattern).replace(r'\ ', r'|').
Instantiate _Highlighter(self._doc, pat, config.val.colors.completion.match.fg) while index.column() is in columns_to_filter and pattern is non-empty.
Only after that, call self._doc.setPlainText(self._opt.text). The content change then triggers highlightBlock.
Keep setPlainText outside the if-block, after it, so non-filtered columns and empty patterns still get their text.
Leave the HTML branch (setHtml with the font span) unchanged.

name: qt-accessor-method-truthiness-check
negative_constraints: 不要用 `is not None` 去判断 Qt 访问器方法对象, 例如 self.text、self.width、self.font, 这种比较恒为真。
不要把守卫改成 `self.text() is not None`。PyQt5 下 text() 返回 str, 不会是 None, 这样写同样无效。
不要顺带重构 elide 逻辑或改动 _elidemode 的语义, 这是最小范围的 bugfix。
不要为了让检查生效而把 text 改成实例属性, 那样会遮蔽 QLabel.text()。
procedure: 定位 TextBase(QLabel) 中读取 Qt 属性的条件判断, 例如 _update_elided_text 里的 `if self.text is not None:`。
判断被检查的名字是 Qt 的访问器方法还是 Python 属性。QLabel.text 是方法, `self.text` 只是绑定方法对象, 永远不是 None, 所以这个检查恒为真, 等于没有守卫。
改为调用访问器并按真值判断, 写成 `if self.text():`。PyQt 返回的 str 为空时为假, 可以同时排除空串和无文本两种情况。
保持守卫内部原有逻辑不变: 仍用 fontMetrics().elidedText(self.text(), self._elidemode, width, Qt.TextShowMnemonic) 生成 _elided_text。
检查同一文件和同一类中有没有类似误用, 例如 setText 或 paintEvent 里直接引用 self.text 而没有调用。确保 _elided_text 在文本为空时的行为和 paintEvent 的分支一致。
validation: 运行现有测试: pytest tests/unit/mainwindow/statusbar/
如果 tests/unit/mainwindow/statusbar/test_textbase.py 存在, 确认 elide 相关用例通过。可以补一条用例: 文本为空时调用 resizeEvent 或 _update_elided_text 不抛错, 且不产生无意义的 elided 文本。
运行 pylint/flake8, 确认没有引入新的警告。

name: qt-bug-version-gated-workaround-with-env-override
negative_constraints: Do not compare the Qt version with a simple `>=` when the fix was backported to an older minor branch. Encode each fixed range explicitly.
Do not silently return `None`. Always surface a `message.error` so the user knows why the new tab or window did not open.
Do not drop the env-var override. Patched distro builds would otherwise lose the feature.
Do not let the guard and the test-skip predicate drift apart. The two expressions must stay equivalent; ideally factor them into a shared helper.
Do not add a new `QUTE_*` env flag without making sure the crash dialog collects it.
procedure: Find the Qt override that triggers the upstream bug. For example, `WebEngineView.createWindow` in `qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webview.py`.
Put the guard at the very top of that method, before any logging or tab creation. Mark it with a `# WORKAROUND for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-NNNNN` comment.

Build the 'fixed' predicate only from `qtutils.version_check`. It must cover every fixed branch, including backports. Example: `(vercheck('5.6.2') and not vercheck('5.7.0')) or vercheck('5.7.1')`. A single `>=` check is wrong here, because 5.6.2 is fixed but 5.7.0 is not.
Add an environment-variable escape hatch to the predicate: `os.environ.get('QUTE_QTBUGNNNNN_PATCHED', '')`. This lets distros or users who carry the Qt patch opt in.

When the predicate is false, report a user-visible error with `message.error(self._win_id, ...)` that names the minimum Qt versions. Then return the Qt-sanctioned 'decline' value; for `createWindow` that is `None`. Do not raise.
Add `'QUTE_*'` to `_get_environment_vars` masks in `qutebrowser/misc/crashdialog.py`. This makes the override flag show up in crash reports.

In `tests/end2end/conftest.py` `pytest_collection_modifyitems`, compute the same predicate. Register a marker such as `'qtwebengine_createWindow': ('Skipped because of QTBUG-NNNNN', pytest.mark.skipif, not fixed)`.
Tag the affected BDD features or scenarios with the new marker.
Add a parametrized case to `tests/unit/misc/test_crashdialog.py::test_get_environment_vars`. It should show that a `QUTE_` variable is included and an unrelated variable is filtered out.

trigger.task_type: Guard a QtWebEngine feature behind a Qt-version check because of a known upstream Qt bug

validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/misc/test_crashdialog.py`.
Run the end2end suite with `--qute-bdd-webengine` on an affected Qt. Check that tests tagged with the marker are skipped, not failing.
On an affected Qt, manually trigger `window.open` or `target=_blank`. Expect an error message and no crash.
Set `QUTE_QTBUGNNNNN_PATCHED=1` and check that the guard is bypassed.
Run pylint/flake8 to confirm the new `os`, `qtutils` and `message` imports are used.

name: qt-hex-version-constant-encoding
negative_constraints: 不要把版本号的十进制写法直接拼进十六进制, 例如把 5.7.1 写成 0x050710, 或把 5.10 写成 0x0510。
不要因为修正常量而删除 qVersion() 的运行时字符串比较。编译期 QT_VERSION 和运行时 Qt 版本可能不同。
不要只改常量而让错误提示文案和实际门槛不一致。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py 中的 check_qt_version(), 以及仓库中所有与 QT_VERSION / PYQT_VERSION 做整数比较的地方 (可 grep '0x05')。
按 Qt 十六进制编码规则校验每个常量: 0xMMNNPP, 每个分量各占两位十六进制 (major<<16 | minor<<8 | patch)。例如 5.7.1 = 0x050701, 5.7.0 = 0x050700, 5.10.1 = 0x050a01。注意 0x050710 实际是 5.7.16, 不是 5.7.1。
核对十六进制常量、parse_version(qVersion()) 中的字符串版本 (如 '5.7.1') 和报错文案 ('Qt >= 5.7.1 and PyQt >= 5.7') 三者是否表示同一个最低版本; 若不一致, 以文案和字符串中的语义版本为准修正常量。
复用现有结构: 保留 QT_VERSION 编译期检查、PYQT_VERSION 检查和 qVersion() 运行时检查三重判断, 只修改错误的字面量。
validation: 确认 Qt 5.7.1 环境下 check_qt_version() 不会触发 fatal error, 5.7.0 环境下会触发。
run existing tests (tests/unit/misc 相关) 并 grep 确认没有残留错误编码的 0x05 常量。

name: qt-message-handler-forgiving-function-parse
negative_constraints: Do not chain .group() directly on re.match/re.search results in logging or message-handler code paths. An exception inside a Qt message handler can abort the process or hide the original message.
Do not raise or log a new error when the parse fails. Degrade silently to the unparsed value.
Do not drop the function information by falling back to None or an empty string when the raw value is available.
Do not broaden the regex as the only fix. The None-guard fallback is what makes parsing robust against unforeseen formats.
Do not change the filtering of suppressed messages or the msg_type to logging-level mapping in the same change.

Do not change only the log output in log.py without updating the LogLine regex in quteprocess.py. Otherwise the integration test parser fails on quoted lines and the whole test process reports errors.
Do not quote every function name. Add quotes only when the name contains ':', so that the format of normal log lines and existing test expectations stay unchanged.
Do not replace or delete the ':' characters in the function name. Keep the original signature for debugging.
When editing the regex under re.VERBOSE, indent with spaces only (the accepted diff mixes in tabs). Escape literal spaces as '\ '.
procedure: Locate the regex in qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py that extracts the bare function name from Qt's context.function, e.g. 'void qt_png_warning(png_structp, png_const_charp)' -> 'qt_png_warning'.
Split the chained call `re.match(...).group(1)`. Store the match result in a variable and check `match is not None` before calling group(1).
If the match succeeds, set func = match.group(1). If it fails, fall back to the raw context.function string so the log record keeps whatever information Qt provided.
Leave the downstream qt.makeRecord(name, level, context.file, context.line, msg, None, None, func) call and the category-to-logger-name mapping unchanged.

Optionally add a unit test that calls qt_message_handler with a fake context. Give it a function value that the regex cannot match, such as an operator, a lambda, a template signature or a name without a return type, and assert that no exception is raised and the record's funcName equals the raw string.

Locate qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py. Find the branch where func is derived from context.function. It must stay a three-way branch: None -> 'none', containing ':' -> wrap in double quotes ('"{}"'.format(...)), otherwise keep the raw value.

Reason for quoting: the log format uses 'module:function:line' with ':' as the separator. Qt can report a full C++ signature in context.function, such as 'void Foo::bar(Baz::Enum, const QString&)'. Its '::' would break the separator, so quoting protects the field boundary.

Update the regex of the LogLine parser in tests/integration/quteprocess.py at the same time. Split the function group into two alternatives: a plain name that does not start with a double quote and contains no colon, or a double-quoted string, i.e. ([^"][^:]*|"[^"]+"). Keep the module and line groups unchanged.

When LogLine sets self.function, strip the outer quotes with function.strip('"') so that downstream consumers (ignore rules, expected-message matching) see the original Qt function name. Keep the existing 'none' -> None logic.

In tests/integration/test_quteprocess.py, add cases to the test_log_line_parse parametrization using real Qt messages, such as the QNetworkReplyHttpImplPrivate::error signature and the QXcbXSettings constructor. Assert that module, the function with quotes removed, and line (int) are all parsed correctly.

trigger.task_type: Let qt function parsing be more forgiving

validation: Run the existing log tests (pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py).
Simulate qt_message_handler with a context whose function is 'void foo(int)' and assert funcName == 'foo'.
Simulate it with a non-matching function string, e.g. 'operator()' or 'Foo::bar', and assert there is no exception and funcName equals the raw string.
Run flake8/pylint on qutebrowser/utils/log.py.

name: qt-sql-driver-name-check-in-earlyinit
negative_constraints: Do not use 'SQLITE' or other driver names without the 'Q' prefix. Qt only recognizes the 'Q'-prefixed plugin keys.
Do not move the PyQt5.QtSql import to module top level in earlyinit.py.
Do not replace the check with try/except around opening a database. Keep the cheap isDriverAvailable probe.
Do not change the user-facing _die message or exit behavior as part of this fix.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py and locate check_sqlite(). It is the early startup dependency check that imports PyQt5.QtSql.QSqlDatabase lazily.

Confirm that every driver-name string matches a name Qt registers. Qt SQL plugin names carry a 'Q' prefix: QSQLITE, QPSQL, QMYSQL, QODBC. A bare 'SQLITE' is never available, so the check always fails and _die runs on every startup.

Fix the literal passed to QSqlDatabase.isDriverAvailable() to 'QSQLITE'. Check that it matches the driver name used where the database is actually opened, i.e. the QSqlDatabase.addDatabase call in qutebrowser/misc/sql.py.
Keep the existing _die('sqlite driver not available! Is sqlite installed?') path and message. Change only the driver identifier.
Keep the QtSql import inside the function, not at module level. earlyinit must still be able to report missing PyQt modules before importing them.

trigger.task_type: Check correct SQL driver in earlyinit.

validation: Run python -c "from PyQt5.QtSql import QSqlDatabase; print(QSqlDatabase.drivers())" and confirm that 'QSQLITE' is listed and the string in check_sqlite matches it exactly.
Start qutebrowser (e.g. python -m qutebrowser --temp-basedir) and confirm it no longer dies with 'sqlite driver not available'.
Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/misc (sql/earlyinit-related tests).

name: qtutils-strict-version-check-operator-semantics
negative_constraints: Do not apply the 'only check compiled when result is True' shortcut to every operator. For lt/le it inverts the semantics and hides an outdated compiled Qt.
Do not silently accept other operators (eq, gt, le, ne) with strict=True unless their combined runtime/compiled semantics are explicitly defined. Assert instead.
Do not change the default behaviour of strict=False, which compares the runtime qVersion() only.
Do not reorder the parametrize tuple fields in test_version_check.
Do not keep a `lambda _v: value` mock. It breaks with a TypeError once keyword arguments are passed.
Do not return the same value for every version when the code checks several versions. That hides the exact-version branch.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py and find version_check(version, op=operator.ge, strict=False). It compares the runtime qVersion() and, when strict=True, the compiled QT_VERSION_STR.

Check what strict means for the chosen operator. With operator.ge it must hold for both runtime and compiled ('both are new enough'). With operator.lt it is the negation of strict ge: True if either version is below the threshold.
When strict=True, add a guard that only accepts the operators whose semantics are defined: `assert op in [operator.ge, operator.lt], op`.

Branch on the operator to decide when the compiled version should be consulted. For ge, check compiled only when the runtime result is True (short-circuit AND). For lt, check compiled only when the runtime result is False (short-circuit OR). In both cases evaluate `op(parse_version(QT_VERSION_STR), parsed)`.
Keep parsing through pkg_resources.parse_version, as the existing code does. Do not switch to a different version-parsing library.

Add parametrized cases (qversion, compiled, version, op, expected) to test_version_check in tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py. Cover strict lt with runtime >= and compiled <, expecting True. Also cover strict lt with both >=, expecting False. Keep the existing strict ge cases.
Replace a boolean parametrize such as `new_qt` with string scenarios such as `'new'`, `'old'` and `'5.7'`. This makes it possible to express version-specific outcomes.
For each scenario, monkeypatch `pdfjs.qtutils.version_check` with a lambda that mirrors the real signature: `lambda version, exact=False, compiled=True: ...`.
Branch on the version argument inside the lambda. For example, in the 'new' scenario return `False` for `'5.7.1'` and `True` otherwise.
End the if/elif chain with `else: raise utils.Unreachable`, and import `utils` from `qutebrowser.utils`.
Add parametrize rows for every scenario × backend combination (QtWebEngine and QtWebKit).
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py -k version_check
Confirm strict ge still returns False when the compiled version is below the threshold.
Confirm strict lt returns True when only the compiled version is below the threshold, and False when both are at or above it.

Grep callers: `grep -rn 'version_check(' qutebrowser/`. Check that any call using strict=True with op=operator.lt now behaves as intended, and that no caller passes an unsupported operator with strict=True.

name: qtutils-version-check-add-pyqt-compiled-gate
negative_constraints: 不要在 exact=True 时把 PYQT_VERSION_STR 纳入相等比较, 应改为禁止 compiled 与 exact 组合。
不要只改 qtutils.py 而漏改 exact=True 的现有调用点, 否则这些调用会在运行时抛出 ValueError, 例如 end2end 的 skip 标记计算。
不要新增独立的 pyqt 比较函数或更改函数签名。应复用 op/parsed 链, 保持向后兼容的默认值。
不要在测试中依赖真实安装的 PyQt 版本, 必须 monkeypatch 三个版本源。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py 中 version_check(version, exact=False, compiled=True), 确认现有逻辑: 先用 pkg_resources.parse_version 比较运行时 qVersion(), compiled=True 时再比较 QT_VERSION_STR。
在 PyQt5.QtCore 的现有多行 import 中追加 PYQT_VERSION_STR, 不另起一条 import。
复用同一个 op 和 parsed, 链式增加检查: 'if compiled and result: result = op(parse_version(PYQT_VERSION_STR), parsed)'。顺序为 运行时 Qt -> 编译期 Qt -> PyQt, 前一项失败即短路。
增加参数守卫: compiled=True 与 exact=True 同时使用时 raise ValueError。原因是 Qt 与 PyQt 的版本号不必相同, 对三个版本串做精确相等的检查没有意义。
全仓 grep 'version_check(' 和 'exact=True', 找出所有调用点。凡是用 exact=True 的地方都显式补上 compiled=False, 典型位置是 tests/end2end/conftest.py 中 qt 标签的 '==' 和 '!=' 分支。
扩展 tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py 中的参数化表: 增加 'pyqt' 列, 并 monkeypatch qtutils.PYQT_VERSION_STR。同时覆盖 pyqt 版本更旧时返回 False、相等或更新时返回 True, 以及 compiled+exact 组合抛出 ValueError。旧用例的 pyqt 列填 None。
修正注释, 写明每一步比较的是哪个版本串。

trigger.task_type: Also check PyQt version for qtutils.version_check()

validation: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_qtutils.py -k version_check
确认在 compiled=True, exact=True 时 pytest.raises(ValueError) 用例通过
grep -rn 'exact=True' qutebrowser tests, 确认每处都带 compiled=False
运行 tests/end2end 的 collection (pytest --collect-only tests/end2end), 确认 qt 版本标签计算不报错

name: qtwebengine-block-internal-chrome-scheme-via-qute-handler
negative_constraints: Do not register the scheme outside the qtutils.version_check('5.11', compiled=False) guard. Older QtWebEngine versions behave differently, and installing handlers for these schemes there can break them.
Do not pass these schemes on to the qute:// dispatch logic (qutescheme.data_for_url). Fail the request immediately with UrlInvalid.
Do not register the scheme in only one of the two places. A scheme that is installed but not handled in requestStarted would be treated as qute: and fall through.
Do not use compiled=True or drop the compiled=False flag. The check must use the runtime Qt version.
Do not create a separate scheme handler class for the workaround. Reuse QuteSchemeHandler.
procedure: Locate the Qt-version-gated block in QuteSchemeHandler.install(profile): `if qtutils.version_check('5.11', compiled=False):`. It already carries the QTBUG-63378 workaround comment and registers b'chrome-error'.

Inside that same version-gated block, add one more `profile.installUrlSchemeHandler(b'<scheme>', self)` line for the new internal Chromium scheme (e.g. b'chrome-extension'). The argument must be a bytes literal.

In requestStarted(job), extend the existing scheme check from `url.scheme() == 'chrome-error'` to a membership test such as `url.scheme() in ['chrome-error', 'chrome-extension']`. Keep it in the early branch that calls `job.fail(QWebEngineUrlRequestJob.UrlInvalid)` and then returns.
Keep the existing WORKAROUND comment that references the Qt bug URL. If the new scheme belongs to a different upstream bug, add a separate WORKAROUND comment with that bug link.
Make sure the scheme name used at registration (bytes) and the one used in the requestStarted check (str) match exactly. Both places have to be changed together.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine and the qute-scheme related end2end tests (tests/end2end/features/qutescheme.feature) on a QtWebEngine >= 5.11 backend.
Manually open a chrome-extension://... URL with --backend webengine and confirm that it fails as an invalid URL without crashing and without rendering the qute: error page.
Grep webenginequtescheme.py and confirm every scheme passed to installUrlSchemeHandler, other than b'qute', also appears in the requestStarted fail list.
Run flake8/pylint on the touched file so the list literal and line length pass lint.

name: qtwebengine-download-filename-unquote
negative_constraints: Do not decode in the caller or in the QtWebKit download path. This change is limited to the QtWebEngine helper.
Do not use `unquote_plus`. Path components should not turn '+' into a space.
Do not move the unquote step before the '(N)' regex.
Do not hand-roll percent decoding with a regex. Reuse `urllib.parse.unquote`.
Do not change the existing parametrized expectations, such as 'foo(a)' and 'foo1' staying unchanged.
procedure: Start from the `_get_suggested_filename(path)` helper in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginedownloads.py. Do not change the download-item creation or signal-handling logic. Filename normalization is done only in this pure function.

Keep the existing order of operations. First call `os.path.basename(path)`. Then use `re.sub(r'\([0-9]+\)$', '', ...)` to strip the trailing '(N)' de-duplication suffix that QtWebEngine appends. Only after that, call `urllib.parse.unquote(filename)`.
Decode after stripping. That way an encoded '%281%29' that is part of the real filename is not mistaken for the dedup suffix and removed.

Import the stdlib explicitly with `import urllib.parse`. A bare `import urllib` only works when another module happens to have loaded the submodule already. Place the import in the existing stdlib import block, matching the current sort order.
In the `@pytest.mark.parametrize` list of `test_get_suggested_filename`, add a case such as `('foo%20bar', 'foo bar')`.
Consider adding a combined case, for example the dedup suffix plus an encoded character. This locks in the strip-then-decode order.

trigger.task_type: Decode percent sequences in QtWebEngine downloads

validation: pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginedownloads.py
Confirm that existing cases ('foo(1)'→'foo', 'foo(a)'→'foo(a)') still pass.
Run flake8 or pylint on webenginedownloads.py to check import order and confirm there are no unused imports.

name: qtwebengine-download-interrupt-reason-with-version-fallback
negative_constraints: Do not call interruptReasonString() unguarded. On Qt < 5.9 it raises AttributeError and crashes the download state callback.
Do not use a hard Qt version comparison (qtutils.version_check) in place of the attribute probe. This change uses EAFP (try/except AttributeError) for API availability.
Do not change or remove the self.successful = False assignment, and do not bypass _die().
Do not change the QtWebKit download implementation (webkit/downloads) or the AbstractDownloadItem interface. This is a WebEngine-only fix.
Do not set the fallback text to an empty string or None. Keep 'Download failed' so the user always sees a message.
procedure: Locate the state == QWebEngineDownloadItem.DownloadInterrupted branch in DownloadItem._on_state_changed in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginedownloads.py.
Keep the existing self.successful = False assignment and the QTBUG-56839 comment. Replace only the hard-coded error string passed to self._die().
Get the specific reason from the Qt object with reason = self._qt_item.interruptReasonString(). Wrap the call in try/except AttributeError, because the API only exists in Qt >= 5.9.
In the except branch, add a '# Qt < 5.9' comment and fall back to the old generic text 'Download failed'. This keeps behavior unchanged on older Qt.
Pass reason to the existing self._die(reason). Do not create a new error-reporting path; _die already handles the message display and download cleanup.
Leave the else branch alone. It still raises ValueError for unknown states.

trigger.task_type: Add error messages for QtWebEngine downloads

validation: Run the existing download-related tests: pytest tests/unit/browser -k download, and the end2end downloads feature tests (tests/end2end/features/downloads.feature) under a webengine backend.
Manually or with a mock, make _qt_item lack interruptReasonString (to simulate Qt < 5.9). Confirm _die receives 'Download failed' and no exception is raised.
On Qt >= 5.9, trigger an interrupted download (for example a network disconnect or a non-writable target directory). Confirm the error message shows Qt's specific reason instead of the generic text.
Run flake8/pylint to make sure the new try/except and comment follow the repository's style rules.

name: qtwebengine-download-suffix-stripping
negative_constraints: Do not keep the end-anchored-only regex `\([0-9]+\)$`. It misses `name(1).ext`, which is the real-world case.
Do not strip all parenthesized numbers anywhere in the name. A legitimate name like `report(2019)final.pdf` must keep its parentheses.
Do not drop or reorder the Qt 5.8.1 unquote workaround while touching this function.
Do not run the end2end test on QtWebKit or non-Linux. The XDG download dir behaviour is Linux/QtWebEngine specific, so skip on other configurations.
Do not rely on the user's real download dir. Always isolate it with `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and tmpdir.
procedure: Open `_get_suggested_filename(path)` in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginedownloads.py. This is where qutebrowser cleans up the filename that QtWebEngine proposes as `path` (QTBUG-56978).

Account for where QtWebEngine puts the uniquifier. When a file with the same name already exists in the XDG download dir, QtWebEngine inserts ` (N)` before the extension, giving names like `download(1).bin`. The suffix does not appear only at the end of the name.

Match the `\([0-9]+\)` suffix with a lookahead so it is stripped both before an extension and at end-of-string. Use `re.sub(r'\([0-9]+\)(?=\.|$)', '', filename)`. The lookahead `(?=\.|$)` leaves the extension intact.
Leave the surrounding pipeline as it is: `os.path.basename` first, then the suffix strip, then the version-gated `urllib.parse.unquote` for Qt < 5.8.1 (QTBUG-58155).
Add an end2end test in tests/end2end/test_invocations.py, marked `@pytest.mark.linux`, that skips unless `request.config.webengine` is set.

In the test, write `XDG_DOWNLOAD_DIR=<tmpdir/downloads>` to a `user-dirs.dirs` file and pass `XDG_CONFIG_HOME=tmpdir` through `quteproc_new.start(args, env=env)`. Use args built from `['--temp-basedir'] + _base_args(request.config)`.
Configure the test with `prompt-download-directory=false` and `download-directory` set to the same dir.
Download `data/downloads/download.bin` once and wait for `Download * finished`.
Download the same file a second time. Wait for `Entering mode KeyMode.yesno *`, which is the overwrite prompt, answer it with `:prompt-accept yes`, then wait for the second finish.
Assert that exactly one file exists in the download dir and that its basename is `download.bin`.
validation: Run `pytest tests/end2end/test_invocations.py -k webengine_download_suffix` with the webengine backend on Linux.
Run the existing download tests (`tests/end2end/features/downloads.feature`, `tests/unit/browser/webengine`) to confirm there are no regressions.
Sanity-check the regex: `download(1).bin` becomes `download.bin`, `download(1)` becomes `download`, `download.bin` is unchanged, and `a(1)b.txt` is unchanged.

name: qtwebengine-download-suggested-filename-suffix-stripping
negative_constraints: Do not drop the old `(N)` suffix handling when adding the new Qt format. Older Qt versions still produce it.
Do not use literal spaces in a re.VERBOSE pattern. Escape them as `\ `, or they are silently ignored.
Do not remove the `(?=\.|$)` anchor. Without it, parentheses or dates in the middle of a name would be stripped.
Do not gate suffix stripping on a Qt version check unless necessary. Matching both formats unconditionally is simpler and safe.
Do not strip non-numeric parentheses such as 'foo(a)'.
procedure: Locate `_get_suggested_filename(path)` in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginedownloads.py. QtWebEngine/Chromium appends a uniquifying suffix to the downloaded path, and this function strips it to recover the user-facing name.
Identify the new suffix format from the Chromium source. Example: time_to_iso8601.cc produces ` - YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`. Cite the source URL in a regex comment.

Replace the one-line `re.sub` with a precompiled `re.VERBOSE` pattern. Use an alternation of suffix variants: the numeric `\([0-9]+\)` and the ISO-8601 ` - ...Z`. Allow an optional leading space (written `\ ?`, because whitespace is ignored in VERBOSE mode). Keep the lookahead `(?=\.|$)` so only a suffix that sits right before the extension or at the end of the name is removed.

Keep the existing post-processing in place and in the same order: `os.path.basename` first, then suffix stripping, then the `qtutils.version_check('5.9', compiled=False)` unquote workaround (QTBUG-58155).

Extend the `pytest.mark.parametrize` table in tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginedownloads.py with positive cases for each new variant, e.g. 'foo (1)' and 'foo - 1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' mapping to 'foo'.
Keep the negative cases ('foo(a)', 'foo1') and the Qt-version-marked cases such as `utils.qt58`.

trigger.task_type: Adjust filename suffix matching for Qt 5.12

validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webenginedownloads.py`.
Check that numeric, spaced-numeric, ISO-8601 and no-extension cases strip correctly.
Check that names with an extension (e.g. 'foo (1).txt' becomes 'foo.txt') still work, and add such a case if missing.
Check that the negative cases are unchanged.

name: qtwebengine-focusproxy-none-guard
negative_constraints: 不要对所有调用点一律加 if 跳过。event_target 这类必须返回有效 widget 的地方静默返回 None 会把错误推迟到调用方，应该用 assert 显式声明不变量。
不要用 try/except AttributeError 包裹 focusProxy() 链式调用来掩盖问题。
不要在 _install_event_filter 中删除或延后 ChildEventFilter 的创建，它是 focusProxy 为 None 时的兜底路径。
不要用 # type: ignore 绕过 Optional 返回值的类型检查。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py 中所有直接链式调用 self._widget.focusProxy().<method>() 的位置。可以用 grep 'focusProxy()' 覆盖整个 qutebrowser/browser/webengine/。
逐个调用点判断语义。如果它只是尽力安装（例如 _install_event_filter 给 focus proxy 装鼠标事件过滤器），就改成先赋值 fp = self._widget.focusProxy()，再用 if fp is not None 守卫后调用。fp 为 None 时跳过即可。

以 _install_event_filter 为例：focusProxy 为 None 时跳过是安全的，因为后续创建的 mouse.ChildEventFilter（eventfilter=self._mouse_event_filter, widget=self._widget）会在 RenderWidgetHostViewQtDelegateWidget 子控件后来出现时补装过滤器。复用这个已有兜底机制，不要另写一套延迟安装逻辑。
如果调用点的契约要求必须返回一个有效对象（例如 event_target() 被按键/鼠标事件派发使用），就改为 fp = ...; assert fp is not None; return fp。这样把 Optional 收窄为非 None，同时满足 mypy，并在违反不变量时尽早失败，而不是在下游抛出晦涩的 AttributeError。
两种处理方式都用同一个局部变量名 fp，保持风格一致。保持函数签名和返回类型不变。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine 以及与 tab/mouse 事件相关的单元测试，确认无回归。
在仓库 tox 配置中运行 mypy，确认 focusProxy() 的 Optional 返回值不再报 'Item None has no attribute' 一类错误。
用 grep 'focusProxy()\.' 确认 webengine 目录下已没有未守卫的链式调用。
手动或用 e2e 测试打开新标签页并立即点击或滚动，确认鼠标事件过滤器仍然生效（通过 ChildEventFilter 补装）。

name: qtwebengine-hardcoded-profile-attributes
negative_constraints: Do not reference new QWebEngineSettings enum members directly, such as QWebEngineSettings.FocusOnNavigationEnabled. They do not exist on older Qt/PyQt versions and would raise AttributeError at startup. Resolve them with getattr(..., None).
Do not expose these hard-coded attributes as user config options in configdata.yml unless the task asks for it. They are intentionally not configurable.
Do not add a qtutils.version_check for attributes that are guarded by getattr. Feature detection is enough and avoids version mismatches between Qt and PyQt.
Do not move the attribute setup out of ProfileSetter.init_profile. It must apply to both the default and private profiles.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginesettings.py and find ProfileSetter.init_profile(). It calls set_http_headers() and set_http_cache_size(), then does the per-profile setup.

Collect the hard-coded, non-user-configurable QWebEngineSettings attributes in one helper method, ProfileSetter._init_attributes(). Inside it, keep a dict that maps the attribute name as a string to its value, for example {'FullScreenSupportEnabled': True, 'FocusOnNavigationEnabled': True}.

In the helper, call settings = self._profile.settings(). Loop over the dict and resolve each attribute with getattr(QWebEngineSettings, name, None). Call settings.setAttribute(attr, value) only when the result is not None.

Replace the old inline settings().setAttribute(QWebEngineSettings.FullScreenSupportEnabled, True) call in init_profile() with self._init_attributes(). Keep the existing version-gated spellcheck block (qtutils.version_check('5.8')) unchanged.
To add a future always-on attribute, add one entry to the dict. Do not add a new inline setAttribute call.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine and tests/unit/config.
Start qutebrowser on an older Qt (for example 5.7 or 5.8) or mock the missing attribute, and confirm there is no AttributeError at profile init.
On Qt >= 5.8, check that profile.settings().testAttribute(QWebEngineSettings.FocusOnNavigationEnabled) is True for the default and private profiles.
Run pylint/flake8 to confirm the new private method has a docstring.

name: qtwebengine-navigation-type-version-guard
negative_constraints: 不要直接在 dict 字面量里引用 QWebEnginePage.NavigationTypeRedirect,旧版 Qt 会在导入或调用时抛 AttributeError。
不要用 Qt 版本号字符串比较来做门控;对单个枚举属性优先用 try/except AttributeError 探测。
不要只加 .get() 兜底而不新增枚举成员,否则 redirect 信息会丢失。
不要把新枚举成员插到 'other' 之后或打乱已有顺序。
procedure: 定位 崩溃点: 在 WebEnginePage.acceptNavigationRequest 里,type_map[typ] 遇到新版 Qt 新增的枚举值(如 NavigationTypeRedirect)时会抛 KeyError。
在 usertypes.NavigationRequest.Type 的枚举列表中增加对应成员(如 'redirect'),放在 'other' 之前,并加注释写明版本限制(例如 '# QtWebEngine >5.14 only')。
在 type_map 字面量构建之后,用 try/except AttributeError 包裹新版 Qt 才有的属性访问,把映射加进去(例如 type_map[QWebEnginePage.NavigationTypeRedirect] = Type.redirect)。旧版 Qt 上 pass 即可。
把 type_map[typ] 改成 type_map.get(typ, usertypes.NavigationRequest.Type.other)。这样以后 Qt 再新增未知类型时会退化为 other,不会崩溃。
检查 navigation_request 的下游消费者(例如按 navigation_type 分支的逻辑)。确认新增的 redirect 类型不会意外落入旧分支,或是否需要按 other 同等处理。

trigger.task_type: Fix crash on redirect on qt5.14

validation: run existing tests (pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine 以及 usertypes 相关单测)
在 Qt 5.14+ 环境手动或端到端访问一个会 302 重定向的 URL,确认不再崩溃,且 navigation_type 为 redirect
在 Qt <5.14 环境确认模块可导入、导航正常
可选:mock 一个未知 typ 值,断言回退到 Type.other

name: qtwebengine-optional-attribute-guarded-mapping
negative_constraints: Do not delete the setting from configdata.py. That would break existing user configs and QtWebKit users.
Do not wrap the entire MAPPINGS literal in try/except. Only the attribute that is actually missing should be optional.
Do not catch broad Exception. Catch only AttributeError.
Do not use hard Qt version checks (qVersion comparisons) when a feature-presence check (try/except AttributeError) is enough.
procedure: Find the attribute that does not exist on older Qt. Typical sign: importing webenginesettings.py raises AttributeError at module load time, e.g. QWebEngineSettings.WebGLEnabled is missing on Qt 5.6.
Remove that entry from the static MAPPINGS dict literal. Otherwise the whole module fails while the literal is being built.

At the end of the module, after MAPPINGS is defined, add a try block that assigns the entry by section and key, e.g. MAPPINGS['content']['webgl'] = Attribute(QWebEngineSettings.X). Catch only AttributeError and pass.
In the except branch, add a comment naming the Qt version that introduced the attribute, e.g. '# Added in Qt 5.7'. This makes it easy to delete the shim once that minimum version is required.

Keep the setting definition itself in configdata.py so the config stays valid across backends and versions. Update its description to state the minimum version, e.g. 'For QtWebEngine, Qt/PyQt >= 5.7 is required for this setting.'
Check that the setting-apply code tolerates a missing key in MAPPINGS, i.e. the setting simply has no effect. It must not crash with a KeyError.
validation: Import qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webenginesettings under the old Qt (5.6) and confirm there is no AttributeError.
Under Qt >= 5.7, confirm MAPPINGS['content']['webgl'] exists and toggling the setting works.
Run the existing config and settings unit tests, plus the configdata docs and description checks.

name: qtwebengine-upgrade-profile-dir-nuking
negative_constraints: 不要每次启动都删目录。必须受 qt_version_changed 或一次性 state 标记控制。
不要在 QtWebKit 后端执行这类清理。
检查运行时 Qt 版本时不要用 compiled=True 或省略该参数，要用 compiled=False。
不要硬编码 ~/.local/share 之类的路径，必须走 standarddir.data()。
不要无限累积备份，也不要在目录不存在时报错。
不要删除整个 webengine 目录，只处理有问题的子目录。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/misc/backendproblem.py 的 _BackendProblemChecker 中找到已有的 _handle_cache_nuking。新方法按它的写法来，命名为 _handle_<thing>_nuking，返回值标注为 -> None。
docstring 里写明这是 WORKAROUND，并列出对应的 QTBUG 链接。
判断是否需要清理时，复用 configfiles.state.qt_version_changed。不要自己去比较或存储 Qt 版本。

如果要对已经装好的旧安装也强制清理一次，就在 configfiles.state['general'] 里加一个一次性标记键，例如 'serviceworker_workaround' = '514'。只有该键不存在，并且 qtutils.version_check('5.14', compiled=False) 成立时才执行清理，然后写入标记。其余情况回退到 qt_version_changed 的判断。
目标路径用 os.path.join(standarddir.data(), 'webengine', '<Dir Name>') 拼出。目录不存在就提前 return。
执行前用 log.init.info 记一条日志，说明原因。
目录里可能有用户持久数据时，不要直接 rmtree。先删除旧的 '<dir>-bak'，再用 shutil.move 把当前目录改名为 '<dir>-bak'，这样始终只留一份备份，同时限制磁盘占用。
在 check() 的 QtWebEngine 分支里，紧跟在 _handle_cache_nuking() 之后调用新方法。不要放进 QtWebKit 分支。

trigger.task_type: Delete Service Worker directory on Qt upgrades

validation: 运行 tests/unit/misc 下与 backendproblem 相关的现有测试，以及 config state 相关测试。
用 monkeypatch 设置 configfiles.state.qt_version_changed 为 True/False，在 tmp_path 下的 standarddir.data() 中验证三点：目录被移动为 '-bak'；旧的 '-bak' 被替换；目录不存在时没有副作用。
验证一次性标记：第一次运行写入 state['general'] 键并执行清理，第二次在 Qt 版本未变时不再清理。
在 doc/changelog.asciidoc 中补充 Fixed 条目，并注明 QTBUG 编号。

name: qtwebkit-explicit-int-coercion-at-qt-boundaries
negative_constraints: Do not use round() or math.floor in place of int() unless the semantics require it. Truncation preserves the existing scroll behavior.
Do not remove the qtutils.check_overflow checks, and do not move them after the Qt call.
Do not import QtWebKitWidgets unconditionally in tests. QtWebEngine-only environments must skip gracefully.
Do not swallow TypeError just to work around the conversion problem. Fix the type at the call site.
procedure: Locate every call site that passes Python numbers into a PyQt/Qt C++ API with an int signature. Typical examples are QWebFrame.scroll, setScrollPosition, and QMetaEnum.valueToKey.

Find expressions that compute floats, such as `x * size.width()` in delta_page. Wrap the result in an explicit `int(...)` before passing it to the int-typed helper (`self.delta(int(...), int(...))`). Do not rely on PyQt's implicit conversion.

Add type annotations to the touched methods so mypy can catch float-to-int mismatches. Use `x: int = 0, y: int = 0 -> None` for delta and `x: float = 0.0 ... -> None` for delta_page. Keep qtutils.check_overflow(x, 'int') before the Qt call.

QFlags/enum objects passed to QMetaEnum.valueToKey must be wrapped as `int(value)`. Assign the `enumerator(idx)` result to a local variable such as `meta_enum`, and keep the AttributeError fallback unchanged.

Add a regression test for the QFlags case. Use pytest.importorskip('PyQt5.QtWebKitWidgets') so it is skipped when WebKit is unavailable. Construct flags with combinations of `|=` and `&= ~`, for example QWebPage.FindWrapsAroundDocument/FindBackward, which reproduces the TypeError seen in the 'Searching with --reverse' scenario. Then call debug.qflags_key(QWebPage, flags, klass=QWebPage.FindFlag).

trigger.task_type: Fix remaining implicit int issues with QtWebKit

validation: Run pytest tests/unit/utils/test_debug.py, including TestQFlagsKey::test_find_flags.
Run the QtWebKit backend BDD scenario 'Searching with --reverse' and the scroll-page related end2end tests.
Run mypy (tox -e mypy) on the annotated webkittab.py and debug.py.
Run with -W error::DeprecationWarning to confirm there are no implicit __int__ conversion warnings.

name: quote-comments-that-look-like-mypy-type-comments
negative_constraints: 不要写以 `# type:` 开头的非类型注释,mypy 会把它当作类型注释解析。
不要用 `type -` 之类的改写来规避,这会篡改被引用的原文格式,也已被后续提交推翻。
不要用 `# type: ignore` 或关闭检查器的方式来绕过这个问题。
不要顺带修改注释所在处的代码逻辑或字符串常量。
不要只给引用块的第一行加 `>`,否则格式不一致。
procedure: 定位: 用 `grep -rnE '#\s*type\s*[:-]' qutebrowser/` 找出所有以 `type` 开头的普通注释行。重点看引用外部文档(如 MDN)或原样粘贴错误输出(如 Qt SQL 错误的 type/database text/driver text/error code)的注释块。
判定: 如果该行不是真正的 PEP 484 类型注释,只是碰巧以 `type:` 开头,mypy 或 flake8 的类型注释检查会把它当成类型注释解析,进而报错。之前用 `type -` 规避的写法会改变原文含义,同样不可取。
改写: 给整个引用块的每一行统一加 `> ` 前缀,做成 markdown 风格的引用。例如 `# > type: ConnectionError`。这样可以保留原文中的 `type:` 冒号格式,而该行开头不再是 `type:`。
保持引用块完整: 引用块的所有行都加 `> `,不只改第一行。引用来源说明(如 'The Mozilla Developer Network says:')和 URL 行不加前缀。
重新折行: 加前缀后要重新换行,使每行仍在仓库行宽限制(79/80 列)以内。
只改注释,不改任何逻辑(如 `if 'type' in style`、`environmental_strings` 列表)。
validation: 运行 `tox -e mypy`(或 `mypy qutebrowser`),确认没有 invalid type comment 或 syntax error。
运行 flake8/pylint(`tox -e flake8`、`tox -e pylint`),确认行宽和注释风格符合要求。
再次 grep `#\s*type\s*:`,确认剩下的匹配都是真正的类型注释。
运行现有单元测试(如 `pytest tests/unit/misc/test_sql.py tests/unit/browser/webkit`),确认行为无变化。

name: qute-scheme-exception-type-dispatch-fix
negative_constraints: 不要只修一个后端而遗漏另一个平行的 scheme handler。
不要在 except 块中引入会抛新异常的属性访问(如 `e.__type__`)。这类异常会掩盖原始错误,并让 job.fail / ErrorNetworkReply 走不到。
不要顺手重构错误映射表或日志格式。修复补丁应保持最小改动。
procedure: 定位 qute:// scheme handler 中把 qutescheme 异常映射为后端错误码的 except 块。WebEngine 侧的映射是 QWebEngineUrlRequestJob.*。WebKit 侧的映射是 QNetworkReply.* / ErrorNetworkReply。
检查获取异常类的写法。Python 异常实例没有 `__type__` 属性。正确写法是用 `type(e)`,或 `e.__class__`。
两个后端是平行实现。同一个修复必须同时应用到 webenginequtescheme.py 和 webkitqutescheme.py。
保留 `errors[exctype]` 这种精确类型字典查找。日志里继续使用 `exctype.__name__`。
确认 errors 字典的 key 覆盖了 except 子句捕获的全部异常类型。例如 NoHandlerFound、SchemeOSError、Error 等。这样 `type(e)` 精确查找不会 KeyError。若 except 捕获的是基类,而实际抛出的是子类,需要补齐映射或改用 isinstance 链。
validation: grep -rn '__type__' qutebrowser/ 确认无残留
run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser -k qutescheme
构造会抛 qutescheme.NoHandlerFound / SchemeOSError / Error 的 qute:// 请求,确认 handler 返回对应错误码而不是 AttributeError
运行 pylint/flake8 检查两个文件

name: qutebrowser-adblock-host-whitelist-setting
negative_constraints: Do not remove or replace the hardcoded HostBlocker.WHITELISTED (local domains such as localhost). The user whitelist is an addition, not a replacement.
Do not use plain string `in` comparison or substring matching. The spec requires exact matching apart from the wildcards.
Do not leave out none_ok=True or default to a non-empty value, or an empty config will fail validation or wrongly whitelist hosts.
Do not put the setting in a section other than content, and do not use a different key name, or the get() path will not match.
Do not use fnmatch.fnmatch directly. Its case sensitivity depends on the platform, so case-insensitive behaviour must be explicit.
procedure: Locate the content section in configdata.data() and find the 'host-blocking-enabled' entry. Add the new 'host-blocking-whitelist' setting right after it: SettingValue(typ.List(none_ok=True), ''). The setting description must state three things: the domains are always loaded even when blocked, * and ? wildcards are supported, and matching is otherwise exact.

In qutebrowser/browser/adblock.py, add a module-level helper is_whitelisted_domain(host). Read the setting with objreg.get('config').get('content', 'host-blocking-whitelist'). If the value is None, return False.

Reuse stdlib wildcard semantics: compile fnmatch.translate(pattern) with re.compile(..., re.IGNORECASE) and test it with .match(host). Host comparison must be case-insensitive. Do not hand-write the glob-to-regex conversion.

Locate the filtering condition in HostBlocker._merge_file (the per-line loop of the blocklist parser). Keep the existing check `host not in self.WHITELISTED` and AND it with `not is_whitelisted_domain(host)`, so whitelisted hosts never enter self.blocked_hosts.
Add the imports (fnmatch, re) in alphabetical order with the other stdlib imports at the top of the file.

Add tests in tests for adblock: wildcard-pattern hits, exact-match hits, case insensitivity, an empty/None whitelist, and the end-to-end check that whitelisted hosts do not end up in blocked_hosts after merging a list. Also add a changelog entry and check whether the generated settings docs need regenerating.
validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser/test_adblock.py tests/unit/config
Mock or stub the config with whitelist=['*.example.com', 'ads.foo.org'] and assert that sub.example.com and ADS.FOO.ORG are not blocked while bar.org is still blocked.
Check that host-blocking-whitelist validates as None/empty and that is_whitelisted_domain returns False in that case.
Run the configdata consistency/docs-generation tests to confirm the new setting is registered correctly.

name: qutebrowser-add-debug-flag-mapped-to-qtwebengine-args
negative_constraints: Do not add the flag only in configinit without registering it in valid_flags; the CLI will reject it.
Do not merge several switches into one yielded string (e.g. '--enable-logging --v=1'); yield each switch on its own.
Do not emit QtWebEngine switches unconditionally or for the QtWebKit backend; keep them inside _qtwebengine_args.
Do not reuse or alter the semantics of existing flags such as 'stack'; add a distinct flag name.
