同步更新 tests/unit/utils/test_version.py::test_version_output, 共三处。第一处: 在 patches dict 中加入被 monkeypatch 的属性。sys.executable 是普通值, 所以写 'sys.executable': 'EXECUTABLE PATH'; 函数类的条目才用 lambda。
第二处: 在 substitutions dict 中加入对应占位键, 例如 'python_path': 'EXECUTABLE PATH'。
第三处: 在 expected 文本模板的相同相对位置插入同一行, 例如 'Using Python from {python_path}'。行顺序必须与 version() 输出严格一致。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py -k test_version_output, 确认所有参数组合都通过。
运行 pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py, 做完整回归。
可选: 启动 qutebrowser 执行 :version, 目视确认新行出现在 'Imported from' 之后。

name: qutebrowser-version-table-driven-module-probe
negative_constraints: 不要使用裸 __import__ 或 exec/eval, 应使用 importlib.import_module。
不要使用普通 dict。当时的目标 Python 版本中普通 dict 不保证顺序, 输出顺序必须稳定, 因此应使用 OrderedDict。
不要把 sipconfig 这类有特殊错误处理和日志的探测并入通用循环。
不要捕获过宽的 Exception, 导入阶段只捕获 ImportError, 取属性阶段只捕获 AttributeError。
不要把通用的 getattr 默认值写死在循环里而丢掉多候选属性的回退逻辑(colorama 依赖 VERSION 回退到 __version__)。
不要只改生产代码而漏改参数化测试中的硬编码列表。
不要改变已有模块的相对顺序。
不要在 _module_versions 外单独 import 或 try/except 新模块, 应复用统一循环。
不要把非 __version__ 的特定属性名硬编码进 ImportFake.version_attribute, 应通过 no_version_attribute 处理。
不要只改 version.py 而不同步 ImportFake.modules, 否则 fake import 无法覆盖新模块, 测试会走真实导入。
不要假设 PyQt5.QtWebEngine 在所有环境都存在, 缺失时必须由现有 ImportError 路径降级。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/utils/version.py 中的 _module_versions(), 找出逐个书写的 'try: import X / except ImportError / getattr(X, "__version__")' 重复块。
保留特殊探测逻辑原样不动: sipconfig 依赖 sip_version_str 并在出错时记录 log.misc.warning, 不适合放进通用表。
在文件顶部的 stdlib import 区增加 import importlib 和 import collections。
建立 collections.OrderedDict([(module_name, [候选版本属性...]), ...]) 表, 保持原有输出顺序(colorlog, colorama, pypeg2, jinja2, pygments)。属性列表按优先级排列, 例如 colorama 用 ['VERSION', '__version__'], 只需报告是否存在的模块用 []。
循环使用 importlib.import_module(name) 导入: 捕获 ImportError 时输出 '<name>: no'; 导入成功后按顺序 getattr 各候选属性, 用 try/except AttributeError + break 取第一个存在的属性; 用 for-else 在全部属性都缺失时回退为 '<name>: yes'。
每个模块只往 lines 追加一行, 格式统一为 '{name}: {value}'。
删除已经不再需要的 '# pylint: disable=import-error,unused-variable,too-many-branches' 注释以及 '应改用 __import__' 的 TODO 注释。
在 version._module_versions() 的 OrderedDict 中按期望的显示顺序增删条目，格式为 (模块名, [版本属性名])。
同步修改 tests/unit/utils/test_version.py 中 ImportFake.__init__ 的 exists 字典。
全文搜索 test_version.py 中所有以 'sip: yes' 开头的 expected 列表，逐一追加或删除对应行，保持与 OrderedDict 顺序一致。对无版本属性的模块写 'name: yes'，对有版本属性的模块写 'name: 1.2.3'。
定位 qutebrowser/utils/version.py 中的 _module_versions(), 找到 modules OrderedDict 的 (modname, [attributes]) 列表。
复用现有条目格式, 新增一行元组 (modname, [attribute_names]), 例如 ('PyQt5.QtWebEngine', ['PYQT_WEBENGINE_VERSION_STR'])。按语义放在相关模块附近 (如放在 QtWebEngineWidgets 之后)。条目顺序决定输出顺序。
依赖现有循环完成后续处理: 它会逐个尝试 import 和 getattr 属性, 并在 ImportError 或属性缺失时降级显示。不要为单个模块另写分支。
在 tests/unit/utils/test_version.py 的 ImportFake.__init__ 中, 向 self.modules OrderedDict 添加同名条目 (modname, True), 位置与 version.py 中的顺序保持一致。
如果该模块的版本属性名不是 '__version__', 或该属性在 fake 中不应存在, 把它加入 ImportFake.no_version_attribute 列表。ImportFake 只模拟 '__version__', 因此不加入会导致 fake 伪造错误的属性行为。
检查 test_version.py 中依赖 modules 顺序或数量的参数化测试 (expected 输出列表、'yes'/'no' 断言等), 确认新条目不会破坏现有断言, 必要时补充期望值。
validation: 运行 tests 中与 utils/version 相关的现有测试, 例如 pytest -k version。
运行 pylint/flake8 处理 qutebrowser/utils/version.py, 确认移除 disable 注释后没有新增告警。
手动执行 qutebrowser --version 或调用 version.version(), 确认各模块行的顺序与格式正确。
注意行为变化: 缺失的模块现在会输出 '<name>: no', 原实现是省略该行; 若有依赖旧行为的测试需同步更新。

name: qutebrowser-webengine-unused-import-cleanup
negative_constraints: Do not remove imports that are only referenced in type comments, annotations, or string-based slot signatures. Confirm the absence of such uses with grep before deleting.
Do not add `# pylint: disable=unused-import` to hide the warning. Delete the import instead.
Do not reorder or regroup unrelated imports (stdlib / PyQt5 / qutebrowser groups). Keep the diff minimal.
Do not change behavior or modify the certificate-error handling logic as part of the lint fix.
procedure: Start from the lint report and locate the unused-import warnings. These often appear after logic was moved into a dedicated module. In this case, certificate-error handling moved to certificateerror.py.

In each flagged file, grep the whole file for every symbol in the multi-line PyQt5 import tuple, for example QWebEngineCertificateError. Do the same for each name in the `from qutebrowser.utils import ...` list, for example jinja. Confirm each symbol has no remaining use outside the import line itself.

Delete only the names that are truly unused. If the tuple then fits on one line, collapse it to a single line and remove the parentheses. If it still spans lines, keep the parenthesized form and align continuation lines with the opening parenthesis.
Check sibling modules in the same refactor scope for the same leftover import. In this PR both webenginetab.py and webview.py were affected.
Keep the imports that are still used, such as the certificateerror module. Do not touch any logic code.
validation: Run `tox -e flake8` and `tox -e pylint`, or run flake8/pylint directly on the changed files, and confirm the unused-import warnings are gone.
Run `python -c 'import qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webview, qutebrowser.browser.webengine.webenginetab'` to confirm the modules still import (requires QtWebEngine).
Run the existing unit tests under tests/unit/browser/webengine.

name: qutebrowser-webengine-version-gated-attribute-mapping
negative_constraints: Do not add the attribute to the unconditional base attribute mapping. On older Qt the missing enum member raises AttributeError at startup.
Do not compare against the Qt version (qtutils.version_check) just to guard the attribute. The getattr/AttributeError pattern in new_attributes already does this.
Do not invent or guess an attribute name. A typo is swallowed by the except clause and the setting silently does nothing.
Do not put an inverting converter on a setting whose semantics match the Qt attribute directly.
procedure: Find the `new_attributes` dict in `WebEngineSettings.__init__` (or the equivalent `_ATTRIBUTES` init path) in qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginesettings.py. It holds attributes that exist only in newer Qt versions and is grouped by '# Qt 5.x' comments.

Check the Qt docs or PyQt for the exact attribute name under QWebEngineSettings.WebAttribute, for example 'WebRTCPublicInterfacesOnly'. It must match exactly, because the loop resolves it with getattr(QWebEngineSettings, attribute) inside try/except AttributeError.
Add an entry under the matching Qt version comment: `'<config.option.name>': ('<WebAttributeName>', converter)`.

Use `None` as the converter when the config bool maps directly to the attribute. Pass a lambda only when the meaning is inverted, as in `content.autoplay` -> `('PlaybackRequiresUserGesture', lambda val: not val)`.
Reuse the existing loop, which wraps each entry in `Attribute(getattr(...), converter=...)` and skips it silently on older Qt. Do not write a separate version-check branch.

Confirm the config option already exists in configdata.yml with backend restrictions. If the option claims support for an older Qt version it cannot work on, change its `backend` to something like `QtWebEngine: Qt 5.11`, or note the restriction in the docs.

trigger.task_type: Make a QtWebEngine-backed setting work on a newer Qt version (e.g. content.webrtc_public_interfaces_only on Qt 5.11)

validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/browser/webengine` and the config tests (`tests/unit/config/test_configdata.py`) to confirm nothing breaks on import.
On Qt >= 5.11, run `:set content.webrtc_public_interfaces_only true` and verify QWebEngineSettings.globalSettings().testAttribute(...) reflects it, or check WebRTC IP leaking on a test page.
On an older Qt, confirm qutebrowser still starts without AttributeError.
Grep to confirm the option name matches configdata.yml exactly.

name: qutebrowser-webkit-choosefile-empty-truthiness
negative_constraints: 不要改写 chooseFile 的控制流或 fallback 到 super().chooseFile 的条件，reviewer 只要求改判空写法。
不要用 `len(selected_file) == 0` 或 `is None` 替代，这会遗漏另一种 falsy 情况。
不要顺手重构 shared.choose_file 的返回类型，也不要新增无关的 changelog 条目。
不要把 `return ''` 改成 `return None`，Qt 的 chooseFile 需要返回 str。
procedure: 定位 reviewer 指出的那一行比较。本例是 BrowserPage.chooseFile 中对 shared.choose_file(multiple=False) 返回值的判空。
确认返回值类型。shared.choose_file 返回文件路径列表，可能为空列表；文件选择被取消或出错时也可能为 None 或其他 falsy 值。
把显式的 `== []` 比较改成 Pythonic 的真值判断 `if not selected_file:`。这样空列表和 None 都会走到 `return ''`，保持 Qt 的 chooseFile 返回空字符串的语义。
保持 else 分支 `return selected_file[0]` 不变。真值判断能保证访问 [0] 之前列表非空。
同一文件中如有 WebEngine 或 multiple=True 的对称分支（例如 extension 中的 ChooseMultipleFiles），检查是否存在同样的 `== []` 写法。仅在 reviewer 要求或明显同类时一并修改，不扩大 diff 范围。
validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser -k 'webpage or choose_file or filepicker'
运行 flake8 和 pylint 检查 webpage.py，确保没有 comparison-to-empty 类告警（pylint 的 use-implicit-booleaness-not-comparison）。
人工确认空列表和 None 输入都返回 ''，非空列表返回第一个元素。

name: qutebrowser-websetting-unset-reset-in-abstract-settings
negative_constraints: Do not return False directly on UNSET. Call the Qt reset* API and compare old_value against the real value after the reset.
Do not override the mapping with None in the backend's except AttributeError branch. That breaks the type annotation and the dict semantics inherited from the base class.
Do not keep a same-named setter in both the base class and a subclass.
Do not leave behind imports that are no longer used (flake8/pylint will fail).
procedure: Locate the special-case setter, e.g. set_unknown_url_scheme_policy, and every place that calls it. Callers are usually in the _update_setting dispatch inside the backend subclass, such as webenginesettings.WebEngineSettings.

Check how the setter handles usertypes.UNSET. An early `return False` on UNSET means a per-URL override never reverts to the backend default when the pattern is removed or no longer matches. That early return is the bug pattern this skill fixes.

Move the setter up into websettings.AbstractSettings, next to set_default_text_encoding and the font setters. Declare the backend mapping as a class attribute there with an empty dict default, e.g. `_UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME_POLICY = {}  # type: typing.Dict[str, typing.Any]`. Backend subclasses only override the mapping.

Implement the setter in three steps. First read old_value = self._settings.<getter>(). If policy is usertypes.UNSET, call self._settings.reset<Name>() and read the getter again to get new_value. Otherwise map the config string to a Qt enum via the mapping, call set<Name>(new_value), and return old_value != new_value.

In the backend subclass, delete the duplicate setter and drop imports it no longer needs (here usertypes). In the try/except AttributeError that builds the mapping, replace the `= None` fallback with `pass` so the empty dict inherited from the base class still works as a falsy guard.
Keep the existing `if self._UNKNOWN_URL_SCHEME_POLICY:` guard in _update_setting. It skips the call when the Qt version does not support the policy.
validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/config/test_websettings.py tests/unit/browser/webengine.

Add a unit test with a stubbed settings object. First set the policy to a non-default value, then call the setter with UNSET. Assert that resetUnknownUrlSchemePolicy was called and that the return value is True when the value changed.
Do a manual or end-to-end check: set content.unknown_url_scheme_policy with a URL pattern, remove the pattern, and confirm the behavior goes back to the default.
Run mypy and pylint to confirm there are no unused imports and no type errors.

name: qutebrowser-wrap-long-import-with-parens
negative_constraints: Do not use a backslash line continuation for the import.
Do not move a function-local PyQt import to module level just to fix lint. Doing so would break older Qt versions.
Do not split the line into several separate `from ... import` statements unless that is already the existing style.
Do not add `# noqa` or pylint disable comments to suppress line-length warnings.
Do not make unrelated refactors, renames, or behavior changes in the same commit.
procedure: Locate the line the linter reports as too long. In this repo it is usually a `from PyQt5.X import A, B, C` statement, often a local import inside a function such as `opengl_vendor()`, because the import depends on the Qt version.

Rewrite it as a parenthesized multi-line import: `from PyQt5.QtGui import (QOpenGLContext, QOpenGLVersionProfile,` then a new line with `QOffscreenSurface)`. Align continuation lines with the opening parenthesis, which is the visual indent used in qutebrowser.

Keep the original names and their order, and keep the import at its current scope (function-local or module-level). Do not move it, since the import placement is intentional for Qt version compatibility.
Leave surrounding comments, `# pragma: no cover` markers, and asserts unchanged.
validation: Run `tox -e flake8` and `tox -e pylint`, or run flake8/pylint directly on the changed file, and confirm the line-length warning is gone and no new warnings appear.
Run `python -c 'import qutebrowser.utils.version'` to confirm the syntax is valid.
Run the existing tests for this module, e.g. `pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py`.

name: qutebrowser-wrap-long-parenthesized-imports
negative_constraints: Do not reorder, remove, or add imported module names. A lint fix must not change semantics.
Do not add a `# noqa` or `# pylint: disable=line-too-long` suppression to get around a line-length warning.
Do not touch other unrelated lines, the changelog, or tests at the same time.
procedure: Run the linter and find the line that exceeds the 79-character limit; check whether it is a multi-name `from X import (a, b, ...)` statement.
Keep the existing parenthesized import form. Do not convert it to backslash continuations or split it into multiple import statements.
Move the last name that overflows (e.g. `tabindex`) onto a new line, leaving the trailing comma on the previous line.
Align the continuation line with the column right after the opening parenthesis (visual indent), consistent with the existing continuation lines.
Keep the original order and set of imported names; only rewrap the line.
validation: Run flake8 / pylint on the changed file and confirm the line-too-long warning is gone and no new continuation-indent warning (E127/E128) appears.
Run `python -c 'import qutebrowser.mainwindow.statusbar.bar'` or the existing tests to confirm the imports still work.

name: read-version-after-bump-in-update-version-script
negative_constraints: Do not read `__version__` before `bump_version()` runs. It will print the old version in the release commands.
Do not place `import qutebrowser` above the `sys.path.insert` that makes the repo root importable.
Do not hardcode or compute the new version by hand (major/minor/patch arithmetic) in the script. Take it from the bumped source of truth.
Do not change bump_version's bump2version invocation or the argparse choices when the task is only fixing which version gets printed.
procedure: Open scripts/dev/update_version.py. Find where `qutebrowser.__version__` is read and where `bump_version(args.bump)` is called.

Check the module-level imports. If `import qutebrowser` sits at the top of the file, it runs before `sys.path.insert(...)`, so it may import the wrong package or fail outright. It also caches the old version string.
Remove the module-level `import qutebrowser`. Keep only the sys.path setup and the `from scripts import utils` style imports at the top.
In the `if __name__ == "__main__":` block, follow this order: `utils.change_cwd()`, then `bump_version(args.bump)`. Only after both, run `import qutebrowser` and `version = qutebrowser.__version__`.
Use the new `version` in every printed release instruction, such as `git push {v}` and the tag or release-notes hints, so they show the post-bump version.

Make sure nothing earlier in the process imports qutebrowser. That includes scripts.utils and any helper imported at the top. If something does, the late import returns the cached old module. In that case use `importlib.reload(qutebrowser)`, or parse `__version__` directly from qutebrowser/__init__.py.

trigger.task_type: update_version: Get new version from qutebrowser.py

validation: Run `python -m py_compile scripts/dev/update_version.py` (or flake8/pylint per repo config) to confirm it is still valid.

Dry-run the logic in a scratch branch: run `python3 scripts/dev/update_version.py patch` and check that the printed `git push vX.Y.Z` matches the new `__version__` in qutebrowser/__init__.py, not the old one. Reset the branch afterwards.
Grep the script to confirm no top-level `import qutebrowser` remains: `grep -n '^import qutebrowser' scripts/dev/update_version.py` should return nothing.

name: reject-nil-qt-keys-in-keyparser
negative_constraints: 不要在 basekeyparser 中直接比较 0x0; 应在 keyutils 层判定非法性, 由 parser 统一捕获 KeyParseError。
不要让非法 key 只返回 NoMatch 而保留之前的部分 keychain, 必须 clear_keystring。
不要把异常变量命名为 e 去遮蔽外层 key event 参数后又在之后的代码中继续使用该事件。
不要在 key_data 中用 getattr(Qt, 'Key_') 处理空 attribute, 会得到错误的 member。
不要删除 is_printable 中对 Key_Space 的原有排除。
procedure: 定位 keyutils.KeySequence.append_event: 在读取 ev.key() 之后、任何 Backtab/modifier 处理之前, 对非法 key (如 0x0) 抛出 KeyParseError(None, '<reason>'), 而不是让它进入序列。
复用已有 KeyParseError 类型 (与 Qt.Key_unknown 的解析路径一致), 不要新增异常类。
在 BaseKeyParser.handle 中用 try/except keyutils.KeyParseError 包住 self._sequence.append_event(e): 调用 _debug_log 记录 'Aborting keychain', 调用 clear_keystring(), 返回 QKeySequence.NoMatch。
同步更新辅助函数: is_printable 排除 0x0 (例如 key not in [Qt.Key_Space, 0x0]); _key_to_string 的 special_names 增加 0x0 -> 'nil', 使非法 key 可被字符串化和日志化。
在 KeySequence.__init__ 末尾增加不变量检查 (每个子序列非空 assert), 防止空序列被静默构造。
对已不可达的防御分支 (如 KeyInfo.__str__ 中 printable 但 key_string 为空的 ValueError) 标注 '# pragma: no cover', 而不是删除。
在测试数据 key_data.KEYS 中新增条目 Key(attribute='', name='nil', member=0x0, qtest=False), 并让 Key.__attrs_post_init__ 只在 attribute 非空时才 getattr(Qt, 'Key_'+attribute)。
在 test_basekeyparser 中增加用例: 先输入合法 key (Key_B), 再输入 fake_keyevent(0x0), 断言 keyparser._sequence 为空; 在 test_keyutils 中增加 append_event(0x0) 抛出 KeyParseError 的用例。

trigger.task_type: Handle invalid keys coming from Qt

validation: pytest tests/unit/keyinput/test_keyutils.py tests/unit/keyinput/test_basekeyparser.py
确认 key_data 驱动的参数化测试 (_key_to_string 期望 'nil') 通过
运行 check_coverage 脚本, 确保 keyutils/basekeyparser 保持 100% 覆盖 (pragma: no cover 位置正确)

name: remove-blank-line-after-function-docstring
negative_constraints: 不要改写 docstring 的措辞或格式(例如 'Undo removing of a tab.')。
不要删除或移动 docstring 后的注释, 只删空行。
不要顺手做无关的重构或改逻辑(例如 config.get('tabs', 'last-close') 分支)。
不要因为这类空白修复去新增测试或 changelog 条目。
class docstring 有不同规则(D203/D204 视配置而定), 不要套用这条函数规则去删 class docstring 后的空行。
procedure: 运行 pydocstyle/pep257 lint(按仓库 tox/lint 配置), 或根据报告里的 D202 定位违规函数。
在违规函数中找到单行或多行 docstring 的结束三引号, 确认其后紧跟一个空行, 然后才是第一条语句或注释。
只删除这一行空行, 让函数体的第一行(包括注释, 例如 '# Remove unused tab ...')紧接在 docstring 下方。
docstring 文本、注释内容和后续逻辑都保持原样, 修复范围限定在空白行。
在同一文件中检查其他 def 是否有相同模式, 只修复 lint 实际报告的违规。

keywords: No blank lines allowed after function docstring

validation: 对修改的文件重新运行 pydocstyle/pep257(或 tox -e pydocstyle 等仓库配置的 lint 环境), 确认 D202 消失。
运行 flake8/pylint 确认没有引入新的风格告警。
确认 git diff 只有删除空行的改动(-1 行)。
可选: 运行相关现有测试, 确认行为没有变化。

name: remove-dead-instance-attribute-in-qt-widget
negative_constraints: Do not rename or remove similarly named attributes (e.g. _color_flags, _win_id) as part of this cleanup.
Do not reorder or restructure other __init__ statements, and do not touch signal/slot wiring in the same change.
Do not add a changelog entry or new tests for a pure dead-attribute removal. The accepted change touched code only.
Do not remove the attribute based on a grep limited to one file. Pylint/attribute access in other modules or tests must be checked.
procedure: Locate the attribute's assignment in the class __init__ (e.g. `self._option = None` in StatusBar.__init__ in qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/bar.py).

Grep the whole repository for the attribute name, e.g. `rg '\._option\b' qutebrowser tests`. Confirm it is never read or written outside __init__. Check subclasses, getattr/setattr string usages, and the tests directory.
If the only occurrence is the initializer, delete that single assignment line. Leave the surrounding init order unchanged (setSizePolicy, _win_id, _color_flags).
If any reader exists, stop. The attribute is not stray, and the task needs a refactor instead of a removal.
validation: Run the existing statusbar tests: pytest tests/unit/mainwindow/statusbar.
Run pylint/flake8 on bar.py to confirm there are no attribute-defined-outside-init or undefined-attribute regressions.
Re-grep for the removed attribute name and confirm there are zero remaining references.

name: remove-legacy-data-migration-path
negative_constraints: 不要删除 _move_data 等共享迁移辅助函数，除非 grep 证明已无调用方。
不要改动 basedir 判断条件，也不要改动 macOS/Windows 迁移逻辑。
不要用 no-op 函数或 `pass` 保留迁移函数的壳，应完整移除。
不要删除其他测试类(如 TestSystemData、TestMoveWindowsAndMacOS)仍依赖的 fixture 或 import。
不要改变 data()、cache() 等目录解析函数的行为。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/utils/standarddir.py 中定位迁移函数(如 _move_webengine_data)本身，以及它在 init(args) 里的调用点。该调用点位于 `if args is not None and getattr(args, 'basedir', None) is None:` 分支内。
只删除该迁移函数的调用行。分支内的其他平台迁移(_move_macos / _move_windows)保持原状，`sys.platform == 'darwin'` / `os.name == 'nt'` 的 if/elif 结构和 `# pragma: no cover` 注释也不要动。

用 grep 检查共享辅助函数 _move_data 是否仍有其他调用方(如 _move_macos、_move_windows)。仍被引用就保留，不要顺带删除。
检查迁移函数用过的 import 和常量(QStandardPaths、APPNAME、log 等)在模块中是否还有其他使用。只有确认无引用时才移除对应 import。
在 tests/unit/utils/test_standarddir.py 中删除专门测试该迁移的测试类(如 TestMoveWebEngine)，连同它的 fixtures(patch_standardpaths、files namedtuple 等)。
清理测试文件中因删除该测试类而变成未使用的 import(如 collections、QStandardPaths)。删除前先确认其他测试类没有使用它们。
如果仓库在 doc/changelog.asciidoc 中记录 Removed 项，就增加一条说明：已移除从旧 QtWebEngine 数据位置的自动迁移。

trigger.task_type: Remove the ability to migrate old QtWebEngine data

validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/utils/test_standarddir.py，确认剩余测试全部通过。
执行 grep -rn '_move_webengine_data' qutebrowser tests，结果应为空。
运行 flake8 / pylint 检查 standarddir.py 和对应测试文件，确认没有 unused-import。
确认 _move_data 仍被 _move_macos 或 _move_windows 引用，且相关测试仍在运行。

name: remove-obsolete-keyparser-type-param
negative_constraints: Do not keep a deprecated `keytype` parameter or a default placeholder for compatibility. Subclasses are internal, so change all of them together.
Do not leave `import enum` behind if it becomes unused, because the linters (flake8/pylint) will fail.
Do not reimplement the commented-out HintKeyParser.execute logic. It was dead code with a FIXME. Hint handling already goes through `handle_key` / `update_bindings`.
Do not change the order or meaning of `count`. Only the middle positional argument is removed.
procedure: Locate every reference with a full-repo search for `Type.chain`, `Type.special`, `.Type`, `keytype` and `_keytype`. Search tests and comments too.
In basekeyparser.py, delete the `Type = enum.Enum(...)` class attribute. Remove the 'Types:' section from the class docstring. Drop `import enum` once nothing else in the file uses it.
Change the abstract `BaseKeyParser.execute(self, cmdstr, keytype, count=None)` to `execute(self, cmdstr, count=None)`. Update its docstring Args and remove the stale FIXME note.
Update the internal caller in `_handle_key` (the ExactMatch branch) from `self.execute(binding, self.Type.chain, count)` to `self.execute(binding, count)`.
Update every override to the new signature, including `CommandKeyParser.execute` in keyparser.py, which used `_keytype`. Keep `count` as a keyword argument with default None.
Delete any commented-out overrides that relied on the Type enum, such as the dead `HintKeyParser.execute` block in modeparsers.py. Do not port that code to a new signature.

Update the unit tests in tests/unit/keyinput/test_basekeyparser.py and related test files. Change the mocked or asserted `execute` calls, for example from `assert_called_once_with('cmd', Type.chain, None)` to `assert_called_once_with('cmd', None)`. Remove any references to `BaseKeyParser.Type`.
validation: Run `pytest tests/unit/keyinput` and confirm the basekeyparser, keyparser and modeparsers tests pass.
Run `grep -rn "Type\.chain\|Type\.special\|keytype" qutebrowser tests` and expect no results.
Run the linters (`tox -e flake8`, `tox -e pylint`) or the pyflakes subset to catch an unused enum import or mismatched override signatures (arguments-differ).

name: rename-qt-setting-enum-values-always-never
negative_constraints: Do not change the Chromium command-line flags themselves. Only the user-visible config values are renamed.
Do not remove the 'auto': None branch, and do not change the mapping structure.
Do not update only the code or only the tests. The mapping keys and the parametrize cases must be renamed together.
Do not touch other settings in the mapping that already use always/never or have their own semantics.
procedure: In qutebrowser/config/configinit.py, find the settings-to-arguments mapping dict in _qtwebengine_args(). It has the shape {setting_name: {value: chromium_arg_or_None}}.
Find the entry for the target setting, e.g. 'qt.low_end_device_mode'. Change only the dict keys: 'force-on' becomes 'always' and 'force-off' becomes 'never'.
Keep each Chromium flag value unchanged. 'always' maps to '--enable-low-end-device-mode' and 'never' maps to '--disable-low-end-device-mode'.
Keep 'auto': None as it is.
Follow the naming already used by neighbouring entries such as 'content.headers.referer' (always/never). Use the existing vocabulary and do not invent new value names.
Check that the valid_values for the same setting in qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml use the same strings as the mapping keys.
Search the whole repository for the old strings ('force-on' / 'force-off'). Update any references in the docs or the changelog that are tied to this setting.
Update the pytest.mark.parametrize list in TestQtArgs.test_low_end_device_mode in tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py. Its (value, expected_arg) pairs must exactly match the new mapping keys.
validation: pytest tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py -k 'low_end_device_mode'
pytest tests/unit/config/test_configinit.py
Search the repository for 'force-on' and 'force-off' to confirm no leftover references to this setting remain.
Confirm that the configdata.yml valid_values for the setting match the mapping keys, so the configdata consistency tests pass.

name: replace-distutils-strictversion-with-pkg-resources-parse-version
negative_constraints: Do not leave any distutils.version import anywhere in the tree. A partial migration keeps the distutils dependency and its pylint workarounds.
Do not switch to LooseVersion or to string or tuple comparison as a shortcut. LooseVersion mis-orders pre-release and dev versions, and strings compare lexically.
Do not change the version_check signature (version, op=operator.ge) or its semantics. Callers rely on it.
Do not wrap parse_version in a try/except for ValueError the way StrictVersion needed. parse_version accepts any string, and swallowing errors would hide real bugs.
procedure: Run `grep -rn 'distutils' qutebrowser/` to find every use of distutils.version. Expect at least two call sites: `version_check` in qutebrowser/utils/qtutils.py (compares qVersion() with the requested version) and the update check in `_CrashDialog` in qutebrowser/misc/crashdialog.py (compares the newest release with qutebrowser.__version__).

At each call site, replace `distutils.version.StrictVersion(x)` with `pkg_resources.parse_version(x)`. Keep the comparison logic as it is: the `op(...)` call in version_check and the `new_version > cur_version` check.
Delete the `import distutils.version  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module,import-error` line. Also delete the bitbucket pylint issue/73 comment line that follows it.
Add `import pkg_resources` to the third-party import group, after a blank line and above the PyQt5 imports. Do not put it in the stdlib group, because pkg_resources comes from setuptools.
Check the remaining `# pylint: disable=no-member` comments inside the functions. They were only there for distutils. You may keep them as in the original change, or remove them if pylint stays clean.
Confirm that setuptools/pkg_resources is available as a runtime dependency (setup.py install_requires and the packaging notes). Add it there if it is missing.

trigger.task_type: Use pkg_resources instead of distutils for version

validation: grep -rn 'distutils' qutebrowser/ returns nothing.
Run the existing tests for qtutils.version_check. Cover equal, lower and higher versions with operator.ge and operator.eq.
Check that version strings like '5.4' vs '5.4.0' and '0.1.dev1' vs '0.1' compare correctly. StrictVersion rejected inputs like these.
Run pylint/flake8 and confirm there are no import-error or no-name-in-module warnings.

name: replace-setattr-hook-with-properties
negative_constraints: 不要保留 __setattr__ 重写与 property 并存,否则副作用会重复触发。
不要在 __init__ 中通过公共 setter 赋初值。那样会在父类或 QLabel 状态未就绪时调用 _update_text,原本 _initializing 防的就是这个。
不要改变公共属性名或外部调用方的赋值语法,保持 API 兼容。
不要在 setter 中省略副作用调用,也不要把副作用改成依赖调用方手动触发。
不要顺手重构 _update_text 的显示优先级逻辑(temptext 优先于 normaltext)。
procedure: 定位重写了 __setattr__ 的类。目标是那种按名字过滤(如 not name.startswith('_'))、在赋值后触发副作用(如 _update_text())的写法。同时找出用来抑制 __init__ 期间副作用的 _initializing 标志。
列出 __setattr__ 实际要拦截的公共属性。本例是 normaltext 和 temptext。用 grep 确认外部调用方(如 StatusBar)通过 obj.normaltext = ... 或 obj.temptext = ... 赋值,这些写法必须保持不变。
将每个公共属性的存储改名为私有字段 self._<name>。在 __init__ 中直接给私有字段赋初值(self._normaltext = ''),这样初始化阶段自然不会触发副作用。
删除 _initializing 标志和整个 __setattr__ 重写。
为每个属性添加 @property getter,返回私有字段。再添加 @<name>.setter:先写入私有字段,再显式调用副作用方法(self._update_text())。
副作用方法内部继续通过公共 property 读取值,行为与原来一致。删除其 docstring 中 'Called from __setattr__' 之类的过时说明。
更新类 docstring 的 Attributes 段:列出私有字段名,并注明 'Accessed via <name> property';移除 _initializing 条目。
validation: 运行现有测试套件(如 tox / pytest),确保无回归。
grep 确认目标类中已无 __setattr__ 和 _initializing 的残留引用。
grep normaltext、temptext 的外部使用点,确认都只做读写赋值,无需修改。
手动或单元验证:设置 temptext 后显示 temptext;清空 temptext 后回退显示 normaltext;构造对象时不触发 setText。
运行 pylint/flake8,确认 property 和 setter 的 docstring 符合仓库 lint 规则。

name: route-mouse-tab-close-through-pinned-prompt
negative_constraints: Do not duplicate the pinned-check and prompt logic inside TabbedBrowser. Reuse the single helper so keyboard and mouse closes behave the same way.
Do not change the default or internal semantics of `close_tab`. Programmatic closes, window close and tab_only with force=True must keep working without a prompt.
Do not add the prompt to `on_window_close_requested` or other non-user-initiated close paths unless the task asks for it.
Do not leave any stale `self._tab_close_prompt_if_pinned` calls after the rename.
Do not keep `self` usage inside the helper once it is a staticmethod. It must only use the tab, force, yes_action and global message/prompt APIs.
procedure: Locate the existing pinned-tab confirmation helper in CommandDispatcher (commands.py). It is the private `_tab_close_prompt_if_pinned`, which is used by `tab_close` and `tab_only`.

Make the helper reusable outside the dispatcher. Drop the leading underscore and make it a `@staticmethod` named `tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(tab, force, yes_action)`, so callers do not need a dispatcher instance.

Update every existing internal call site to `CommandDispatcher.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(...)`. Use grep to confirm that no reference to the old private name remains. The known call sites are `tab_close` and the pinned loop in `tab_only`.
Locate the GUI close path in TabbedBrowser. This is the slot connected to the tab bar close request (`on_tab_close_requested`) that currently calls `self.close_tab(tab)` directly.
Replace the direct close in that slot with `CommandDispatcher.tab_close_prompt_if_pinned(tab, False, lambda: self.close_tab(tab))`. Pass `force=False` because mouse closes have no force flag.

Add the import `from qutebrowser.browser.commands import CommandDispatcher` in tabbedbrowser.py. Then check that it causes no circular import at startup, since commands.py already references tabbed browser objects.

trigger.task_type: Prompt when closing a pinned tab via the mouse

validation: run existing tests (pytest tests/unit, plus end-to-end tab tests such as tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature).
Verify manually or with an end-to-end test that clicking the close button or middle-clicking a pinned tab shows a yes/no prompt, that answering 'no' keeps the tab, and that answering 'yes' closes it.
Verify that unpinned tabs still close immediately via the mouse.
Verify that `:tab-close`, `:tab-close --force` and `:tab-only` behavior is unchanged.
Start qutebrowser (or import qutebrowser.mainwindow.tabbedbrowser) to confirm there is no circular import error.
Run the repository linters (pylint/flake8) to catch unused or private-name references.

name: statusbar-mutually-exclusive-flags-to-enum-qt-property
negative_constraints: 不要保留两个互斥的布尔标志并手动同时设置 True/False，这正是要清理的易错模式。
不要把 pyqtProperty 声明为枚举类型或返回枚举对象，样式表选择器会匹配不到。应返回 .name 字符串。
不要把状态改成实例属性而删掉类属性定义，否则 pyqtProperty 可能失效。
不要改动 insert_active 等无关的布尔属性，也不要改颜色配置键名。
不要在 val=False 的分支里调用 _set_mode_text 或读取 selection 状态来决定颜色。退出时统一设为 off。
不要遗漏 STYLESHEET 中的旧选择器，否则 caret 背景色会静默失效且不会报错。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/bar.py 中 StatusBar 的类属性布尔标志 (例如 _caret_active / _caret_selection_active)。确认它们是否互斥，也就是同一时刻最多一个为 True。
复用 usertypes.enum，在模块顶部挨着 PreviousWidget / Severity 定义一个模块级枚举，例如 CaretMode = usertypes.enum('CaretMode', ['off', 'on', 'selection'])。第一个成员必须是“关闭”状态。

把多个布尔类属性合并成一个类属性 _caret_mode = CaretMode.off。保持“类属性”这一形式，因为 pyqtProperty 需要它。同时在类 docstring 的 Attributes 部分补充说明，沿用已有的 'For some reason we need to have this as class attribute so pyqtProperty works correctly.' 注释。
把多个 @pyqtProperty(bool) getter 换成一个 @pyqtProperty(str) getter caret_mode，返回 self._caret_mode.name。Qt 样式表的属性选择器只能匹配字符串或布尔值，不能直接匹配枚举对象。
同步修改 STYLESHEET 中的选择器：[caret_active="true"] 改为 [caret_mode="on"]，[caret_selection_active="true"] 改为 [caret_mode="selection"]。颜色键 statusbar.bg.caret / statusbar.bg.caret-selection 保持不变。

重写 set_mode_active 中 KeyMode.caret 的分支，结构为 if val 判断进入还是退出，进入时再按 webview.selection_enabled 选择 CaretMode.selection 或 CaretMode.on，并设置对应的 mode 文本（'caret selection' / 'caret'）。val 为 False 时只设为 CaretMode.off。
更新 debug 日志，让它同时记录 val 和 selection_enabled，取代原来的 'Setting caret_active to'。
保留函数末尾的样式刷新调用 (setStyleSheet / style polish)。属性变化后必须重新应用样式表，选择器才会生效。
全仓 grep 旧属性名 caret_active / caret_selection_active / _caret_selection_active，覆盖其他模块、测试和样式。确认没有残留引用，有则一并迁移。
validation: 运行现有测试：tox 或 pytest tests/，重点运行 statusbar 相关测试。
grep -rn 'caret_active\|caret_selection_active' qutebrowser tests，确认无残留。
手动验证：进入 caret 模式后状态栏使用 statusbar.bg.caret 背景，文本为 'caret'；按 v 切换到选择后使用 caret-selection 背景，文本为 'caret selection'；退出后恢复普通背景。
运行 pylint/flake8，确认新的 getter docstring 与行宽符合仓库规范。

name: strip-single-prefix-char-not-lstrip
negative_constraints: Do not use str.lstrip/rstrip to remove a single known prefix or suffix. It strips a character set repeatedly, not one occurrence.
Do not fix only the search path (command.py). Also fix the equivalent stripping of ':' for startup commands in app.py and any other prefix-stripping sites.
Do not slice with [1:] without first checking that the prefix is present.
Do not change the signal mapping or the mode-leave ordering while fixing the stripping.
procedure: Locate the code that strips the mode/prefix character from command-line input. It lives in Command.on_return_pressed / the accept handler in qutebrowser/mainwindow/statusbar/command.py. There, `signals[text[0]].emit(...)` dispatches ':' to the command, '/' to search and '?' to reverse search.
Grep the whole repo for `.lstrip(` calls that use a prefix character (':', '/', '?', text[0]). Common sites are app.py's handling of startup args (`cmd.lstrip(':')`), runners, keyparsers and IPC.

Replace `x.lstrip(c)` with the slice `x[1:]`, because `lstrip` removes every leading occurrence of the character. Only do this after confirming the prefix is present (for example after an `if text[0] in signals` or `cmd.startswith(':')` check). Where the presence is not guaranteed, you can use `x[len(prefix):] if x.startswith(prefix) else x` instead.
Keep the dispatch logic unchanged. Only the stripping should change, so that a search like '//foo' sends '/foo' and a startup arg like '::cmd' passes ':cmd' to run_safely_init.

Add or extend unit tests for the statusbar Command widget. The test should check that the emitted search text keeps its inner leading prefix chars, e.g. '/' + '/path' emits '/path' and '?' + '?x' emits '?x'.
Add a changelog entry under Fixed, e.g. 'Searching for terms starting with a slash now works'.

trigger.task_type: Fix searching for terms starting with a slash (or other prefix char being over-stripped)

validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/ (in particular tests for mainwindow/statusbar and app).
Manually search for '/foo' by typing '//foo' and confirm the search term is '/foo'.
Run `qutebrowser ':open about:blank'` and check the startup command still works and that the leading ':' is removed exactly once.
Grep again to confirm no remaining `.lstrip(':')`, `.lstrip('/')` or `.lstrip(text[0])` usages on prefixed input.

name: suppress-noisy-qt-log-message
negative_constraints: Do not lower the global Qt log level, and do not drop a whole message category to hide a single message.
Do not use a regex or substring match when the existing prefix list already handles the case. Do not change the matching logic.
Do not include dynamic parts of the message in the prefix, because the prefix would then fail to match.
Do not suppress messages that point to real bugs actionable by users. Only suppress messages that are known to be harmless and have a tracked issue.
Do not add a new configuration option for this.
procedure: In qutebrowser/utils/log.py, find qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg) and its `suppressed_msgs` list of string prefixes.

Decide the scope. Messages that occur on every platform go in the common list. Platform-only messages go in the existing `if sys.platform == 'darwin':` block (or an equivalent platform guard). The guard follows where the message is emitted, not which backend logs it. QXcbClipboard comes from the X11 backend, but the patch put it in the common list.

Add a short comment directly above the new entry that links the issue, for example `# https://github.com/The-Compiler/qutebrowser/issues/<n>`, or briefly explains the source. This follows the style of the entries already there.

Add the stable leading part of the message as a string literal, for example "QXcbClipboard: SelectionRequest too old". Matching is by startswith, so leave out any variable tail such as numbers, timestamps or URLs.
If the prefix is long, split it with implicit string concatenation over several lines, matching the indentation of the existing entries.

trigger.task_type: Hide/suppress a spurious Qt warning or debug message in qutebrowser logs

validation: Run the existing log tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py (or the equivalent path).
Run flake8/pylint on qutebrowser/utils/log.py and check line length and continuation indentation.
Optionally, call qt_message_handler with the message, or reproduce the message, and confirm it is no longer logged while other messages still are.

name: suppress-noisy-qt-message-via-log-handler
negative_constraints: Do not include the dynamic part of the message (port/URL) in the match string.
Do not lower the global Qt log level, and do not filter by message type to hide a single message.
Do not add suppression at the call site that enables the inspector (e.g. QTWEBENGINE_REMOTE_DEBUGGING setup). Centralize it in log.py.
Do not use regex or substring matching that could swallow unrelated legitimate warnings.
Do not lose the trailing space or the exact punctuation when splitting the string literal.
procedure: Locate the suppressed_msgs list in qt_message_handler in qutebrowser/utils/log.py.

Capture the exact stable prefix of the Qt message to hide. Drop the variable tail, such as the URL or port printed after 'Try pointing a Chromium-based browser to '. The handler matches by prefix (startswith), so the prefix alone is enough.
Add the prefix to the generic, platform-independent part of the list. Only put it in the sys.platform-specific blocks (darwin, etc.) when the message is platform-specific.
Above the entry, add a short '# When/why' comment explaining where the message comes from, e.g. '# When enabling debugging with QtWebEngine'. Follow the existing grouped-comment style.
If the string exceeds the line length, split it with implicit string concatenation and a continuation indent. Keep the trailing space before the split point so the joined string is exact.
validation: Run existing tests: pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py.
Enable the QtWebEngine inspector or remote debugging and confirm the 'Remote debugging server started successfully' line no longer appears in the log output.
Confirm that other Qt warnings are still logged.
Run flake8/pylint on log.py to check line length and continuation-indent style.

name: suppress-noisy-qt-warning-in-log-handler
negative_constraints: 不要为了屏蔽单条消息而降低整个 Qt 日志级别,也不要新增过滤机制。复用现有的 suppressed_msgs 列表。
不要把消息里的可变部分(格式名、环境变量值)写进匹配字符串,否则匹配会失效。
不要把跨平台出现的消息放进 sys.platform == 'darwin' 分支。
不要省略 QTBUG 链接注释,否则后续维护者无法判断这条屏蔽何时可以删除。
不要通过设置 QTWEBKIT_IMAGEFORMAT_WHITELIST 环境变量来绕过警告,那会改变安全行为。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/utils/log.py 中定位 qt_message_handler(msg_type, context, msg)。在它内部找到 suppressed_msgs 列表。
确认这条噪音消息来自 Qt 上游 bug,而不是 qutebrowser 自身的问题。找到对应的 Qt bugtracker 链接,例如 https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-53989。
在通用的 suppressed_msgs 列表末尾追加该消息的字面量前缀。位置在 darwin 等平台专属分支之前,除非这条消息只在某个平台出现。
在条目上方加一行 '# https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-XXXXX' 注释,说明为什么屏蔽、以后什么时候可以移除。
长字符串按现有风格拆成多段相邻字面量(隐式拼接),续行缩进与已有条目保持一致,行宽不超过 79。
字符串只写到消息中稳定不变的前缀。可变的尾部,例如环境变量的取值,要截掉,让匹配走 startswith 前缀逻辑。

keywords: blocked because it is not considered safe

validation: 运行现有测试:pytest tests/unit/utils/test_log.py。
运行 flake8/pylint 检查 log.py,确认行宽和缩进符合规范。
构造与 suppressed_msgs 条目前缀一致的 msg,调用 qt_message_handler,确认没有日志输出。
可选:用 QtWebKit 后端打开触发该消息的页面,确认日志不再出现这条警告。

name: sweep-all-stylesheet-font-placeholders-after-font-format-change
negative_constraints: Do not fix only the widget you noticed. Downloads, completion, statusbar, tabbar, hints, keyhint and messages all share the same pattern, and missing one is exactly the failure this follow-up PR fixed.

Do not put 'font:' or ';' back into the config value or into the jinja filter to work around the problem. That reverts the contract change and produces 'font: font: ...;' in templates that were already migrated.
Do not rename font config keys or change selectors while doing this sweep.
procedure: Confirm the new contract first. Check how the font config value is now rendered through jinja/config.style or the configtypes Font/QtFont `to_str`/`transform`. Does it still emit the full 'font: ...;' declaration, or only the value, such as 'bold 10pt Monospace'?

Search the whole repository for every usage. Run `grep -rn "{{ font\[" qutebrowser/` and `grep -rn "font\[" qutebrowser/`. Cover all class-level STYLESHEET strings, any inline templates, and the HTML/CSS templates under html/.
Classify each hit. A bare line `{{ font['x'] }}` is the old form. `font: {{ font['x'] }};` is the new form.
Rewrite every old-form hit to the new form: `font: {{ font['<section>'] }};`. Keep the property name and the trailing semicolon inside the template, not in the config value.
Keep the edit local. Change only the placeholder line, and leave selectors and the other properties (background-color, color) in their existing order.
Grep again and confirm that no line matching `^\s*{{ font\[` remains, i.e. no bare placeholder without a 'font:' prefix.
validation: Run the existing tests: `pytest tests/unit/config tests/unit/completion tests/unit/mainwindow tests/unit/browser`.
Render each STYLESHEET with `config.style.get_stylesheet` (or the jinja env) and assert that the result contains 'font: ' followed by a non-empty value, and no 'font: font:'.
Start the browser manually and check that the downloads bar, completion and statusbar honor custom fonts with no Qt 'Could not parse stylesheet' warnings.

name: update-qtwebengine-chromium-security-backport-table
negative_constraints: Do not change the body of _chromium_version() or any other runtime logic. This task only edits the docstring and documentation.
Do not keep stale lines for older patch releases. Replace them, because the table only records the latest patch per minor version.
Do not change the base Chromium version or base date of an existing Qt minor version. Only the security-fix line moves.
Do not add changelog entries or tests for this docstring-only update.
Do not guess Chromium versions or dates. Use the version stated in Qt's release notes.
procedure: Open qutebrowser/utils/version.py and find the docstring of _chromium_version(). It holds a table with one entry per Qt minor version.
Each entry has three parts: the base Chromium major on the 'Qt 5.x: Chromium N' line, the full base Chromium version with its date, and one 'Security fixes up to' line for the latest patch release.

Get the new patch release (for example 5.12.5 or 5.13.1) and the highest Chromium version whose security fixes it backports. Use the QtWebEngine release notes or the chromereleases blog, and record the Chromium stable release date.

Replace the existing 'Security fixes up to' line in place. Change the Qt patch version prefix (5.12.4 becomes 5.12.5), the Chromium version string and the date. Keep a single line per minor series. Do not add a second line.
Update every Qt minor series that received a release in the same Qt release wave. Parallel releases, such as LTS 5.12.x and current 5.13.x, often share the same Chromium backport level.

Keep the column alignment the same: 13-space indentation under the 'Qt 5.x:' label, the '(LTS)' marker where it already exists, and the '(YYYY-MM-DD)' date format. Use a '~' prefix only for approximate dates.

If a new Qt minor version came out, add a new block after the last one with the same layout: the 'Qt 5.N: Chromium M' line followed by the base version and date line. Leave the trailing 'Also see' links unchanged.
validation: Run flake8 and pylint on qutebrowser/utils/version.py and confirm there are no line-length or docstring-format warnings.
Run pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py and confirm nothing regressed.
Check the diff contains only docstring lines, and that each updated Qt series still has exactly one 'Security fixes up to' line with a valid version and date.

name: update-qtwebengine-chromium-security-fix-docstring
negative_constraints: 不要修改 _chromium_version() 的运行时逻辑,本任务只涉及 docstring 中的文档数据。
不要改动基线 Chromium 行(例如 '80.0.3987.163 (2020-04-02)'),除非 Qt 本身的 Chromium 基线确实变了。
不要编造版本号或日期,版本号必须与日期一一对应,并可在 Chrome Releases 博客上查证。
不要顺手改其他 Qt 版本块,也不要删除末尾的 'Also see' 参考链接。
这类纯文档的维护改动不要求新增测试或 changelog 条目。
procedure: 在 qutebrowser/utils/version.py 中定位函数 _chromium_version(),它的 docstring 维护了一张 Qt 版本到 Chromium 基线版本、各 Qt patch 版本安全修复上限的对照表。
找到目标 Qt 版本那一块(例如 'Qt 5.15: Chromium 80'),再找到对应的 patch 行(例如 '5.15.0: Security fixes up to ...')。
依据上游 QtWebEngine 的变更说明或 chromereleases.googleblog.com,确认新的安全修复上限:Chromium 完整四段版本号,加上该 Chromium 版本的发布日期。
只替换这一行里的版本号和日期,格式保持 'X.Y.Z: Security fixes up to MAJOR.MINOR.BUILD.PATCH (YYYY-MM-DD)',缩进与上下行对齐。
如果该 Qt patch 版本还没有对应行,就按同一格式在该 Qt 版本块内按 patch 版本顺序新增一行,不要改动其他块。
validation: 运行 git diff,确认只有 version.py 中目标 docstring 行有变化。
核对新版本号的发布日期与 Chrome Releases 博客一致,日期格式为 ISO 的 YYYY-MM-DD。
运行 python -m pytest tests/unit/utils/test_version.py,确认没有回归。
运行 flake8 或 pylint 检查 qutebrowser/utils/version.py,确保没有行宽或空白方面的问题。

name: validate-command-arg-against-config-option-type
negative_constraints: 不要在命令内硬编码合法值列表 (如 ['number','letter','word']), 否则会与 config 定义产生漂移。
不要对配置回退得到的值重复校验。
不要让 ValidationError 直接冒泡, 必须转换为 cmdexc.CommandError。
不要在校验前修改 HintManager 状态 (_context, 模式切换等)。
不要改动 config 选项本身的类型定义来迁就命令参数。
procedure: 定位命令处理函数中接收可选参数的分支。在 :hint 中是 HintManager.start, 其中有 `if mode is None: mode = config.val.<option>` 的回退逻辑。
确认该参数在 config 中对应同名选项 (这里是 hints.mode)。该选项的 typ 已经定义了合法值域, 应复用它, 不要另写一份校验。
仅在用户显式传入参数时校验, 即在 else 分支中执行。从配置回退得到的值已经由 config 系统校验过。
通过 `opt = config.instance.get_opt('<option.name>')` 取得选项定义, 再调用 `opt.typ.to_py(value)` 校验用户输入。
捕获 `configexc.ValidationError`, 转换成 `cmdexc.CommandError("Invalid <arg>: {}".format(e))`。这样错误会作为命令错误显示在状态栏, 而不是产生 traceback 或静默行为。
在文件顶部的 import 中补上 `configexc`, 例如 `from qutebrowser.config import config, configexc`。
把校验放在 `_check_args` 和 HintContext 创建之前, 确保失败时不会进入 hint 模式, 也不会留下部分初始化的状态。

trigger.task_type: Show errors on invalid --mode argument for :hint

validation: 运行现有测试: pytest tests/unit/browser/test_hints.py 以及 hints 相关的 end2end 测试 (tests/end2end/features/hints.feature)。
补充或手动执行 `:hint --mode=foobar`, 预期出现 'Invalid mode: ...' 的错误消息, 且不进入 hint 模式。
确认 `:hint --mode=number`、`:hint --mode=letter`、`:hint --mode=word` 和不带 --mode 时行为不变。
可在 end2end feature 中添加场景: When I run :hint --mode=foobar, Then the error "Invalid mode: *" should be shown。

name: vim-style-tab-focus-fallback-to-next
negative_constraints: Do not handle the no-argument case after arg_or_count. Its default=1 would silently turn bare gt into 'jump to the first tab'.
Do not reimplement index +1 / wrap logic inside tab_focus. Call tab_next directly to stay consistent with the tabs.wrap setting.
Do not change the precedence of index='last' or the countzero semantics.
Do not delete the tab-next command itself. Other bindings and user configs still depend on it.
procedure: Locate CommandDispatcher.tab_focus in qutebrowser/browser/commands.py, which has the signature (index=None, count=None).
Keep the existing early return for index == 'last' (_tab_focus_last) first, so that special value keeps priority.

Right after it, add a branch: if index is None and count is None, call self.tab_next() and return. This reuses the existing tab-next logic, including the tabs->wrap behavior, instead of duplicating index arithmetic.
Leave the original cmdutils.arg_or_count(index, count, default=1, countzero=self._count()) path unchanged, so the semantics of an explicit index or count ({count}gt jumps to tab N) stay the same.

Add a line to the tab_focus docstring explaining that with neither index nor count it behaves like tab-next. The docstring generates doc/help/commands.asciidoc, so regenerate that doc with scripts/asciidoc2html / src2asciidoc and commit it as well.
In KEY_DATA in qutebrowser/config/configdata.py, change the binding ('tab-next', ['J', 'gt']) to ('tab-focus', ['J', 'gt']). Leave tab-prev (K, gT) unchanged.

trigger.task_type: Make tab-focus (bound to gt) behave as in VIM

validation: run existing tests: pytest tests/unit and tests/end2end/features/tabs.feature

Add or extend end2end scenarios: with multiple tabs open, :tab-focus without arguments switches to the next tab; wraps around when tabs.wrap is enabled; :tab-focus with a count still jumps to the specified index; :tab-focus last behaves as before.
Check that the default-binding / keyconf unit tests (e.g. configdata/keyconf related tests) still pass, since the command mapped to gt changed.
Run scripts/dev/src2asciidoc.py and confirm the generated docs are in sync with the docstring (CI checks for consistency).

name: webengine-search-prev-use-local-flags
negative_constraints: 不要为了修 prev 去原地修改 self._flags（例如 self._flags ^= FindBackward）。那样会污染 next_result 及后续的 prev/next 调用。
不要改动 next_result，它直接使用 self._flags 是正确的。
不要把 FindBackward 的切换逻辑挪进 _find 或 AbstractSearch。修复应局限在 prev_result 的单行调用参数。
不要顺带重构 FindFlags 的构造或 result_cb 回调链。
procedure: 定位 qutebrowser/browser/webengine/webenginetab.py 中的 WebEngineSearch.prev_result 和 next_result。
核对 prev_result 的写法：它先从 self._flags 拷贝出局部变量 flags，再按当前方向翻转 FindBackward。如果 self._flags 已含 FindBackward，就清除它；否则加上它。
确认最终调用 self._find(...) 时传入的是这个翻转后的局部 flags，而不是 self._flags。传 self._flags 会让翻转被丢弃，:search-prev 就会变成 :search-next。
最小修复：只把 self._find(self.text, self._flags, result_cb) 改为 self._find(self.text, flags, result_cb)。self._flags 保持不变，它代表原始搜索方向，仍要留给 next_result 使用。
对照 QtWebKit 后端（webkittab.py）中 WebKitSearch.prev_result 的同类逻辑，确认两个后端的方向语义一致：prev 是原方向取反，next 是原方向。
validation: 运行 pytest tests/unit/browser 以及与 search 相关的 end2end 测试（tests/end2end/features/search.feature）。
手动或 BDD 验证 QtWebEngine 后端：先 :search foo，再 :search-prev 应向上跳转；先 :search -r foo，再 :search-prev 应向下跳转。
确认连续交替执行 :search-next 和 :search-prev 时方向始终正确，即 self._flags 未被修改。

name: webkit-search-clear-before-new-search
negative_constraints: Do not call clear() before the duplicate-search check. That would cause flicker and remove highlights on a no-op repeated search.
Do not call clear() after self.text, search_displayed or _flags are set. clear() resets state, so the new search state would be overwritten or be inconsistent.
Do not add the same clearing to WebEngineSearch. QtWebEngine already clears automatically, so the fix belongs only in the WebKit backend.
Do not change the AbstractSearch interface or signatures to fix a single backend.
Do not duplicate the findText('', HighlightAllOccurrences) logic. Call the existing clear().
procedure: Locate WebKitSearch.search() in qutebrowser/browser/webkit/webkittab.py, the implementation of browsertab.AbstractSearch for the QtWebKit backend.

Find the duplicate-search early return, the branch that logs 'Ignoring duplicate search request for {}' and returns. The new clear call must come after this branch. A repeated identical search should not wipe and redo the highlights.
Insert self.clear() after the early return. Place it before any search state is written (self.text, self.search_displayed = True, self._flags).

Reuse the existing WebKitSearch.clear(). It emits cleared when search_displayed is set, resets search_displayed, and calls findText('', HighlightAllOccurrences) to remove old highlights. Do not reimplement the highlight removal inline.
Add a short comment explaining why the call exists. QtWebKit does not clear previous highlights on its own, while the other backend (QtWebEngine) does.
Check the ordering: clear() resets search_displayed to False, so search_displayed = True must be assigned after the clear() call.

trigger.task_type: Clear old search results on webkit

validation: Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/browser and the search-related end2end features (tests/end2end/features/search.feature), with the webkit backend where available.
Manual check on --backend webkit: search 'foo', then search 'bar', and confirm the 'foo' highlights are gone.
Manual check: repeat the same search and confirm it is still ignored as a duplicate and the highlights stay.
Confirm the cleared signal is emitted when switching from one displayed search to a new one, so status and UI consumers are not broken.

name: widen-readonly-type-comments-to-mutable-for-mutated-attrs
negative_constraints: Do not change runtime code, such as swapping OrderedDict for dict, to satisfy mypy.
Do not add `# type: ignore` or replace the type with Any to silence mutation errors.
Do not convert `# type:` comments into inline variable annotations.
Do not narrow or alter element types while fixing container mutability.
Do not widen attributes that are never mutated. Read-only Sequence and Mapping stay as they are.
procedure: Run mypy on qutebrowser/commands/command.py. Collect errors that name attributes initialised in Command.__init__, such as opt_args, pos_args and flags_with_args.

For each flagged attribute, find the PEP 484 `# type:` comment at its initialisation. In this file the comment sits on the closing line of a multi-line literal, e.g. `)  # type: ...` or `]  # type: ...`.

Search the class for writes to that attribute: `self.X[key] = ...`, `.append`, `.extend`, `.insert` and `.pop`. Check the methods that build arguments from the signature, such as _inspect_func and _get_param_value.
If the attribute is written, widen only its container type. Change typing.Mapping to typing.MutableMapping and typing.Sequence to typing.MutableSequence.
Keep the element types exactly as they are, for example Tuple[str, str] and str. Keep the runtime constructor as it is, for example collections.OrderedDict() and [].
Keep the `# type:` comment syntax and its position, because the repo still supports Python versions without variable annotations.
Re-run mypy and confirm the errors in commands.command are gone and no new ones appear.

trigger.task_type: mypy: Fix new issues in commands.command

validation: Run mypy (tox -e mypy or the repo's mypy config) and confirm there are no errors in qutebrowser/commands/command.py.
Run the existing tests: pytest tests/unit/commands.
Run the flake8/pylint lint env to confirm the type comment line lengths still pass.
